izzyondroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.name: De1984
izzyondroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.summary: Privacy-focused Firewall and Package Manager for Android devices
izzyondroid:io.github.dorumrr.de1984.description:
De1984 is a Firewall and Package Manager for Android that works with or without root.
 The name De1984 comes from George Orwell's Nineteen Eighty-Four. It stands for resisting surveillance and taking back control of your device and data.
 FIREWALL FEATURES 
 Four firewall methods: iptables (root, or Shizuku in root mode), ConnectivityManager (Shizuku, Android 13+), NetworkPolicyManager (Shizuku, chosen manually) and VPN (no root, works everywhere). Picked automatically for your device. iptables blocks at kernel level
 On ROMs without POLICY_REJECT_ALL, NetworkPolicyManager only blocks metered background data, not WiFi
 Block WiFi, Mobile Data and Roaming separately with iptables and VPN (Roaming is part of Mobile Data). ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager block an app on all networks or none
 Block LAN access, enforced only by iptables
 "Block All by Default" (allowlist) or "Allow All by Default" (blocklist). Switching resets every app's WiFi, Mobile, Roaming and LAN rules to the new default, with no confirmation. System-recommended apps keep theirs, and critical and VPN apps keep theirs only while "Allow Firewall Critical Packages" is on
 Captive portal settings (root or Shizuku). They stay changed after De1984 is uninstalled
 Screen-off blocking to save battery and data
 Rules follow network changes in real time
 PACKAGE MANAGEMENT (Shizuku or root) 
 Enable or disable system apps, force stop apps, uninstall system and user apps
 Filter by system/user and enabled/disabled, and search
 PRIVACY FIRST 
 No tracking, analytics or telemetry
 Local-only data storage
 No proprietary libraries, no Google Play Services
 100% open source (MIT License), buildable from source
 REQUIREMENTS 
 Android 8.0 (API 26) or higher
 PERMISSIONS 
 ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE: apply rules per network
 BIND_VPN_SERVICE: the VPN firewall
 QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES: list installed apps
 POST_NOTIFICATIONS (optional): new app installs
 RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED: start the firewall after a reboot, if it was on
 FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE: keep the firewall running
 REQUEST_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATIONS (optional): stop Android killing the firewall
 KILL_BACKGROUND_PROCESSES: last fallback for force stop
 Shizuku API: talk to Shizuku or Sui
 INTERACT_ACROSS_USERS: read apps in other profiles. When one exists, De1984 grants it to itself through root or Shizuku, without asking
 WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS, CHANGE_COMPONENT_ENABLED_STATE: only checked, to show status
 REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES, INSTALL_SHORTCUT, ACCESS_SUPERUSER: declared, not used
 Root or Shizuku (optional): the iptables, ConnectivityManager and NetworkPolicyManager firewalls, package management, boot protection and captive portal settings
 OPEN SOURCE 
 Source code: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984 Issues: https://github.com/dorumrr/de1984/issues
 Late nights for brighter days. Created by Doru Moraru

LaundryNotes is an Android app that allows you to manage the washing instructions for all clothing and fabrics in your home. This application contains the main symbols found on clothing labels, along with their descriptions, to help you remember how to wash each garment effectively and precisely.
 Have you ever encountered a symbol on a care label that you didn't know what it meant? LaundryNotes allows you to store information for each garment, making it easy to remember how to wash your clothes.
 Did some symbols may fade away after washing an item? LaundryNotes is completely waterproof! The care instructions will remain on your smartphone.

To view or modify an existing item, simply click on it in the list. To delete an item, press and hold the symbol to open the deletion menu.

izzyondroid:su.comp.bk.name: BkEmu
izzyondroid:su.comp.bk.description:
BkEmu is an emulator of 16-bit PDP-11-compatible Soviet home computers Elektronika BK-0010/11M.
 Supported emulations: 
 BC-0010-01: without external blocks (Basik Vilnius), with the MSTD block (Focal + tests), with a 16KB DOS unit of CNGMD
 BK-0011M: with MSTD or KNGMD
 Emulated Hardware: 
 Processor K1801VM1 (basic set of commands, except those specific to HALT-mode)
 Video controller K1801VP1-037 (color and black-and-white modes, screen palettes)
 Keyboard controller K1801VP1-014
 Built-in timer K1801BE1
 Audio output (PCM, bit 6 in register 01777716)
 11M system timer (50 Hz vector 100 interrupt, bit 14 in register 01776662)
 Page memory 11M (bits 8-10, 12-14 in register 01777716)
 Standard six-button joystick on the parallel port
 Drive controller on flexible magnetic disks K1801VP1-128 (KNGMD, "read-only" mode)
 Supported formats: 
 The emulator supports loading and saving program images in KUVT-86 (.BIN) format by intercepting EMT 36 on the BK-0010 or system call .BMB10 on the BK-0011M format, as well as mounting images of floppy magnetic disks in the .IMG/.BKD (800 KB) format.

Dive into Politrics and master the art of strategic board gaming!

fdroid:net.koofr.vault.name: Koofr Vault
fdroid:net.koofr.vault.summary: Open source, client-side, zero-knowledge encrypted storage application by Koofr
fdroid:net.koofr.vault.description:
Koofr Vault is an open source, client-side, zero-knowledge encrypted storage application by Koofr. Unlock enhanced security for your files. Discover a better way to securely store and access your photos, videos and documents.
Included in all Koofr plans, even in the free one.
Start using Koofr Vault now to make your life more secure. First time users must create a free Koofr account. Access everything through the Koofr Vault mobile app for Android.
With Koofr Vault for Android you can:
• create new Safe Boxes,
• upload files or folders to your Safe Boxes,
• download your files to your phone or open them in different apps,
• take a photo and store it in your Safe Box,
• use biometrics to unlock Safe Boxes.
All Safe Box files are encrypted or decrypted by your device on demand as you access them.
Since your Safe Key, only known to you, is required to decrypt cloud content, only you can access the files.
Neither your Safe key nor any other unencrypted file data or metadata is sent to or stored by Koofr.
The cloud has never been safer!
Need help? Contact our support team at support@koofr.net.

fdroid:org.androidlabs.applistbackup.name: AppListBackup
fdroid:org.androidlabs.applistbackup.summary: Effortlessly create and manage backups of a list of your installed apps.
fdroid:org.androidlabs.applistbackup.description:
AppListBackup is the ultimate solution for generating a backup list of installed applications on your Android device.
This user-friendly app allows you to automatically create and view a backup list of all your installed apps with just a few taps.
Whether you want to safeguard your list of favorite apps or prepare for a device reset, AppListBackup ensures your apps list is securely backed up and ready to be viewed whenever you need it.
Key Features:
* Quickly create backup lists of installed apps with ease, including details such as: installation date, version number, package name, app icon and more.
* Export your backup lists in multiple formats including HTML, Markdown, and CSV to suit your needs. The HTML export includes powerful sorting and filtering capabilities.
* Control the maximum number of stored backups.
* Seamlessly integrate with Tasker, Automate, MacroDroid, and any other apps that support Tasker Plugin, allowing you to trigger backups from your automations.
* Trigger backups via Intent Broadcasts, enabling automation with tools like Tasker, ADB, and MacroDroid for even more flexibility.
* No account, no network access and no root. The app needs permission to see your installed apps and to write to the folder you choose; notifications are optional.
* Also includes an easy to click widget, notification bar progress updates, and more.
With AppListBackup, you can have peace of mind knowing an up to date list of your favorite apps is safely backed up. Download and install now to ensure your list of apps is always ready for restoration.
IMPORTANT: This app does not back up your actual application APKs or data, it only generates a list of installed applications and allows you to choose where to save it for future reference. Additionally it is the user's responsibility to save/backup the generated files to a safe location in the event their phone is broken or lost, such as, but not limited to, email, remote storage, or a local folder which is synced elsewhere.

flathub:de.scrylab.ScryLab.name: ScryLab
flathub:de.scrylab.ScryLab.description:
With ScryLab, data from a running Python environment or from measurement files can be explored
 in interactive plots for side-by-side comparison and analysis.
 It includes line, scatter, XY, frequency and spectrogram views, plus tools from simple operations
 like addition, derivative and integral to advanced analysis such as FFT and STFT, including moving
 averages and regression.
 Imports CSV and Excel tables with a guided import that detects time columns, plus MDF measurement
 files (.mf4, .mf3, .dat). HDF5 is ScryLab's own storage format; HDF5 files from other tools load
 as long as they contain plain 1-D signal datasets. A local REST API accepts signals from any programming
 environment or toolchain.
 Includes an optional AI assistant that can operate ScryLab. It comes with a free trial; further
 usage requires purchasing credits on the website or bringing your own API key / connecting via
 MCP.

flathub:im.pidgin.Pidgin.name: Pidgin

flathub:net.veloren.airshipper.summary: Airshipper is the official launcher for Veloren.
flathub:net.veloren.airshipper.description:
Airshipper is the official launcher for Veloren, the online voxel-based RPG.
 Veloren is a multiplayer open world, voxel-based RPG written in Rust. It is inspired
 by games such as Cube World, Minecraft, Dwarf Fortress and Breath of the Wild.
 Veloren's development mainly happens on the official Discord server (https://discord.gg/kjwJwjK).
 New contributors are always welcome!

flathub:org.audacityteam.Audacity.name: Audacity
flathub:org.audacityteam.Audacity.summary: Audacity is the world's most popular audio editing and recording app
flathub:org.audacityteam.Audacity.description:
Audacity is the world's most popular audio editing and recording app.
 You can use Audacity to:
 Record live audio
 Convert tapes and records into digital recordings or CDs
 Edit WAV, AIFF, FLAC, MP2, MP3 or Ogg Vorbis sound files
 Cut, copy, splice or mix sounds together
 Change the speed or pitch of a recording
 Apply a wide range of other effects to audio recordings
 and much more!

flathub:org.gnome.Recipes.name: Recipes
flathub:org.gnome.Recipes.description:
Recipes is an easy-to-use application that will help you to discover what to cook
 today, tomorrow, the rest of the week and for your special occasions.
 Recipes comes with a collection of recipes that have been collected by GNOME contributors
 from all over the world. It also lets you store your own recipes and share them with your
 friends.
 The major features of Recipes include:
 Add and edit your own recipes
 Share recipes with your friends
 Export and print shopping lists
 Adjust quantities based on the number of servings
 Mark recipes to cook later or add them to your favorites
 Add notes to recipes
 Hands-free cooking instruction mode

flathub:org.gnome.Shotwell.name: Shotwell
flathub:org.gnome.Shotwell.description:
Shotwell is an easy-to-use, fast photo organizer designed for the GNOME desktop. It allows you
 to import photos from your camera or disk, organize them by date and subject matter, even ratings.
 It also offers basic photo editing, like crop, red-eye correction, color adjustments, and straighten.
 Shotwell’s non-destructive photo editor does not alter your master photos, making it easy to experiment
 and correct errors.
 When ready, Shotwell can upload your photos to various web services, such as Flickr, Google
 Photos, and more.
 Shotwell supports JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and a variety of RAW file formats.

flathub:org.kde.kbackup.name: KBackup
flathub:org.kde.kbackup.summary: Create backups as .tar files to a local folder or remote URL
flathub:org.kde.kbackup.description:
KBackup is an application which lets you back up your data in a simple, user friendly way
 Features:
 Using profile files with definitions for Folders and files to be included or excluded from
 the backup
 The backup target can be either a locally mounted device like a ZIP drive, USB stick, etc.
 or any remote URL
 Running automated backups without using a graphical user interface

flathub:org.kde.kwrite.name: KWrite
flathub:org.kde.kwrite.description:
KWrite is a text editor by KDE, based on the Kate's editor component.

 Auto-indentation
 Plugin support

flathub:org.kde.optiimage.name: OptiImage
flathub:org.kde.optiimage.summary: Image optimizer to reduce the size of images
flathub:org.kde.optiimage.description:
Optimize your images with OptiImage, a useful image compressor that supports PNG, JPEG, WebP
 and SVG file types.
 It supports both lossless and lossy compression modes with an option whether to keep or not
 metadata of images. It additionally has a safe mode, where a new image is created instead of overwriting
 the old one.
 It uses the following tools:
 oxipng for PNG images
 jpegoptim for JPEG images
 scour for SVG images
 cwebp for WebP images

flathub:pro.saladin.Eeman.name: Eeman

Compatible with the JavaScript EventSource API. * Accept Override Override the Accept header in a request. Special handling for the _accept query parameter (which is used throughout WAI override the Accept header). * Add Headers WAI Middleware for adding arbitrary headers to an HTTP request. * Clean Path Clean a request path to a canonical form. * Combine Headers Combine duplicate headers into one. * GZip Compression Negotiate HTTP payload gzip compression. * Health check endpoint Add an empty health check endpoint. * HTTP Basic Authentication WAI Basic Authentication Middleware which uses Authorization header. * JSONP "JSON with Padding" middleware. Automatic wrapping of JSON responses to convert into JSONP. * Method Override / Post Allows overriding of the HTTP request method via the _method query string parameter. * Request Logging Request logging middleware for development and production environments * Request Rewrite Rewrite request path info based on a custom conversion rules. * Select Dynamically choose between Middlewares. * Stream Files Convert ResponseFile type responses into ResponseStream type. * Virtual Host Redirect incoming requests to a new host based on custom rules.

firefox-addons:2867673.summary: Turbocharge lichess.org with a ton of features
firefox-addons:2867673.description:
This extension adds a lot of extra functionality to the https://lichess.org web site.
Main features:
 Extended Interactive Lessons allow you to play ALL variations
 Explorer Practice allows you to play against the moves in Opening Explorer, essentially helping you train against any rating bracket on the Internet or a specific opponent
 local computer analysis chart when no server one exists, even when not logged in
 Enhanced PGN Import in Analysis board allows you to merge multiple PGNs into a single one (lichess limitations strip down the comments, but I am working on a solution). This helps you quickly collect a player's repertoire and maybe save it as a study Interactive Lesson, simulating their play. Then you can export the current analysis moves into separate lines as well, or just copy a single branch as a PGN.
 See evaluation of possible moves of the selected piece in analysis
 Automatic detection of interesting/brilliant/good/best moves
 a PGN editor supporting a lot of operations and accepting tens of megabytes of text
 Mobile device features (for browsers that support extensions on mobile, like Kiwi), including drawing arrows and circles on mobile, scroll/zoom lock while playing, etc.
 Change the friends box into a menu or a button, live update Friends page,
 Sound and voice notifications where players you follow start playing (with mutable option per player)
 TV enhancements: Current games section for players you follow and streamers, menu to go to previously opened games, previous two games in player TV just like in category TV
 Ctrl-right/left to play a random move from the available ones in the list. This also works for moves coming from transposing positions
 Extra context menus for Analysis/Study move list. One allows you to copy the current branch as a PGN. Another will use add comments with the computer evaluation to the terminating moves in all branches
 Show player country flags and game opening names
 Custom chat buttons when playing
There are many more. Here is a comprehensive list, in the order of implementation:
 randomly play one of the next moves with Ctrl-RightArrow configurable probability to play a move by putting prc:<number> in the move comment, where number is a percentage between 1 and 100
 highlights for the last move of variations in the analysis/study board also showing which of the last moves that have not ended in mate have no comment
 highlights the transpositions to the current move in the analysis/study board also an option to show all transpositions in the PGN
 play multiple variations in Interactive lesson mode in the same chapter! (using the prc: notations if present)
 automatically open/hide/convert to menu the Friends box at page load
 sound alert when one of your friends starts playing a game (for various time controls)
 changing the shortcut for playing the next best computer move from Space to Ctrl-Space
 a minimum chess engine level (if it is idle in a lower state, it runs until it gets to that level)
 sticky Interactive lesson Preview mode (remains in Preview when switching between chapters)

 import multiple PGNs in analysis mode and merge them into one

 Move list options: indented variations shows all variations as tree branches, not inline
 Move list options: bookmarks allows tagging variations with a label, collapse/expand them, link to them, split chapter by them, open another window with just the analysis tools (move list, explorer, computer eval)
 Option to not see cloud values in computer evaluation

firefox-addons:649712.summary: The LRT Power*Trust metric helps you evaluate the quality and trustworthiness of a domain or page you are currently visiting.
firefox-addons:649712.description:
Ever since Google announced that they would not update PageRank anymore, SEOs and webmasters from all around the world are looking for the best replacement. 
LinkResearchTools developed the perfect alternative for Google’s toolbar PageRank: the LRT Power*Trust Extension.
LRT Power*Trust (previously known as CEMPER Power*Trust) is a unique metric that measures the overall quality of a page or domain.
LinkResearchTools launched this metric shortly after the first Google Penguin update in 2012. 
By looking at the LRT Power*Trust metric, you can quickly answer the most important SEO questions: 
• is it ok to build this link on this site?
• is this link worth keeping? 
• which links should go to the disavow file?
If you already have an active LinkResearchTools or Link Detox account, there’s no need to sign up. You can simply sign in with your LinkResearchTools or Link Detox credentials.
Use the LRT Power*Trust extension and give it a good rating if you like it.
Christoph C. Cemper
and the team of
LinkResearchTools

bluejetty:00018820:ios.description:
Thirrrsty is the simplest and most beautiful way to track your daily water intake. It was designed to ensure you are able to log water in the most convenient manner to you. Thirrrsty integrates with the Health app on your phone to ensure all your health data is available in one place. You can even ask Siri to record your water intake. You can also add a widget to the Home Screen to quickly see your water intake throughout the day.
Key features:
- Set and track goals easily
- Schedule reminders to make sure you are on top of your goals
- Log water intake through notifications
- Home Screen widget to quickly see and update your water intake
- Record a personalized phrase, and you'll be able to log your water intake simply by asking Siri
- Dark mode support
- Sync progress across devices with iCloud
- Health app integration
Watch app features:
- Completely independent app
- Set goals directly on your watch
- Schedule reminders to make sure you are on top of your goals
- Lets you track your daily intake easily on your wrist
- Complication for quickly glancing at your progress
- See your past seven day history

bluejetty:00184239:ios.description:
APP DESCRIPTION:
The Carolina Bank SC App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Carolina Bank & Trust customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Carolina Bank SC App, you must be enrolled as a Carolina Bank & Trust Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

Download the District Direct app today and get benefits at your fingertips!

bluejetty:00138791:ios.description:
**Rope Hero Town: Mafia Crime – Save the City from Chaos!** 
Welcome to **Rope Hero Town: Mafia Crime**, an open-world action game where you take on the role of a powerful rope-wielding hero! The city is under siege by ruthless mafia gangs, and only you can bring justice to the streets. Use your superhuman abilities, swing across skyscrapers, battle dangerous criminals, and become the ultimate crime-fighter! 
** Action-Packed Open-World Gameplay** 
Explore a vast urban environment filled with crime, chaos, and high-stakes battles. Take on thrilling missions, engage in **explosive street fights**, and prove that you're the true protector of the city! 
** Take Down the Mafia Lords** 
Crime bosses and gangsters are taking over, and the police can’t stop them. It’s up to you to clean up the city! Fight against mafia syndicates, eliminate gang hideouts, and stop illegal activities before it’s too late. 
** Superhero Abilities & Weapons** 
 Use your **rope powers** to swing between buildings and chase criminals. 
 Perform **high-speed stunts** and aerial attacks. 
 Unlock powerful **weapons, melee combat moves, and vehicles**. 
Upgrade your hero to enhance **strength, speed, and durability**. 
** Drive, Fight, and Explore** 
Steal and drive a variety of **cars, bikes, and even tanks**! 
Engage in epic **street chases** and high-speed pursuits. 
Use special hero vehicles to dominate the battlefield. 
** Exciting Missions & Challenges** 
Take on **dangerous quests**, eliminate enemy hideouts, and battle rival gangsters in a **series of action-packed missions**. The fate of the city is in your hands! 
** Features:** 
 Open-world city full of action and adventure. 
Dynamic missions and **intense combat**. 
Realistic physics and **smooth controls**. 
 Tons of weapons, vehicles, and power-ups. 
Stunning 3D graphics and immersive sound effects. 
**Are You Ready to Become the Ultimate Rope Hero?** 
The city needs a **real superhero** to restore peace. Are you up for the challenge? Download **Rope Hero Town: Mafia Crime** now and swing into action!

bluejetty:00200182:ios.summary:
Claude Duet is available through a waitlist. Before you download, check that you've received our email saying your account has access. If you haven't, join the waitlist at claude.com/product/claude-duet.
WAKE UP KNOWING WHAT NEEDS YOUR ATT
bluejetty:00200182:ios.description:
Claude Duet is available through a waitlist. Before you download, check that you've received our email saying your account has access. If you haven't, join the waitlist at claude.com/product/claude-duet.
WAKE UP KNOWING WHAT NEEDS YOUR ATTENTION
Each morning, Claude Duet looks across your email and calendar and brings you the few things that need a decision or a reply. It provides context on each one, so you have what you need to decide right there. Where it can, it has a draft ready for you to review. Through the day, it checks your connected accounts every few hours and flags what's gone quiet, like a client email you haven't answered in a few days.
HAND IT OFF
Ask in a chat or add a task. Claude Duet gets going, sends you updates as it works, and tells you when it needs your review.
GET THINGS MADE FROM A SINGLE MESSAGE
Describe what you need in one message. It comes back as work you can check, like a brief, research, or a draft.
YOU HAVE THE FINAL SAY
Claude Duet waits for your okay before it sends, posts, pays, or deletes anything. It works with the apps you've connected to Claude, and you can disconnect any of them at any time.
ORGANIZE BY CHANNEL
Keep each part of your work in its own channel, like one for finance and one for hiring. Claude Duet can read across all of them, so it keeps the whole picture.
THE CLAUDE YOU KNOW
Claude Duet runs on your Claude account, with your memory, skills, and connected apps like Gmail and Google Calendar there from the first message.
IT KEEPS WORKING
Claude Duet works in the background even after you close the app. It will let you know when it's done or needs your approval.
TALK IT THROUGH
When you'd rather talk than type, hold to talk or have a spoken conversation.
WHAT TO EXPECT
We built Claude Duet for work, so it's weaker at personal errands. It can make mistakes, including about what's urgent. Emails and web pages written by other people can contain hidden instructions meant to mislead it. Claude Duet is built to resist these, but review what it shows you before you approve. Because it checks every few hours, something urgent can arrive between checks. Learn more at support.claude.com/en/articles/17631495.
HOW TO GET ACCESS
Join the waitlist at claude.com/product/claude-duet. We'll be adding people gradually, and we'll email you when your account has access. Please note, signing into the app doesn't add you to the waitlist.

bluejetty:00032983:ios.description:
Join your Facebook friends and millions of players worldwide in this addictive adventure game. Build bridges, attack and raid your way from island to island, to travel through tons of unique villages to earn coin and build your pirate kingdom to the top! 
Are you brave to defeat pirate attacks, to master island challenges, or to steal coins from other pirates? Play any role you like as island king. Become a master of coin who holds billions of coins and rule the realm!
You can explore many beautiful islands in this online multiplayer game! Let's go! You will become a rich coin master to build and explore beautiful villages by winning coins from spins, attack and raids. If you're looking for a casual, adventure, multiplayer, or coin game, Pirate Kingdom - Coin Rush is a game you can't miss! Here is what you could do to be the coin master:
BUILD BRIDGES TO EARN COIN!
Build bridges to earn tons of coins, attack and raid. Shield your islands and coins from other players' attacks. Build your own pirate kingdom and explore new villages and islands to compete with friends, and become the next coin master in this social pirate adventure game!
UNLOCK MANY MATEYS
Explore the islands in this pirate adventure game and unlock many new mateys. You can select any matey you like to travel with you from island to island. Every matey is an unique character and will make your pirate voyage full of fun.
ATTACK & RAID PIRATES!
Attack or raid friends and other players from around the world to get enough treasure to build your villages and islands. Take revenge on those who have attacked your islands! You never know what treasure you can find in someone else's villages and islands!
PLAY WITH YOUR FACEBOOK FRIENDS!
Pirate adventures are even more fun with your friends: the more friends you have, the better you will raid, so invite them all! For the best multiplayer game experience, invite fellow pirates and your Facebook friends for even more coins, and become the greatest pirate captain of all your friends!
HOW TO PLAY PIRATE KINGDOM - COIN RUSH？
- Tap and hold to build a bridge.
- Release to drop the bridge onto the adjacent island. Hold for the perfect duration to earn extra rewards.
- Earn gold coins, attack and raid from each successful bridge.
- Join friends and players from all over the world online in this battle.
- Simple and addictive gameplay, casual multiplaye

bluejetty:00022609:ios.description:
Design your own chart for your craft project!
StitchSketch was developed by a creator of the popular software program "KG-Chart for Cross Stitch".
This mobile version utilizes intuitive "touch" user interface of mobile devices.
Features includes:
- Design your own chart for craft works such as:
 Cross Stitch (Crossstitch), Bead Weaving, Iron Beads (Perler(R) Beads), Knitting pattern, Color Knitting, Pixel Art, and more!
- This is also suited for drawing "dotted" pictures (Pixel Art), such as icons in low resolution
- Convert your photo into a chart
- Draw chart with a symbol in a cell
- Maximum chart size is 250 x 250
- Pixel & Vector Drawing (Backstitch, Fractional Stitch, Hardanger)
- Pinch to zoom
- Generic color palette and Color Charts (palette) for: DMC(R), DFT, COSMO, Delica, Toho Best, Perler(R) Beads
- Knitting Symbols (Amizu Kigou (JIS)) for designing knitting pattern
- Rectangular cell size
- Real view to simulate finished image
- Undo / Redo 
- Drawing tools: Pencil, Rectangle, Ellipse, Flood Fill, Text
- Selecting Tool: Selection and Cut/Copy/Paste/Rotate/Flip/Stamp
- Edit colors and symbols
- Save or Email a chart as native format or PNG image
- Generate a chart in PDF for emailing or printing.
- Organize charts with thumbnails
- Support Dropbox
- Notes: The chart file is not compatible with KG-Chart (win) right now.
*** User's Manual / Tutorials are here:
http://www.iktsoft.net/kgchart-en/StitchSketch/manual

“An easy to use App that really helps my shopping.” – Tom H.
BuyVia was founded by Professional Shopper Norman Fong. Creator of the first deal site, Techbargains.
How To Scan Barcodes
To scan a Barcode or QR code simply open the app, point the camera, and it will be quickly scanned. It will automatically recognize any Barcode or QR code.
When scanning a QR code, if the code contains a website, you will see it and optionally launch it securely. If the QR code contains text, email addresses, etc, you'll see it.
Coupons and Deals
You will have access to a selection of the latest discounts, deals, coupons, and special promo codes from thousands of well known national and local stores that change based on your location.
• Find and compare prices on items from your favorite stores like Amazon, Target, Walmart, Best Buy, and more
• Price match items when shopping
• Turn on your light for scanning in low-light
How is the Price Scanner better than other Scanning Apps?
• Price Scanner Supports many barcode formats including UPC, EAN, EAN-13, Code 128, Code 93, Code 39, Interleaved 2 of 5, CODABAR
Other ways Scan and Shop can help: 
•Save all your scanning history to your Shopping List, which is synchronized across multiple devices and the Web
•Connect with Facebook, Twitter, Text, or Email to share your favorite products with others
•Supports the latest iPhones, iPads, and iOS; and on the web at BuyVia.com
We value feedback! If you have an issue with the app, do not leave a review, immediately contact us at BuyVia.com
===
How is Price Scanner different than the Apple Camera App?
Price Scanner can scan many types of barcodes including UPCs and also QR Codes. Camera App only scans QR Codes.
How is Price Scanner better at scanning QR Codes than the Apple Camera App?
Price Scanner can scan QR Codes and show you the entire link and either go to the link or cancel. You can look for spammy links and abort going to them. Camera App only shows a small part of the link.
Is Price Scanner a Free app?
Yes, Price Scanner is free. You do not need to create an account. It is an ad supported app with an in-app purchase option to remove ads.
What happens when a UPC isn't found?
Price Scanner matches UPC's to products from its database of millions of items that is updated daily. If the UPC is not found, you will be show its number and given options to search Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and Google for it.
Privacy. Do you keep user scan data?
We do not retain user data that connects a person to scanning particular products.

Free App! Easily Scan ANY Barcode / QR Code or search to quickly find the BEST price. Download NOW.

Not designed to scan items under $10, groceries, alcohol, or tobacco.

“Wow, this app quick scanned and found lower prices, saving me a bundle.” – Jamie R.
“An easy to use App that really helps my shopping.” – Tom H.

BuyVia was founded by Professional Shopper Norman Fong. Creator of the first deal site, Techbargains.

How To Scan Barcodes

To scan a Barcode or QR code simply open the app, point the camera, and it will be quickly scanned. It will automatically recognize any Barcode or QR code.
When scanning a QR code, if the code contains a website, you will see it and optionally launch it securely. If the QR code contains text, email addresses, etc, you'll see it.

Coupons and Deals

You will have access to a selection of the latest discounts, deals, coupons, and special promo codes from thousands of well known national and local stores that change based on your location.

• Find and compare prices on items from your favorite stores like Amazon, Target, Walmart, Best Buy, and more
• Price match items when shopping
• Turn on your light for scanning in low-light

How is the Price Scanner better than other Scanning Apps?
• Price Scanner Supports many barcode formats including UPC, EAN, EAN-13, Code 128, Code 93, Code 39, Interleaved 2 of 5, CODABAR

Other ways Scan and Shop can help: 
•Save all your scanning history to your Shopping List, which is synchronized across multiple devices and the Web
•Connect with Facebook, Twitter, Text, or Email to share your favorite products with others
•Supports the latest iPhones, iPads, and iOS; and on the web at BuyVia.com

We value feedback! If you have an issue with the app, do not leave a review, immediately contact us at BuyVia.com

How is Price Scanner different than the Apple Camera App?
Price Scanner can scan many types of barcodes including UPCs and also QR Codes. Camera App only scans QR Codes.

How is Price Scanner better at scanning QR Codes than the Apple Camera App?
Price Scanner can scan QR Codes and show you the entire link and either go to the link or cancel. You can look for spammy links and abort going to them. Camera App only shows a small part of the link.

Is Price Scanner a Free app?
Yes, Price Scanner is free. You do not need to create an account. It is an ad supported app with an in-app purchase option to remove ads.

What happens when a UPC isn't found?
Price Scanner matches UPC's to products from its database of millions of items that is updated daily. If the UPC is not found, you will be show its number and given options to search Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and Google for it.

Privacy. Do you keep user scan data?
We do not retain user data that connects a person to scanning particular products.

bluejetty:00169637:ios.description:
Step into a world where everything's changed – zombies everywhere, and surviving is your only goal. 'Merge 2 Survive' isn't just any game. It's an epic journey where strategic thinking meets puzzle-solving excitement.
Meet Mia, brave and unstoppable, on a mission to find out what happened to her dad in a city swallowed by the apocalypse. Get ready to wade into zombie-infested war zones, remnants of a world that once buzzed with life. Every merge you make isn't just a move; it's a pivotal moment in Mia's story. You're crafting weapons, putting together defenses, and bringing people together to hold off the relentless undead.
This destroyed city's waiting for you to explore it. Unravel its secrets, track down the clues, and maybe you'll find what happened to Mia's father. But remember, 'Merge 2 Survive' isn't just about combining stuff. It's about forging a path in a world where order's been flipped upside down. Show off your strategic chops by mixing and matching vital resources, ensuring your allies don't just survive – they thrive.
Features:
- Merge & Craft: It's all about mixing and matching here. Find items and combine them to create weapons, defenses, and anything else you need to stand strong against a sea of zombies.
- Strategic Gameplay: Every choice counts. Hone your strategic skills to outwit the challenges that lie ahead on your journey.
- Epic Exploration: Immerse yourself in a city that's seen better days. Explore every nook and cranny, and uncover the mysteries of a world overrun by zombies.
- Survivor's Saga: It's up to you to gather survivors, rebuild what's been lost, and lead the charge against the undead. In a world plunged into darkness, you're the light of hope.
Ready for an adventure that'll keep you on the edge of your seat? Merge, scout, and battle your way to shine a light in a world taken over by zombies. In 'Merge 2 Survive', it's all about what it truly means to survive. Step into Mia's shoes and face the challenges head-on! Every merge you make is a stride towards hope, every fight a test of your determination. The fight against the undead is here. So, are you up for it?
Have a problem? Want to suggest a cool new feature? Send your feedback to Pixodust Games. We love to hear from our players! support@pixodust.com
Be sure to check for updates. We're always working on ways of improving gameplay and adding new content!

Show off your strategic chops by mixing and matching vital resources, ensuring your allies don't just survive – they thrive.

- Strategic Gameplay: Every choice counts. Hone your strategic skills to outwit the challenges that lie ahead on your journey.

- Epic Exploration: Immerse yourself in a city that's seen better days. Explore every nook and cranny, and uncover the mysteries of a world overrun by zombies.

- Survivor's Saga: It's up to you to gather survivors, rebuild what's been lost, and lead the charge against the undead. In a world plunged into darkness, you're the light of hope.

Ready for an adventure that'll keep you on the edge of your seat? Merge, scout, and battle your way to shine a light in a world taken over by zombies. In 'Merge 2 Survive', it's all about what it truly means to survive. Step into Mia's shoes and face the challenges head-on! Every merge you make is a stride towards hope, every fight a test of your determination. The fight against the undead is here. So, are you up for it?

bluejetty:00075133:ios.name: aWallet Cloud Password Manager
bluejetty:00075133:ios.summary:
• Securely stores your passwords, credit card information, e-banking credentials, web accounts and other custom data.
• Synchronizes encrypted data with the Cloud: Dropbox or Google Drive.
• There is a built in Editor for changing or creati
bluejetty:00075133:ios.description:
• Securely stores your passwords, credit card information, e-banking credentials, web accounts and other custom data.
• Synchronizes encrypted data with the Cloud: Dropbox or Google Drive.
• There is a built in Editor for changing or creating new data Categories.
• Search within fields.
• Contains no advertisements.
• One time payment - forever.
• Supports backup and restore of the encrypted data file to the iTunes File Sharing folder.
• Export of unencrypted data in CSV format to the iTunes File Sharing folder.
• There is an Auto lock feature that can be preconfigured for a specific period of time.
PRO FEATURES, included:
• Cloud synchronization
• Unlock with Face ID
• Unlock with Touch ID
• Password Generator
• CSV Import
SECURITY FEATURES
• All data is encrypted, including Entry names, Category definitions and the data itself.
• Encrypts data using AES or Blowfish algorithms with key sizes of 256, 192 or 128 bits.
• When the data file is decrypted, up to all combinations of algorithm and key size are tried with the Master password to unlock the data file. The app itself does not store any hint to the actual cipher or key size.
• Uses a randomly generated 'salt' combined with the Master password. Salt helps to protect from off-line dictionary attacks.
• The key to open the data file is created by combining your master password with the 512-bit 'salt'. The result is hashed 1000 times by SHA-256. Repetitive hashing makes a brute force attack more difficult.
• Supports auto destruction of the data file after a predefined number of unsuccessful unlocks have been tried.
For more info see http://www.awallet.org/
If you like this App, rate it in the App Store. If you have any suggestions, just let me know.

bluejetty:00183213:ios.description:
► MAIS DE 200 MIL RECEITAS
Do petisco à sobremesa, você encontra no app do TudoGostoso mais de 200.000 receitas testadas e aprovadas para todos os paladares e ocasiões. E não para por aí: aqui você tira dúvidas de cozinha, aprende truques de culinária e ganha muita inspiração de cardápio para as suas refeições e eventos. E o melhor é que é tudo muito fácil de fazer!
- Bolos e tortas doces
- Carnes
- Aves
- Peixes e frutos do mar
- Saladas, molhos e acompanhamentos
- Sopas
- Massas
- Bebidas
- Doces e sobremesas
- Lanches
- Prato Único
- Light
- Rápidas
► RECEITAS FAVORITAS
Sinta-se um chefe e crie seu livro de receitas marcando aquelas que você mais gosta como Favoritas. Assim, ficará muito mais fácil organizar e fazer suas tarefas na cozinha, além de ter sempre disponível (mesmo offline!) a receita daquele prato que é sucesso garantido!
► BUSCAR POR RECEITAS E INGREDIENTES
Você também pode usar a ferramenta de busca para diversificar sua alimentação, encontrar aquela receita especial, saudável ou gastar pouco em uma receita barata com ingredientes que estão na sua geladeira.
► CANAIS ESPECIAIS
Inspire-se nas seleções de receitas, fotos de empratamento, dicas e sugestões de produtos em nossos canais especiais e encontre ideias para o dia a dia e grandes festas como Natal e Páscoa.
► OPINIÕES E DÚVIDAS
Confira os comentários de quem já testou os pratos e compartilhou suas experiências. Você também pode enviar sua opinião ou tirar dúvidas e aprender a cozinhar com nossa equipe de revisores.
► COMPARTILHE NAS REDES SOCIAIS
O TudoGostoso possui a opção de envio de receita por e-mail e mensagem. Também é possível compartilhar a foto da receita que você preparou no Facebook e Instagram!
► RECEITAS PARA A CULTURA DA SUA REGIÃO
Altere as receitas e o idioma sempre que desejar. Esta opção pode ser encontrada na última aba da barra inferior do app. Cada região possui suas próprias receitas e esta alteração exigirá que você entre com uma conta correspondente à região selecionada.
► É GRÁTIS (FREE APPS)
Não perca tempo, instale o aplicativo de receitas e culinária mais completo do Brasil!
“TudoGostoso. As receitas que todo mundo faz”

bluejetty:00037168:ios.description:
Build a fantasy world you can organize, visualize, and actually explore.
Summon Worlds brings worldbuilding, character creation, and AI roleplaying together for writers, worldbuilders, game masters, and tabletop RPG players. Create connected characters, Creatures, locations, maps, and lore, then explore your setting through character chat and interactive adventures.
Free to start, with optional in-app purchases. No ads, ever.
BUILD A CONNECTED WORLD
Create characters, Creatures, locations, factions, weapons, items, spells, and lore. Connect the people, places, and ideas behind your stories so you can keep building without scattering everything across separate notes.
Use custom categories to organize your creations your way, and customize how your world is presented.
MAP THE PLACES YOU IMAGINE
Create and edit maps with the World Map editor. Give your fantasy setting a visual home alongside its characters, locations, and history.
DEVELOP CHARACTERS AND RELATIONSHIPS
Build character profiles with backstories, personalities, classes, alignments, stats, and artwork.
Define friendships, rivalries, romances, family bonds, and alliances. Keep these connections alongside the lore that gives them meaning.
Chat with your characters to explore their voices, personalities, relationships, and story possibilities.
CREATE WITH AI
Generate artwork and visual references for your characters, locations, and worlds. Develop names, descriptions, backstories, and lore when you want help moving an idea forward.
Choose from AI models for image generation, character chat, and adventures while shaping the results around your creative vision.
STEP INSIDE WITH ADVENTURE MODE
Play as one of your characters in an interactive, AI-guided RPG adventure. An AI game master narrates the story, responds to your decisions, and draws from your world's characters, locations, relationships, and lore.
Explore an open-ended adventure or begin with a structured quest, premise, and goal. Adjust story pacing, response length, and suggested actions to suit the experience you want.
BUILD SOLO OR COLLABORATE
Develop your world privately, publish creations when you're ready, or invite collaborators into a Shared World to build together.
Explore worlds and creations from the community for inspiration.
MADE FOR YOUR NEXT STORY
Plan a fantasy novel, prepare a tabletop campaign, develop an original character, or explore a world of your own creation. Keep your ideas connected as your universe grows.
Download Summon Worlds and start building your next world.

listings.name: Summon Worlds: AI RPG Worlds
listings.description:
Build a fantasy world you can organize, visualize, and actually explore.

Summon Worlds brings worldbuilding, character creation, and AI roleplaying together for writers, worldbuilders, game masters, and tabletop RPG players. Create connected characters, Creatures, locations, maps, and lore, then explore your setting through character chat and interactive adventures.

Free to start, with optional in-app purchases. No ads, ever.

BUILD A CONNECTED WORLD

Create characters, Creatures, locations, factions, weapons, items, spells, and lore. Connect the people, places, and ideas behind your stories so you can keep building without scattering everything across separate notes.

Use custom categories to organize your creations your way, and customize how your world is presented.

MAP THE PLACES YOU IMAGINE

Create and edit maps with the World Map editor. Give your fantasy setting a visual home alongside its characters, locations, and history.

DEVELOP CHARACTERS AND RELATIONSHIPS

Build character profiles with backstories, personalities, classes, alignments, stats, and artwork.

Define friendships, rivalries, romances, family bonds, and alliances. Keep these connections alongside the lore that gives them meaning.

Chat with your characters to explore their voices, personalities, relationships, and story possibilities.

CREATE WITH AI

Generate artwork and visual references for your characters, locations, and worlds. Develop names, descriptions, backstories, and lore when you want help moving an idea forward.

Choose from AI models for image generation, character chat, and adventures while shaping the results around your creative vision.

STEP INSIDE WITH ADVENTURE MODE

Play as one of your characters in an interactive, AI-guided RPG adventure. An AI game master narrates the story, responds to your decisions, and draws from your world's characters, locations, relationships, and lore.

Explore an open-ended adventure or begin with a structured quest, premise, and goal. Adjust story pacing, response length, and suggested actions to suit the experience you want.

BUILD SOLO OR COLLABORATE

Develop your world privately, publish creations when you're ready, or invite collaborators into a Shared World to build together.

Explore worlds and creations from the community for inspiration.

MADE FOR YOUR NEXT STORY

Plan a fantasy novel, prepare a tabletop campaign, develop an original character, or explore a world of your own creation. Keep your ideas connected as your universe grows.

Download Summon Worlds and start building your next world.

bluejetty:00013910:ios.description:
The most intelligent scanner app
Trusted by 300M+ users
CamScanner is an all-in-one scanner app. It turns your mobile device into a powerful portable scanner that recognizes text automatically (OCR) and improves your productivity to save your time. Download this scanner app for free to instantly scan, save, and share any document in PDF, JPG, Word, or TXT formats.
Would you like to keep your entire office in your pocket and increase your productivity at work? Use the CamScanner scanner app to handle your paperwork with ease. Say goodbye to huge and heavy copy machines and get this ultra-fast scanner app for free now.
DOCUMENT SCANNER
This free-of-charge yet powerful scanner app is a must-have for students and anyone involved in business: accountants, realtors, managers, or lawyers. With this PDF scanner, scan anything you need, receipts, contracts, paper notes, fax papers, books, and store your scans as multipage PDF or JPG files.
VARIOUS SCANNING MODES
–ID CARD & PASSPORT: A mode specifically designed for fast and convenient scans of ID documents.
–QR CODE: Scan any QR code with the camera on your mobile device.
PDF CONVERTER
–PDF Converter: This PDF scanner enables you to create PDF from a website, and convert documents in multiple formats to PDF.
–Supported file formats: PDF, JPG, DOC, DOCX, TXT, XLS, XLSM, XLSX, CVS, PPT, PPTM, PPTX.
SHARE AND COLLABORATE
–Share files for commenting or viewing in WhatsApp, iMessage, Microsoft Teams.
–Collect comments from multiple people in one file online.
–Speed document reviews by responding to each other's comments.
–Receive activity notifications for the files you share.
INNOVATIVE PDF SCANNER
–Scan documents and photos to PDF, JPG, or TXT.
–Easily scan multiple pages into one document.
–Extract text from any scannable object with text recognition (OCR).
–Create and add your own e-signature on documents.
HANDY DOCUMENT EDITOR & FILE MANAGER
–Edit scans with filters and the feature of noise removal.
–Manage files with folders, drag & drop to reorder, and enjoy other document editing features.
–Protect your confidential scans by locking folders and files with passwords.
EASILY SEND DOCUMENT
–Scan, save and send documents in just a few taps.
–Email with attachments or send document links.
–Upload scanned documents to cloud services like Dropbox, Google Drive, Evernote, and OneDrive.
–Print PDF files, such as contracts and invoices, right from the scanner app.
–Send files quickly and securely. Scanning or sharing is achieved with no intervention from the CamScanner scanner app team or any third party. Documents are safely stored on your mobile devices.
UNLIMITED ACCESS MEMBERSHIP SUBSCRIPTION
–You can subscribe to get unlimited access to all features of the scanner app.
–Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, quarterly, or annually at the rate based on the subscription plan.
–Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
–Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
–Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. The cost depends on the selected plan.
–Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
–Any unused portion of the free trial will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
For Terms of Use, please visit
https://www.camscanner.com/app/service?language=en-us

bluejetty:00065691:ios.description:
Trusted by millions of Muslims who rely upon Scan Halal everyday. The most informative source on halal food products. 
Scan Halal is largest halal foods organization bringing transparency to the halal food industry and providing valuable and much-needed information readily available at their fingertips to make better informed halal dietary choices. Scan Halal was born out of frustration with reading through all the long worded hard to pronounce time consuming ingredients that so many of us muslims struggle with every day. 
We handle the complicated stuff, so you don't have to. Simply scan the barcode (UPC/EAN) of the product you wish to consume and within seconds our app will breakdown the sources of ingredients (plant, animal, synthetic, etc) and display the halal status. Our app service is trusted by millions of muslims and other halal consumers who rely upon Scan Halal everyday.
Made by the team at scanhalal.org. There’s lots of work that goes on behind the scenes, working around the clock at Scan Halal to make sure things are running smoothly. Our team of food technologists, nutritionist, and auditors have a strong understanding in food matters and a wealth of industry experience that work endlessly to serve both the Muslim community and Halal Certification Industry.
To learn more, you can also visit scanhalal.org
This app currently supports U.S.A & Canada Products.
U.K, France, & Germany release coming soon!
Terms of Use: https://scanhalal.com/pages/terms.html

bluejetty:00042625:ios:1.name: Kingshot
bluejetty:00042625:ios:1.summary: The Ultimate Medieval Strategy Idle Game!
bluejetty:00042625:ios:1.description:
Kingshot is an innovative idle medieval survival game that combines strategic gameplay with rich details waiting to be explored.
When a sudden rebellion overturns the fate of an entire dynasty and ignites a devastating war, countless people lose their homes. In a world riddled with societal collapse, rebel invasions, rampant disease, and mobs desperate for resources, survival is the ultimate challenge. As a governor in these turbulent times, it's up to you to lead your people through these adversities, devising internal and diplomatic strategies to rekindle the spark of civilization.
[Core Features]
Defend Against Invasions
Stay vigilant and ready to repel invasions at any moment. Your town, the last bastion of hope, depends on it. Gather resources, upgrade your defenses, and prepare for battle to ensure survival in these tough times.
Manage Human Resources
Enjoy a unique gameplay mechanic involving the allocation of survivor roles such as workers, hunters, and chefs. Monitor their health and happiness to ensure they remain productive. Respond quickly to illness to make sure everyone receives timely treatment.
Establish Laws
Codes of law are vital for sustaining civilization and are crucial for the growth and strength of your town.
[Strategic Gameplay]
Resource Struggle
Amidst the sudden state collapse, the continent is flooded with untapped resources. Refugees, rebels, and power-hungry governors are all eyeing these precious materials. Ready yourself for battle and use every strategy at your disposal to secure these resources!
Battle for Power
Compete against other players for the ultimate honor of becoming the strongest governor in this grand strategy game. Claim the throne and reign supreme!
Forge Alliances
Ease the burden of survival in this chaotic world by forming or joining alliances. Collaborate with allies to rebuild civilization!
Recruit Heroes
The game features a roster of unique heroes, each waiting to be recruited. Bringing together heroes with various talents and skills is essential for taking the initiative and ensuring safety in these desperate times.
Compete with Other Governors
Hone your heroes' skills, assemble your squads, and challenge other governors. Victory not only earns you valuable points, but also grants access to rare items. Lead your town to the top of the rankings and showcase the rise of a great civilization.
Advance Technology
With the rebellion obliterating almost all technological advancements, it's crucial to start rebuilding and reclaiming the fragments of lost tech. The race to master cutting-edge technology could determine the dominator of this new world order!
[Stay Connected]
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/5cYPN24ftf

bluejetty:00014168:ios.name: ‎Le Coran en Français
bluejetty:00014168:ios.summary:
The French Quran is a beautiful translation of the Holy Quran in the French language, making the timeless wisdom and guidance of Islam accessible to millions of Russian people around the world.
The French Quran is not just about the words;
bluejetty:00014168:ios.description:
The French Quran is a beautiful translation of the Holy Quran in the French language, making the timeless wisdom and guidance of Islam accessible to millions of Russian people around the world.
The French Quran is not just about the words; it’s about connecting deeply with the teachings of Islam in a language that resonates with the heart. Whether you're a new learner or someone looking to strengthen your faith, the French Quran helps you understand and reflect on the messages of peace, love, and guidance that Islam offers. It's a bridge to a more personal, meaningful relationship with the Quran while still preserving the depth and beauty of the original Arabic text.
Before the French Quran translation, the Quran was primarily recited and taught in Arabic. However, for many French people, understanding the Quran’s meaning was a challenge due to the language barrier. This was the main reason behind producing translations of the Quran and other Islamic texts in French.
FEATURES:
DAILY VERSES:
After setting the reminder, you’ll get daily notifications to read your daily Quran verses.
QURAN VIDEOS:
Here you can find many Quran videos available.
NEARBY MOSQUE:
The app provides information about nearby mosques based on your location.
QUOTES:
We have Quran quotes in the form of images and text.
MY LIBRARY:
My library has all the highlighted verses, notes, and bookmarks that you make.
CALENDAR:
Contains all the festival dates.
VERSE GRAPHICS:

The French Quran is a beautiful translation of the Holy Quran in the French language, making the timeless wisdom and guidance of Islam accessible to millions of Russian people around the world.

The Payentry mobile app offers individuals access to their employee information, and provides employers with a cutting edge time and attendance solution for employees to clock in and out on a tablet in their workplace on the kiosk clock.
I
bluejetty:00187369:ios.description:
The Payentry mobile app offers individuals access to their employee information, and provides employers with a cutting edge time and attendance solution for employees to clock in and out on a tablet in their workplace on the kiosk clock.
Individuals can view all of their employee information in one place. Pay history is available by year, and paystub details are displayed in a graph so individuals can see the allocation of their pay check. When enabled by their employer, individuals can clock in and out using the Time Mgmt capabilities and view their tax forms, such as 1099-M, W-2, and 1095-C. Individuals can view their contact, status & position, accruals, direct deposits, and deductions.
When using the kiosk clock at a business location, individuals can clock in and out for their work shifts. Using a clock ID and facial recognition, the Payentry kiosk clock helps businesses reduce wage and hour fraud. Individuals are able to send a note to their manager and clock in and out of different departments and jobs when applicable. Once an individual has saved a time punch, they’ll immediately see a large message indicating success.

bluejetty:00177129:ios.name: GoCamera – PlayMemories Mobile
bluejetty:00177129:ios.summary: GoCamera is a powerful camera app that gives you remote control over your Sony PlayMemories Mobile camera. Use GoCamera to take stunning photos with custom exposure settings. Once shot, easily edit and share your pictures with your friends.
bluejetty:00177129:ios.description:
GoCamera is a powerful camera app that gives you remote control over your Sony PlayMemories Mobile camera. Use GoCamera to take stunning photos with custom exposure settings. Once shot, easily edit and share your pictures with your friends.
FEATURES 
- Remote control Sony PlayMemories Mobile cameras
- Zoom in and zoom out of your scenes
- Use different shooting modes like Program Auto, Aperture Priority, Shutter Priority and Manual (depending on camera and firmware)
- Control exposure settings such as exposure compensation (EV), ISO speed, aperture and shutter speed (depending on exposure mode)
- Adjust white balance pre-sets
- Edit your photos using features like cropping, filter effects or blur
- Share your favorite moments with your friends via iMessage, Facebook, Twitter, and more
Please note that GoCamera does not support capturing videos.
RELIABILITY & USER EXPERIENCE
With our latest updates we were able to significantly improve reliability and user experience. GoCamera is now faster than ever. Furthermore, we tested GoCamera with a large number of different Sony camera models such as the QX10, QX100, Alpha 5100, Alpha 6000, HX400V, and more.
DEVICE SUPPORT 
List of Sony PlayMemories Mobile cameras: Sony a7, Sony a7S II, Sony a7R, Sony a7R II, Sony a7S, Sony a5000, Sony a5100, Sony av6000, Sony a6300, Sony a6500, Sony NEX-5R, Sony NEX-5T, Sony NEX-6, Sony HX60, Sony HX80, Sony HX90, Sony HX400, Sony WX500, Sony RX10 II, Sony RX10 III, Sony RX100 III, Sony RX100 IV, Sony RX100 V, Sony DSC-QX10, Sony DSC-QX30, Sony DSC-QX100, Sony ILCE-QX1.
Sony discontinued the PlayMemories Mobile interface in March 2017. Cameras released after this date such as the Sony a7R III may not be compatible to GoCamera. Please read your camera’s user manual or visit Sony’s support website for further information on device support.
Please note that some devices need to install the ‘Smart Remote Embedded’ service from the camera's built-in app store to enable WiFi connectivity. Please adhere to your camera's manual. Furthermore, being a third party developer, we cannot guarantee device support for all PlayMemories Mobile cameras as Sony can restrict third party usage and change interface settings at its own discretion.

bluejetty:00148221:ios.name: OmaPosti
bluejetty:00148221:ios.summary:
OmaPosti is Posti's app for parcels and digital post.
TRACK PARCELS - OmaPosti shows you the status of your parcels: what's coming and where and when. When notifications are activated, OmaPosti notifies you when a parcel can be picked up.
bluejetty:00148221:ios.description:
OmaPosti is Posti's app for parcels and digital post.
TRACK PARCELS - OmaPosti shows you the status of your parcels: what's coming and where and when. When notifications are activated, OmaPosti notifies you when a parcel can be picked up. Depending on the situation, it shows you what delivery options are available for the parcel. If you've ordered home delivery, you can choose the most suitable delivery time in OmaPosti.
AFFORDABLE SENDING - When sending a parcel, it's a good idea to pay for the parcel in OmaPosti. This is the most affordable sending option. A prepaid shipment can be taken to any Posti Service Point or Parcel Locker.
RECEIVE DIGITAL POST - If you wish, you can get electronic letters and invoices in to your OmaPosti digital postbox.* The letters could be, for example, messages from the authorities, invoices and payslips. You can also choose to receive notification in OmaPosti or by email when you get new digital post.
PAY INVOICES - You can pay your invoices directly in OmaPosti – it's quick, easy and safe! The application sends out due date reminders and archives the invoices on your behalf.
GET HELP QUICKLY IN CHAT - The chat starts with a couple of questions to give you an automatic answer right away. If you need further help, we'll connect you with a customer advisor (during service hours).
FREE TO USE - The OmaPosti service is intended for all Finnish persons over 15 years of age. The OmaPosti service can be used free of charge.
BROWSER VERSION - If you don't want to or can't install the app on your phone, you can use the browser version of OmaPosti. You can find it at posti.fi/en/omaposti. Some Posti services are only available through the browser version, such as change of address and forwarding mail to another address. If you want to download all the letters and invoices you've received in OmaPosti, you can do so in the browser version.
*) The letters and invoices arriving in OmaPosti are handled in compliance with mail, correspondence and bank secrecy as well as the information security policy of the data protection ombudsman and Posti Group. We use standardized data transfer methods and secure connections.

bluejetty:00127987:ios.summary:

Join our rebels Lyra, Ken and Poppy on their adventures in Lupinia to
bluejetty:00127987:ios.description:
From the makers of award-winning Castle Cats, Dungeon Dogs is an idle RPG that allows you to battle, build, collect and craft all from the comfort of your mobile device.
Join our rebels Lyra, Ken and Poppy on their adventures in Lupinia to take down the evil cat king, who is suppressing the canine population and treating them as second-class citizens.
Dungeon Dogs is the perfect pick up and play game with tried and trusted gameplay mechanics and beautiful artwork that will capture the hearts of gamers young and old.
Set your rebels to battle foes whilst you are busy and collect your loot later or join the fight against oppression in real time, the choice is yours!
Features:
IDLE AND ACTION GAMEPLAY SYSTEM
Set your heroes to battle if you are busy and collect the rewards on your return to upgrade your heroes with Dungeon Dogs’ crafting system and collect new, epic doggos, each with their own individual skillset and characteristics.
Alternatively, join battles whenever you want to help your heroes out!
COLLECTING AND CUSTOMISATION
With over 45 different dog heroes to collect from launch there is plenty of options to choose from. Set your heroes to battle and evolve to unlock new skills, characteristics and outfits to make each hero original. You can also collect over 100 different items for your guild leader and customise to your liking.
FRESH AND ORIGINAL NARRATIVE
Dungeon Dogs’ standalone narrative fits perfectly into the Castle Cats Universe in a pawsome, pun filled storyline that will engage and captivate newcomers, as well as veterans of PocApp’s Idle RPG games.
LIKE THE CHARACTERS, THE GAME WILL KEEP EVOLVING
Packed with 85+ quests from launch, Dungeon Dogs does not stop there! Dungeon Dogs is an ever-evolving game where regular event updates will be added to the game, creating longevity. Whether it is a spring, summer, fall, holiday or even a special celebrity event, you will want to keep coming back for more. Extra heroes will also be added at regular intervals with special guest heroes making an appearance to help you expand your collection.
FULL COMMUNITY SUPPORT
We are always listening, and we want to include you as much as possible. Dungeon Dogs related competitions, fan art features and more are fully supported by PocApp Studios through our social media channels and Discord server. You never know, your idea may even make it into the game! How cool is that?
Get those paws ready and download now! It’s pawsome!
For more information, please visit:
www.dungeondogsgame.com
FOLLOW US ON SOCIAL MEDIA:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dungeondogs/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Dungeon_Dogs
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/dungeondogs/

listings.description:
From the makers of award-winning Castle Cats, Dungeon Dogs is an idle RPG that allows you to battle, build, collect and craft all from the comfort of your mobile device.

Join our rebels Lyra, Ken and Poppy on their adventures in Lupinia to take down the evil cat king, who is suppressing the canine population and treating them as second-class citizens.

Dungeon Dogs is the perfect pick up and play game with tried and trusted gameplay mechanics and beautiful artwork that will capture the hearts of gamers young and old.

Set your rebels to battle foes whilst you are busy and collect your loot later or join the fight against oppression in real time, the choice is yours!

Features:
IDLE AND ACTION GAMEPLAY SYSTEM
Set your heroes to battle if you are busy and collect the rewards on your return to upgrade your heroes with Dungeon Dogs’ crafting system and collect new, epic doggos, each with their own individual skillset and characteristics.
Alternatively, join battles whenever you want to help your heroes out!

COLLECTING AND CUSTOMISATION

With over 45 different dog heroes to collect from launch there is plenty of options to choose from. Set your heroes to battle and evolve to unlock new skills, characteristics and outfits to make each hero original. You can also collect over 100 different items for your guild leader and customise to your liking.

FRESH AND ORIGINAL NARRATIVE

Dungeon Dogs’ standalone narrative fits perfectly into the Castle Cats Universe in a pawsome, pun filled storyline that will engage and captivate newcomers, as well as veterans of PocApp’s Idle RPG games.

LIKE THE CHARACTERS, THE GAME WILL KEEP EVOLVING

Packed with 85+ quests from launch, Dungeon Dogs does not stop there! Dungeon Dogs is an ever-evolving game where regular event updates will be added to the game, creating longevity. Whether it is a spring, summer, fall, holiday or even a special celebrity event, you will want to keep coming back for more. Extra heroes will also be added at regular intervals with special guest heroes making an appearance to help you expand your collection.

FULL COMMUNITY SUPPORT

We are always listening, and we want to include you as much as possible. Dungeon Dogs related competitions, fan art features and more are fully supported by PocApp Studios through our social media channels and Discord server. You never know, your idea may even make it into the game! How cool is that?
Get those paws ready and download now! It’s pawsome!

bluejetty:00157740:ios.description:
At AdvantageCare Physicians we care for the whole you. That’s why our myACPNY app features a variety of tools to help manage your overall health, anytime and anywhere.
By logging in to myACPNY you can:
• Securely message your provider and Care Team anytime you have questions. It's the perfect way to keep in touch!
• Schedule your own appointments. Use our easy online appointment scheduler to make regular or follow-up appointments with your primary care provider and certain specialists.
• Conduct virtual visits. You will need a myACPNY account in order to conduct a virtual visit with one of our providers (for many appointment types).
• Express Check-In. Verify address and contact information, medications and allergies, and pay your co-pay all prior to your appointment.
• Make online payments and review paperless statements. Homepage notifications show your outstanding balance which you can now pay online with your credit card. You also have the ability to pay your copays and sign up for paperless statements.
• Request prescription renewals. Simply log into your account, click on the medications that you need refilled and your Care Team will take care of the rest.
• Get referral authorizations as soon as they're ready. No more waiting for them to arrive in the mail!
• See your test results. They're online for you to review! (In some instances, your Care Team may want to discuss certain results with you before making them available in myACPNY.)
• Review your health history and check your annual screenings.
• Manage your family's health. You can even link your family's accounts and keep everyone on the same page.
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs

-
bluejetty:00183085:ios.description:
Keep track of your Board Game collection, plays and scores in this easy to use tool.
View statistics and graphs for your games, plays, and other players.
Works offline, can sync with BoardGameGeek.
- How many games did you play recently?
- Who scored the highest for a game?
- With whom did you play and who wins more?
- Did you improve your score from last times?
- Use tailor-made score sheets to enter scores.
- Compare players, view graphs and charts.
- Keep track of your collection and sync with BoardGameGeek.
Collection management features:
- Keep track of every game you've played or are interested in.
- Choose a specific version and image, and track multiple copies.
- Set status to Owned, Wishlist, Want to play, and much more.
- Enter details like comments, price paid, acquisition date, etc.
- Filter games on status, Played but not owned, Unplayed owned games.
- Set Custom filters to select a game for your specific group.
- Full automatic syncing with your BoardGameGeek (BGG) collection.
Play tracking features:
- Set scoring rules, cooperative and team play for each game.
- Select game and played expansions.
- Set Players and Locations, including anonymous players.
- Enter location, scores per player and many more details.
- Calculate scores on the fly by using the math keyboard.
- Create teams and enter team scores.
- Use over 2800 game-specific tailor-made score sheets.
- Add Player roles, and choose from previously used ones.
- Use a timer to keep track of your play length.
- Add a Game note you can view each time you start a Play.
- Post your plays to BoardGameGeek, including auto-post after each save.
- Import existing plays from BoardGameGeek (BGG), Yucata and Board Game Arena (BGA)
- Send one or more Plays to other BG Stats users so only one of you has to enter the details.
Statistics features:
- View statistics for each game and player, and combination.
- See pie charts, play times and durations graphs, and score charts.
- View insights for Games and Players, for different time periods.
- See your H-index, fives, dimes, quarters and centuries.
- View a Player's personal H-index and win percentage.
- Share Insights charts and 3x3 images.
- See cost per play for your games.
BG Stats has export and import functions for easy backup to a variety of services.
You can sync with other devices via BG Stats Cloud sync (an in-app subscription).
All in a native iOS interface, supports dark mode, landscape and iPad screens.
With the Power Expansion (in-app purchase):
- Extended game charts, based on number of players.
- Filter your data on players, locations, specific periods and player counts.
- Statistics for a specific combination of players, and compare them.
- Winning streaks, tiebreakers, and new and starting player stats.
- Role- and board-based statistics.
- Heat map of plays and play duration. 
- Cost per hour, player and more.
- Add tags to Games, Players and Locations.
- Create and save custom filters, now also with tags.
- Customize the Game filter dropdown menu.
- Create advanced filters with multiple criteria and logical operations.
- View combined game statistics.
- Sync game tags with BoardGameGeek.
- Create Challenges (if available) based on game filters or tags.
With the Challenges expansion (in-app purchase):
- Create a challenge from one of the many templates.
- x times y challenges: play x games y times.
- Ongoing Reach your next H-index challenges.
- Set the time period and choose specific games to track, or use auto-fill.
- Filter specific Players, Locations and player counts to count for the challenge.
With a Cloud sync subscription:
- Seamlessly sync your data between all your devices.
- Keep a backup of your data in the cloud.
Please note that changes to the BGG website or API can temporarily break BGG related features. I cannot guarantee their continued availability.
