bluejetty:00138960:ios.name: Two Words with Susie Dent
bluejetty:00138960:ios.summary: Introducing Two Words - a captivating word game designed for word enthusiasts! Join Susie Dent (Countdown, 8 out of 10 Cats does Countdown) in a new word game that combines the thrill of classic crossword-style with simpler gameplay feature
bluejetty:00138960:ios.description:
Introducing Two Words - a captivating word game designed for word enthusiasts! Join Susie Dent (Countdown, 8 out of 10 Cats does Countdown) in a new word game that combines the thrill of classic crossword-style with simpler gameplay features.
**Engaging Gameplay!**
- Place tiles strategically on top of letters to craft new words on the vibrant word grid.
- Easy to understand Crossword game with less complicated rules
- The unique scoring system multiplies letter values by the length of the formed word, adding an extra layer of strategy to every move.  
- Encounter a challenging set of letters? Fear not! A quick swap option allows you to shake up your letter rack and discover fresh possibilities.  
- With a comprehensive UK & US English dictionary, your vocabulary skills are sure to be put to the test. You may learn new words along the way and improve your spelling!
**Establish Rivalries and Connect with Friends!**
- In Two Words, dive into the exciting world of curated opponents and Rivals.
- Connect with friends or make new adversaries as the game finds thrilling head-to-head matches for you.  
- Challenge your friends, track your stats, and engage in the friendly competition that makes Two Words a truly social experience.
- Search out new opponents to challenge with both a built in player search engine, or pick from a simple list of curated matches that refresh daily!
**Solo Play and Train Your Brain!**
- Whether you prefer the thrill of multiplayer matches or the tranquility of solo play, Two Words caters to all preferences.  
- Test your anagram skills against four different robot player difficulties, including the formidable SusieBot.  
- It's not just a game; it's an opportunity to solve word puzzle with each turn and expand your vocabulary in a fun and interactive way. It’s educational as well as enjoyable!
**Bright and Relaxing Visuals!**
- Immerse yourself in a visually stunning experience with fun and beautiful tile sets to collect.  
- Animated backgrounds featuring serene landscapes create a calming backdrop as you puzzle over turns. 
- Clean and intuitive animations make every move on the board a joy to experience.
- Study the grid for your next best move as calming scenery helps you focus your mind.
**Keep Track of Your Skills!**
- Delve into in-depth stats that monitor your best words and scores.  
- Compare your stats with opponents, friends, and rivals as you go.  
- The Head 2 Head score tracking ensures you always know where you stand in the ultimate battle of words. 
- As you train your brain’s skills in memory and learning, you’ll see improvements to your overall play
Are you a human dictionary? This crossword game might make you one! Match with opponents, connect with friends and broaden your mind. Go out and make a name for yourself online, study their moves and become a walking thesaurus!
Susie Dent invites you to a game that not only challenges your vocabulary but also provides a visual feast for your eyes. Dive into Two Words and Duel friends, boggle opponents and master vocabulary as you scramble to beat the rest in this simple crossword experience. 
Be sure to tell your friends to have a go!
For any queries or comments, visit our FAQs at https://playtwowords.com 
It's time to rediscover the joy of wordplay with Two Words – the game that keeps your brain buzzing for more!

Terms and conditions of use: https://www.iubenda.com/terms-and-conditions/24559092

Become a Grubhub Driver and deliver customers the food they love from their favorite restaurants. With the largest restaurant and diner network, Grubhub offers more opportunities to make money on your own schedule. 
Why drive with Grubhub?
MAKE GREAT MONEY
Earn competitive money and keep 100% of your tips as a Grubhub delivery person.
WORK WHEN YOU WANT
Work part time, full time or in your spare time. You can schedule your hours in advance or have the flexibility to deliver on short notice. Create a schedule that works for you!

NO CAR NEEDED

EASY SIGN UP
Download the Grubhub for Drivers app and sign up to work at driver.grubhub.com. We’ll walk you through each step along the way.
MORE ORDERS, MORE OPPORTUNITIES TO EARN
Grubhub has the largest restaurant and diner network of any other food delivery platform.
Grubhub drivers are earning money in cities across the US, including: Albany, Atlanta, Austin, Baltimore, Boston, Bridgeport, Chicago, Dallas, Denver, Hartford, Houston, Las Vegas, Los Angeles, Miami, Minneapolis, Nashville, New York City, Orlando, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, San Diego, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, St. Louis, Sacramento, Tampa, Washington DC … and many more.

bluejetty:00040826:ios.name: Arc Studio Screenwriting
bluejetty:00040826:ios.summary:
Arc Studio Pro supports your screenwriting process from idea to finished script:
* Format your script according to professional industry standards without even thinking about it
* Write with flow, thanks to distraction-free, thoughtful des
bluejetty:00040826:ios.description:
Arc Studio Pro supports your screenwriting process from idea to finished script:
* Format your script according to professional industry standards without even thinking about it
* Write with flow, thanks to distraction-free, thoughtful design
* From idea to story: Outline and visualize your story-structure with the most advanced beat-board available
* Collaborate: Write with others in real-time, receive feedback and margin notes directly in your script
PROFESSIONAL FORMATTING
Arc Studio Pro automatically formats your screenplay to industry standards, even if you don’t know what they are. It’s super-easy to use for beginners and fully-customizable for pros.
* Fully automatic, industry standard page layout and text formatting
* Import and export Final Draft, PDF, and Fountain
* Use intuitive shortcuts to format your text perfectly and effortlessly
* The most advanced autocompletion on the market: Character names and sluglines automatically completed for you, for faster typing and consistent naming.
* Elements are chosen for you based on what's most likely, and can be configured.
KEEP IT FLOWING
Stay focused thanks to state of the art design. Write with ease and only think about your story, not the page margins or when you saved the last time.
* Intuitive interface
* Autosave and automatic backups for worry-free writing
* Super-pretty night mode
CRAFT YOUR STORY
Arc Studio Pro takes you beyond just formatting, and helps you build your story with the most powerful outlining features on the market.
* Build your story from basic elements: plots, characters, and locations
* Add beats and organize them in acts or sequences
* Rearrange your story with intuitive drag & drop
* Tag your beats with plots and characters, for intuitive color coding
* Highlight certain storylines and characters to see their arcs at a glance
TEAM WORK
Arc Studio Pro is the screenwriting app that focuses most on collaboration. Screenwriting is often teamwork, so we want to make it as easy as possible for you to work together - that’s why we offer the most sophisticated collaborative writing tools on the market.
* Write at the same time in the same document in real-time
* Invite collaborators with one click via email
* Comment directly on the script
* Request reviews and send read-only excerpts
WORRY-FREE EDITING
Tying to find a certain scene or deleted dialogue? Miss a bit of text? Arc Studio Pro keeps track of all your edits and makes it easy for you and your collaborators to recover previous versions. Never search through piles of papers, different documents or endless emails again.
* Search and manage your history with ease
* Track your own changes
* See who what others changed – who and when
* Delete and recover whole scenes thanks to sophisticated history features
PAY-AS-YOU-GO
Arc Studio on iOS and iPadOS requires an annual Pro subscription.
A 7-day free trial is included.
PRIVACY AND TERMS
Privacy policy: https://www.arcstudiopro.com/privacy
Terms and Conditions: https://www.arcstudiopro.com/terms

bluejetty:00185914:ios.name: Backgammon Masters
bluejetty:00185914:ios.summary:
Want to learn how to play backgammon wherever you go? You are in luck!
Backgammon Masters is an aesthetically pleasing game for online and single player backgammon. Enjoy the ancient board game in crisp, modern graphics on your smartphone
bluejetty:00185914:ios.description:
Want to learn how to play backgammon wherever you go? You are in luck!
Backgammon Masters is an aesthetically pleasing game for online and single player backgammon. Enjoy the ancient board game in crisp, modern graphics on your smartphone or tablet!
All board game fans will appreciate the easy to use interface, detailed visuals and many features. There is something for everybody! You can personalise your profile, challenge online players, make bets, gammon opponents, participate in tournaments, chat live, find new friends and learn all the tricks of this ancient and exciting board game!
Want to play with friends and family?
Easy! Play with your friends in hotseat mode, organise tournaments and improve your skill!
Out on a trip and have no internet connection?
Just challenge our AI in any backgammon style you wish! One match will take you only 5 to 30 minutes.
Backgammon Masters supports many styles of backgammon:
» Classic backgammon - the core of the game.
» Narde (Nardi) - very popular in Russia. Longer play, since you can't hit opponent's checkers. 
» Tavla (Tavli or Turkish Backgammon) - popular in Turkey. Very similar to backgammon with some rule differences regarding checker play.
» Nackgammon - variation invented by Nack Ballard with 2 differences from the original game.
» Old English Backgammon - a style popular in United Kingdom.
Despite the game's old age millions of people all around the world still enjoy this fantastic board game and its variations up to this day.
Join and become a true Master of Backgammon!
Game Features:
● 5 backgammon styles: Backgammon, Narde, Nackgammon, Old English and Tavla
● 3 game modes: Online game, against AI, and Hotseat
● 100% fair and completely random dice rolls 
● Option to check dice fairness in the game in your profile and on the server
● 6 beautiful boards: Classic, Metal, 10,000BC, Profi, Casino and White Crocodile! 
● 2 difficulty levels in game vs AI
● Daily tournaments in Backgammon, Narde, Tavla and Nackgammon
● Extensive statistics for the last match
● Share your success on Facebook or Twitter!
● Highlighting of available moves
● Find new friends and opponents in global chat! 
● Elo score support and skill levels for players. Can you reach the top? 
● Free and regular updates! 
● Collect daily free bonus coins!
● Multi language support: Russian, German and Turkish translations!
● Cross platform support for devices all over the world!
Internet access is required upon first launch of the app in order to download additional resources (size up to 100 Mb).
Online play requires an internet connection.
Here is what our players are saying about Backgammon Masters:
“I had tried many backgammon apps: Backgammon NJ, Backgammon Deluxe, Backgammon Live, Backgammon Ace, Backgammon Gold, but I really think Backgammon Masters is the best and most exciting backgammon app currently available in the market! I play it with my friends and family all the time!"
"To put it simply, Backgammon Masters is one gorgeous looking application." -- TheiPhoneAppReview
"The game is exactly what a backgammon app should be. It has a great look, detailed instructions, and is faithful to the original game. The number of match-making offerings is impressive and the controls are easy to use." -- 148apps
Like us and follow us for the latest news, updates and free offers:
» http://www.facebook.com/2KBLLC
» http://www.twitter.com/2kbcompany
If you enjoy Backgammon Masters, leave us a rating!
We listen to our players and work constantly to improve the game and make it better.

bluejetty:00154324:ios.name: Association Master: Word Game
bluejetty:00154324:ios.summary:
► WORK WONDERS WITH WORDS
Word game aficionados, get ready to be wowed with the latest and greatest vocabulary building connections puzzle! Each level contains sets of 4 items or words that you’ll need to uncover, with categories ranging f
bluejetty:00154324:ios.description:
► WORK WONDERS WITH WORDS
Word game aficionados, get ready to be wowed with the latest and greatest vocabulary building connections puzzle! Each level contains sets of 4 items or words that you’ll need to uncover, with categories ranging from bullfighting, tree parts, countries, and more. As you progress the number of sets to merge will grow, as will the complexity, so you’ll really need to stop and think before making your guesses as you seek to figure out which words are associated with which. But don’t worry, this game is low stress – take as long as you want to search and connect sets and enjoy word merging fun.
► NO WORD SALAD HERE
Word Jam makes building your vocabulary simple: each game level contains a list of words that have been jumbled up, and your task is to figure out what categories they belong to and merge those 4 words together. This puzzle adds extra layers, with new words appearing in later levels, and the use of emojis and icons to make guessing extra fun! Not only is solving tricky puzzles fun, this type of game is a great way to help your brain stay sharp, so players of all ages are encouraged to get searching and connecting!
► LOOK FORWARD TO:
◾ Multiple merging – like typical word merging games, Word Jam has set levels where you’ll need to search for and connect the matching words or objects. Where it gets extra fun is that as you progress, the puzzle levels increase in difficulty! Not all of the words may be visible at first, and sometimes the sets you’ve matched will reappear in the form of an object that is itself part of a new set.
◾ Chill puzzling – making associations between words and training your brain can be hard as it is, so why make it harder? Thanks to the lack of timer and ability to get hints and help, you’ll never find yourself completely stuck on a level or worried about your reaction time– there’s always a way to solve it! You’ll be able to fly through puzzles or sit and work through them at your own pace, the choice is yours.

◆ L.CLUB 멤버십으로 누리는 최고 등급 혜택 
다양한 할인 쿠폰과 적립, 롯데 계열사 제휴까지! 지금 L.CLUB에서 모두 경험하세요. 
◆ 롯데홈쇼핑이 처음이시라면? 
신규 회원 가입하고 구매하시면 즉시 사용 가능한 웰컴 기프트를 선물해 드려요. 
※ 앱 접근 권한에 대해 안내 드립니다. 
롯데홈쇼핑은 정보통신망법 제 22조의 2(접근 권한에 대한 동의)의 규정에 맞춰 서비스에 꼭 필요한 항목만을 필수접근하고 있습니다. 
[OS버전 지원 안내] 
- iOS 11.0 이상 환경에서 원활히 동작합니다. 
[필수적 접근 권한] 
- 단말기ID : 단말기 식별 및 사용성 개선 
[선택적 접근 권한] 
- 카메라 : 리뷰 작성, 이벤트 참여, 게시글 작성, 1:1 문의 
- 사진/저장소 : 리뷰 작성, 이벤트 참여, 게시글 작성, 1:1 문의 
- 생체인식 : 생체인증 로그인 및 결제 
- 알림 : PUSH 알림 수신 
- 연락처 : 선물하기, E쿠폰 주문 
※ 기종별로 선택적 접근 권한 항목이 상이 할 수 있습니다 
※ 선택적 접근 권한은 해당 기능을 사용할 때 동의를 받고 있으며, 동의하지 않아도 해당 기능 외 서비스 이용이 가능합니다. 
※ 접근 권한 동의 여부 변경을 원할 경우 앱의 설정>권한 및 기기 설정에서 변경해 주시기 바랍니다. 
◆ 롯데홈쇼핑 고객센터 1899-4000 
◆ 앱 이용 관련 불편사항, 오류신고 : APPhelp@lotte.net (단말기종, OS정보 기재) 
더욱 편리한 쇼핑환경을 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다. 
감사합니다.

bluejetty:00027277:ios.name: AmberDraw: Animated Drawing
bluejetty:00027277:ios.summary: AmberDraw is a drawing app where the brushes themselves animate. Not filters. Not effects added afterwards. The motion is built into every single stroke. Pick up your Apple Pencil, draw a line, and watch it wiggle, scatter, flow, or pulse —
bluejetty:00027277:ios.description:
AmberDraw is a drawing app where the brushes themselves animate. Not filters. Not effects added afterwards. The motion is built into every single stroke. Pick up your Apple Pencil, draw a line, and watch it wiggle, scatter, flow, or pulse — live, as you draw.
There are no keyframes. No timelines. No exporting to After Effects just to make something move. You draw, and it's already animated.
The wiggle line aesthetic, finally in an app If you've ever loved the hand-drawn, jittery motion style — in title sequences, illustrated reels, motion posters — AmberDraw is how you make that. Each brush has its own character: Scribble shakes with nervous energy, Gradient flows like liquid, Particle explodes outward, Charcoal drifts like smoke. You're not choosing a tool, you're choosing a feeling.
What's inside • Animated brushes, each with unique bespoke motion • Full brush customisation — speed, density, size, behaviour • Layers for organisation and creative control • Custom canvas dimensions • Apple Pencil support • Import images directly onto your canvas • Transform tool for repositioning and scaling • Export your finished piece as video — ready to post
Who it's for Artists who composite across apps. Illustrators who want their work to breathe. Designers making content for social. Anyone who's opened Procreate and thought — what if this moved?
Export your animations as video and bring them straight into After Effects, CapCut, or anywhere else you work. AmberDraw fits into your workflow, not the other way around.
Free to download. Unlock the full brush library with Pro.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/view/amberdraw-privacypolicy/home

bluejetty:00194468:android.description:
Stay up-to-date with the latest headlines and stories from the conservative perspective with Conservative News.
Our app brings you a streamlined and customizable news reading experience, ensuring you get the news that matters to you, right when you need it.
Key Features:
AI Generated Article SummariesHave articles summarized into a couple of paragraphs to stay on top of the news.
Trending ArticlesGet a list of the most popular article from the last 12 hours.
*Android AutoNews on the go! Have the trending summaries read to you on the way to work. 
Smart Notifications: The notification system was designed to update you when breaking news happens but not annoy you with constant notifications that you don't want or need.
Tailored Reading Experience: Read the way you want. Adjust the text size for comfortable reading and choose how you view articles: see the full text and images, just the headlines, or a text-only version to save on data. You can also choose to open article links in our fast in-app browser or your device's default browser.
Save & Share Articles: Found an article you want to read later? Save it with a single tap and access it anytime. Easily share important stories with your friends and family via social media, email, or messaging apps.
Powerful Search: Looking for information on a specific topic? Our robust search function helps you find articles across all your selected sources quickly and easily.
Light & Dark Themes: Enjoy a comfortable reading experience day or night. The app automatically syncs with your system's theme, switching between light and dark modes for your viewing pleasure.
See News That Matters To You First: You can now reorder your sources to prioritize the news you want to see first.
* Build Your Own News Feed: Take control of your news. Select which news sources to include and create a feed that's uniquely yours.
* Add Your Own Sources: Have a news source you wish was included? Or want to have your local news or sports in the app? No problem, you can easily add it to your list of news sources.
Conservative News is the perfect app for anyone who wants to stay informed with news from a conservative viewpoint, all in one convenient and highly customizable place.
Get News Feeds from:
• Daily Wire
• One America News
• The Blaze
• Newsmax
• Breitbart

Transform your iPhone and iPad with ArabicWalls, a growing collection of handcrafted Arabic and Islamic wallpapers. Beautiful calligraphy, intricate geometric patterns and cultural motifs in HD and 4K, from talented artists across the Arab world.
THOUSANDS OF UNIQUE WALLPAPERS
A large curated library of Arabic and Islamic wallpapers in HD and 4K. Calligraphy, geometric patterns, nature, occasions and more, carefully selected and updated regularly.
QURAN, HADITH AND WISDOM QUOTES
Add inspiring quotes from the Quran, authentic Hadith and timeless Arabic wisdom onto any wallpaper. A daily reminder of faith, right where you look most.
MAKE IT YOURS
Move, resize and rotate quotes, add your own text in beautiful Arabic fonts, and place a calendar in Gregorian or Hijri. Blur the background, switch to the dark version of wallpapers that have one, and pick any colour with the eyedropper.
DEPTH EFFECT
Place text and quotes behind the subject of a wallpaper for a layered look on your lock screen.
YOUR OWN PHOTO
Turn any photo from your library into a wallpaper with the same quotes, text, calendar and depth tools. Your photo stays on your device.
PREVIEW BEFORE YOU SAVE
See the wallpaper on a full lock screen preview, then save it to Photos in full resolution.
DESKTOP AND 4K READY

COMMUNITY
Browse designs shared by other artists and share your own with thousands of users.
EASY TO BROWSE
Categories for Arabic letters, nature, occasions and more. Know a wallpaper's number? Search for it and open it directly.

• Thousands of HD and 4K Arabic and Islamic wallpapers
• Beautiful Arabic calligraphy designs
• Quran, Hadith and wisdom quotes on any wallpaper

• Blur and depth effects
• Use your own photo as a wallpaper

bluejetty:00092616:ios.description:
Welcome to The Blox! 
We are a series of tools and assets designed to entertain, educate, and empower entrepreneurs - for free!
Our flagship asset is a competition docu-series about 20 startups living under a single roof, competing to se who is the best startup on The Blox. This show is exclusively available on the app. Use it to binge-watch their trials and tribulations in the largest live-in startup competition on the planet.
We also have hundreds of hours of video and audio based consultations between our world-class mentors and our startups. This will allow you to be a fly-on-the-wall of a startup accelerator - so you can learn alongside our teams. Use the app to filter by topic to ensure you're learning only the things that are most relevant to you!
The app also features a series of guided meditations designed to help entrepreneurs harness the power of their brainspace. By doing so, we can physically strenghten your brain, allowing you to more easily build your business.
We also have functional music, AKA bi-naural beats, which is ambient music with a scientific twist. Use the app to pick a task, such as study, sleep, flow state, etc. Our music will then auto-tune subliminal frequencies into the background of the music that will sync your brainwaves to the optimal frequency for the task. Use it to help you turn on your focus for the day, or relax at night when it's time to wind down.

bluejetty:00167596:ios.summary: ReeXpose is the best app for long exposure photography on the App Store. Designed by professionals for professionals, ReeXpose closes the gap between your iPhone and a DSLR camera, allowing you to shoot long exposure photos in RAW. All with
bluejetty:00167596:ios.description:
ReeXpose is the best app for long exposure photography on the App Store. Designed by professionals for professionals, ReeXpose closes the gap between your iPhone and a DSLR camera, allowing you to shoot long exposure photos in RAW. All without the need for additional ND filters!
Select your capture mode, adjust your exposure, chose your capture duration and ReeXpose will do the rest. The result will be a single, 12-bit DNG file editable in your favorite editing software.
Use the “motion blur” mode to make people disappear, smooth the movement of clouds, or give running water a characteristic silky appearance. Use the “light trails mode” for stunning star trails or to transform moving cars into gorgeous rivers of light. Enjoy the flexibility of full manual controls and the extended dynamic range given by RAW files.
ReeXpose is brought to you by REEFLEX, the small studio behind the development of Reeflex Pro Camera and ReeHeld.
 — MAIN FEATURES —
• RAW capabilities for long exposure*/**/***
• Motion blur & Light trails modes
• Extended capture time ranging from seconds to minutes, hours, and Bulb (unlimited)
• Full manual controls for ISO, shutter speed, focus, and white balance
• Live preview: watch the RAW photo developing on the screen
• Interims results: allows taking intermediate photos during a long capture
• Parallel bracketing: allows capturing 2 photos at different selected exposures for HDR bracketing in post-production
• Exposure guides like histogram and zebra stripes 
• Focus peaking
• Apple Watch integration for remote shutter
• Photo backup in the File app
• Gyroscopic tiltmeter and Grid (rule of thirds)
• GPS location in the photo’s metadata
• Multi-Language support
• Blazing fast processing & saving time (1ms)
• Lock Screen Widget for quick access
• Tap-to-focus (Auto-focus)
— ACCESSIBILITY —
• Color-blind users can tune the app to suit their needs best, customizing the UI and color coding.
— IMPORTANT REMARKS —
• Note #1: *The RAW format is not supported for the ultra-wide camera on devices older than the iPhone 12 series (this is a limitation given by the manufacturer - Apple)
• Note #2: **As usual for long exposure, you must use a tripod and keep the phone as steady as possible. The app does NOT stabilize the images automatically. If this is what you're looking for, then please have a look at our other app (ReeHeld)
• Note #3: ***Bayer RAW images, which are the standard in professional photography, necessarily require editing in post-production in order for you to obtain a properly elaborated photo. The RAW image captured differs from what you see in the live-preview when shooting, as the live preview is based on the elaborated live output which is in JPG. Hence you might notice differences in what you see on the screen when shooting vs the final DNG image (Bayer RAW). We, therefore, suggest fine-tuning your exposure by manually adjusting SS and ISO, and taking several shots in order to find the best settings for your desired shot.

• Stay up to date and receive regular updates, subscribe to our newsletter: reeflexstore.com/pages/newsletter
• Follow us on Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter: @ReeflexCamera
• Share your photos with us! Tag #ShotWithReeXpose and join our community
— TUTORIAL —
• Learn tips & tricks, and get the most out of the app: https://reeflexstore.com/pages/reexpose-tutorial
• Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ): https://reeflexstore.com/pages/faq-reexpose

bluejetty:00015095:ios.description:
This is the Educational Institution Edition of "Visual Countdown Timer". It has all the great features of the normal version but comes without any Ads or InApp purchases, and is opted into Apple's volume discount for educational institutions. COPPA and GDPR compliant.
Is it a battle to get your child to do something quickly?
This visual countdown App was designed for my 2 year old son to help him get his reward chart star for getting dressed quickly. 
Getting him dressed used to take forever with many stalling strategies being deployed. Now he runs upstairs asking for the "Countdown". 
Watch as the timer runs from green to amber to red, helping the child understand that time is running out. 
A fun picture is slowly revealed as the time runs down and when the time is up the child is rewarded with an exciting sound and the picture spins. 
Background image changes to match the time of day, so that your child is given subtle hints as to what time of day the task they are being asked relates to.
Choose your own image to reveal from your iPhones photo library to really surprise your child.
Endless possible uses:
* Getting dressed
* Getting out the door (shoes and coats on)
* Tidying
* Brushing teeth
* Sharing toys
Turns daily struggles into fun time!

bluejetty:00167757:ios.description:
Baby Lila’s World: Toddler Games & Preschool Learning Fun
Explore, Learn, and Play in Baby Lila’s World — A Safe & Ad-Free Adventure for Toddlers!
Welcome to Baby Lila’s World, a colorful and engaging pretend play game for toddlers and preschoolers aged 2–5! If your child loves apps like Sago Mini, Kiddopia, Lingokids, and ABC Mouse, they’ll adore the interactive adventures and creative activities in Baby Lila’s World. Designed by early childhood education experts, this app blends fun and learning through imaginative play and hands-on exploration.
Why Parents and Kids Love Baby Lila’s World:
• Creative & Imaginative Play: Explore Baby Lila’s House, the Playground, Beach, and even a Petting Zoo! Every location is packed with tappable objects, fun surprises, and adorable characters that inspire creativity and storytelling.
• Educational Mini-Games: Build essential preschool skills like counting, colors, shapes, sorting, and vocabulary with simple, fun games made for little learners.
• Ad-Free & Kid-Safe: 100% ad-free with no in-app purchases. Enjoy worry-free playtime in a safe, secure digital environment trusted by parents.
• Fun Characters & Stories: Meet Baby Lila, her friends, and cute pets in heartwarming stories that promote kindness, curiosity, and social learning.
• Creative Expression: Color, draw, decorate scenes, and build your own pretend play stories! Encourage artistic growth and imagination.
• Easy for Toddlers: A toddler-friendly interface with intuitive controls makes it easy for little fingers to play independently.
• Built-In Parental Controls: Manage playtime, monitor progress, and customize settings with tools that give you peace of mind.
Inspired by Trusted Kids Learning Apps
Just like Kiddopia, Sago Mini World, and ABC Mouse, Baby Lila’s World supports early learning goals with engaging activities that develop cognitive and motor skills. It’s the perfect preschool app to help your toddler grow through joyful exploration.
Perfect for Families Looking For:
• Toddler learning games
• Preschool educational apps
• Safe, interactive pretend play
• Creative role-playing for kids
• No ads, no in-app purchases – just pure play!
• Offline toddler games for on-the-go fun
Growing With Your Child
Baby Lila’s World is constantly updated with fresh content and new locations to explore. Whether it’s learning about animals at the zoo, baking cupcakes in the kitchen, or creating art in the playroom, there’s always something new for your child to discover.
Let Kids Play and Learn Their Way
Our app nurtures the natural curiosity and creativity of young children, turning screen time into meaningful learning. With a play-based approach inspired by Montessori and early education techniques, Baby Lila’s World helps children build confidence, independence, and life skills in a playful way.
Join the millions of families choosing safe, fun, and educational games for kids!
Download Baby Lila’s World today and turn everyday moments into magical learning adventures.

• Privacy Policy: https://photontadpole.com/privacy-policy-lila-s-world

bluejetty:00114777:ios.description:
Build your family legacy across generations!
Welcome to Family Go! — the ultimate life simulator where every choice shapes your dynasty. Play multiple story scenarios, tackle a Challenge Mode with roguelite runs, and grow a living family tree across generations.
In Family Go!, you start with a single character and make life-changing decisions that influence your family’s journey. Will you choose love, wealth, fame, or a peaceful rural life? As your family grows, each new generation brings fresh opportunities, challenges, and surprises.
Family Simulation Adventure
Experience the full cycle of life: marriage, children, career, retirement, and beyond. Build your home, raise your kids, and pass on your family’s values to the next generation. Watch your family evolve into a flourishing legacy over time!
Multiple Story Scenarios
Choose from curated story scripts with unique settings and goals—small-town romance, career hustle, cozy homestead, competitive sports, and more. Each scenario features branching events and meaningful choices, so no two legacies play the same.
Challenge Mode (Roguelite Runs)
Test your strategy in replayable roguelite runs with escalating difficulty and special modifiers. Earn legacy points and permanent bonuses that carry into your next life. Master the rules, optimize builds, and climb seasonal leaderboards!
Grow Your Family Tree
Expand your family across decades! Track generations as they unfold, watching how your choices impact descendants. Each new member brings unique traits, talents, and dreams, making every legacy completely different.
Build Your Town and Empire
Transform a humble village into a thriving town! Invest in businesses, upgrade your home, open new shops, and build bustling streets. Your town grows hand in hand with your family’s story.
Life Choices Matter
Every decision opens a new path. Who will you marry? How will you educate your children? Will you invest in your town’s future, build a peaceful farm, or chase fame and fortune? Make the right choices and leave a story worth telling.
Inheritance & Traits
Pass traits, talents, and appearances from generation to generation. Watch children inherit skills, looks, and delightful quirks, creating a rich, evolving family tree shaped by your decisions.
Achievements, Events & Surprises
Life is full of unexpected moments! Celebrate marriages, honor retirements, unlock secret talents, and conquer challenges through a wide range of dynamic events and achievements.
Key Features
 - Build and grow a multigenerational family legacy
 - Play multiple story scenarios with branching choices
 - Challenge Mode with replayable roguelite runs and legacy bonuses
 - Design and expand homes, businesses, and towns
 - Raise children and guide them toward unique destinies
 - Experience inheritance with evolving family traits
 - Participate in dynamic events and unlock rare rewards
 - Enjoy a cozy, heartwarming life simulation you can replay forever
Whether you dream of raising a legendary family, building a town empire, or simply enjoying the journey of life, Family Go! lets you craft a unique legacy full of love, dreams, and adventure.
Download Family Go! today — your family’s journey begins now!

bluejetty:00045846:ios.description:
FNBEA-Go is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with FNBEA-Go:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the FNBEA-Go app, you must be enrolled as a First National Bank of Eastern Arkansas digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Take charge of your files with Zip & RAR & 7z File Extractor — an all-in-one file manager to unzip, scan to PDF, sign documents, and manage everything in seconds.
Designed for speed and efficiency, it’s your ultimate zip file opener, RAR extractor, 7z tool, and PDF editor. Easily scan documents with your camera, fill and sign PDFs on the go, and manage all your files in one place.
Key Features
• Lightning-Fast Extraction: Unzip or extract RAR, 7zip, and TAR files in seconds.
• Smart Compression: Create ZIP or 7zip files to save space or share easily.
• Wide Format Support: Handle ZIP, RAR, 7zip, TAR and more with this powerful extractor.
• Batch Processing: Unzip files or compress multiple files at once for maximum efficiency.
• Scan Documents: Turn photos into high-quality PDFs instantly using your camera scanner.
• PDF Reader: Open and view PDF files smoothly anytime.
• Compress PDF: Reduce PDF file size for easy storage and sharing.
• Fill and Sign PDFs: Complete forms and add signatures on the go.
• PDF Converter: Convert PDFs to and from common file formats with ease.
• PDF Security: Protect sensitive files with password encryption.
• Secure & Reliable: Process files locally with stable and secure performance, helping keep your data protected..
Why Choose Us?
• All-in-One File Tool: Unzip, compress, scan, and manage PDFs in one powerful app.
• Speedy Performance: Extract RAR or unzip files instantly with our efficient extractor.
• Work Smarter: Scan documents, edit PDFs, and organize files without switching apps.
• Space Saver: Compress files into ZIP or 7zip, and reduce PDF size for sharing.
• Time-Saving Batch Mode: Process multiple files at once to stay productive.
• Privacy First: All files are processed locally, ensuring maximum data security.
Who’s It For?
• Students: Scan notes into PDFs, unzip lecture materials, and compress assignments for easy sharing.
• Professionals: Manage work files, extract archives, scan documents, and fill & sign PDFs on the go.
• Remote Workers: Handle contracts, scan receipts, and organize compressed files anytime, anywhere.
• Tech Enthusiasts: Extract 7zip archives, and explore advanced file formats effortlessly.
• Everyday Users: Simplify daily tasks—unzip files, scan documents, and manage PDFs in one place.
[Note]

Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Privacy Policy
Zip & RAR & 7z File Extractor is designed with privacy first. Your files are processed locally on your device for enhanced privacy. bluejetty:00074613:ios.summary:
With USTA Flex, you can play tennis at your level on a court near you, whenever it suits you. Get on the court and enjoy friendly, competitive singles or doubles matches.
Whatever your level – beginner or advanced – you will play exciting
bluejetty:00074613:ios.description:
With USTA Flex, you can play tennis at your level on a court near you, whenever it suits you. Get on the court and enjoy friendly, competitive singles or doubles matches.
Whatever your level – beginner or advanced – you will play exciting matches, meet new people and improve your game. Flex leagues are taking place all across the US and all year round for adults over the age of 18.
Leagues take place in a round-robin or ladder 2.0 format, and a season generally runs for 8 to 12 weeks. You can arrange matches whenever you want – so it’s ideal if you’re looking to compete around your busy lifestyle.
Why you should join
More tennis: Play 5-7 level-based matches while making new tennis friends
Ultimate flexibility: With our in-app chat, scheduling matches around your life has never been easier. Play when you want, where you want
Track your progress: Every match is an opportunity to improve your game and improve your WTN rating 
Features of the USTA Flex app
- Find all you need in one place – entering leagues, setting up matches, inputting scores and match history
- In-app chat – easily schedule matches with your opponents with individual and group chats
- More to come: Set up your own flex leagues and join local events and communities to get the most out of your tennis
Not sure of your level of play? No problem – we’ll find the right group for you using your ITF World Tennis Number, so you play opponents at the right level for you.
What’s the ITF World Tennis Number?
The ITF World Tennis Number is a rating system for all tennis players across the world. It makes it easier for everyone who plays tennis in US to organize and play against opponents of a similar standard.
• A worldwide rating system that ranges from 40 (beginner players) to 1 (pro players).
• Has separate ratings for Singles and Doubles players
• Uses a sophisticated algorithm to calculate your rating and updates it every time you compete
• Counts sets and matches played, which means the more you compete, the more accurate your WTN will be
Game on!
Download the USTA Flex App today and enter a world where more tennis matches are just a tap away. Join our community of passionate players and discover the joy of playing tennis on your terms. Let’s make every match count with USTA Flex!

bluejetty:00030310:ios.description:
This is Barre Body, your online workout portal and the fastest way to feel good. 
Fun fact: feeling good is the reason why we move. We don’t care about looking a particular way. Abs shmabs. We care about listening to our bodies, and resting when we need to. About loving our bodies, even on days we don’t particularly like them. We care about showing up, sweating it out, and shaking it off. And doing arm workouts even if it’s just to help make IKEA flatpacks easier.

bluejetty:00129064:ios.description:
Note: The Past Within is a co-op only game. Both players need to own a copy of the game on their own device (mobile, tablet or computer), as well as a way to communicate with each other. Play together with a friend or find a partner on our official Discord server!
The past and future cannot be explored alone! Team up with a friend and piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives! 
The Past Within is the first co-op only point-and-click adventure set in the mysterious world of Rusty Lake.
Features:
▪ A co-op experience 
Play together with a friend, one in The Past, the other in The Future. Work together to solve the puzzles and help Rose set her father’s plan in motion!
▪ Two worlds - Two perspectives 
Both players will experience their environments in two different dimensions: 2D as well as in 3D - a first-time experience in the Rusty Lake universe!
▪ Cross-platform
As long as you can communicate with each other, you and your partner of choice can each play The Past Within on your preferred platform: Mac, PC and Nintendo Switch!
▪ Playtime & Replayability
The game contains 2 chapters and has an average play-time of 2 hours. For the full experience, we recommend replaying the game from the other perspective. Plus you can use our replayability feature for a fresh start with new solutions to all puzzles.

bluejetty:00096252:ios.description:
VIRAL SYNTH 2: T2x (Inspired by Virus TI2 Synth series)*
NEW T2x: Enjoy New Oscillators, Filters, Microtonality, Scales and more!
FULLY LOADED w/ 600+ presets by Analog Matthew, Brice Beasley, Electronisounds, DMT Cymatics, Moby Pixel, Wabi Sabi Waves, Red Sky Lullaby, and more
NOTE: This is a synth, and contains no hardware preset samples. All presets are completely original.
"HUGE! VIRAL SYNTH sounds like serious hardware!" - GarageBand Guide
"Amazing! Possibly my favorite iOS Synth of all time" - DJ Puzzle, iPad Music Reddit founder & Hardware Virus TI Owner
"So many inspiring presets, it's inspiring so many songs!" - Loopy Pro, Forum
Not imitation, it's Innovation! 
https://audiokitpro.com/viralsynth
FIRST AudioKit Synth app with Trance Gate, LFO Polarity, Triplets, and more!
Uses NEW Technology to sound more like Real Hardware Synth
VIRAL SYNTH gives you Access (see what we did there?) to 40+ classic waveforms inspired by Virus TI2!*
VIRAL SYNTH T2X:
• 64-voice, Retro VA-Synth
• Includes 48+ Virus TI2 inspired waveforms
• Advanced Synth Engine (including PWM, Osc Morph, and waveform shapes)
• Plus, Bonus XL exclusive samples, created by Analog Matthew (Not available anywhere else!)
• 3 Low-Pass Filter choices, New self-resonating T12 and T24 models
• Trance Gate, with routings to different OSC
• MICROTONALITY, World Scales, Western Scales
• Synth section features 2x Oversampled Oscillators
• 3 LFOs, with POLARITY! Fun Routings. LFOs can modify other LFOs
• Arpeggiator! Classic Hardware-style Arp, with extra features
• Vintage-style Step Sequencer that can be routed to specific layers
• A proper filter envelope ADSR, with visual feedback
• TouchPads! 2 fun assignable pads,
• Four-voice Unison PER Oscillator
++ 3 different Unison algorithms: Regular, HYPER, and BEAST!
Modeled sound: It's like a time-capsule. Imagine if there were iPads in 2009?
Complete with that Hardware VA sound that ruled the dance floors and stages
ADDITIONAL FEATURES:
• EPIC Glorious Reverb + Sparkle Verb option
• FX: Analog Tape Delay, Distortion, Phaser, Chorus, Crush, and more.
• On board "Record" button, no external hardware required
• Works with a MIDI Keyboard
• FM wild pitch drop controls! Modeled after digital VA-Synths, complete with vintage digital aliasing for old-school vibe! 
• Crazy aggressive distorted RING MODULATION – It's like robots talking, or fighting? You decide!
COOL:
• iPad version has "stacked" views for maximum onscreen control!
Tap the current Nav Button at the top to change the bottom view 
• This is a Premium App: No iAP, No Ads, No subscriptions!
Use as a plug-in in DAWs like GarageBand & Logic for iPad, Cubasis, AUM, and more!
* LEGAL NOTICES
This app has no affiliation or endorsement from Access Corporation. It is not a clone of the Virus TI2, or any other synthesizer. Nor does it use any Virus ROM or direct waveforms. The wavetables are legally different, and the names have been changed. While we were inspired by the sound and legacy of these iconic instruments, this is an original creation, built from the ground up. 
All product names, trademarks, and images mentioned are the property of their respective owners and are used only to describe the inspiration behind this app and for purposes of reference. Their inclusion does not imply any association, affiliation, or endorsement.
We sincerely respect the incredible work of Access in shaping music history.

bluejetty:00093156:ios.description:

Real-Time Tracking: Monitor your transfers in real-time, from initiation to completion.

Peer-to-Peer Currency Exchange: Exchange currencies with other users at competitive rates for added flexibility and savings.

Korrency is revolutionizing the remittance experience by providing a reliable, user-friendly, and secure platform that caters to the unique needs of African migrants. Stay connected with your loved ones across borders without the hassle and high costs associated with traditional money transfer services.
Download Korrency today and experience the future of international money transfers!

bluejetty:00062005:ios.description:
Beep beep! Welcome to the wonderful world of Alfie Atkins & friends. In this city builder game you help Alfie keep the world clean and use the recycled material to build roads, residential houses, shops, schools, parks and more! As the community grows you and Alfie help the citizens to do fun chores around the city. You get to clean windows, charge cars, go shopping, rake leaves, and even put out fires just like real firefighters. In return the citizens will show you love and you'll get richly rewarded. Loads of fun with 16 different mini-games (in the full version). 
There are no timers or stress elements so that kids can play in their own time. If they can't finish any certain game it still continues so that they never get stuck. It always works and it's always fun! Beep Beep Alfie Atkins is suitable for the whole family!
FEATURES IN THE FREE VERSION:
2 Blocks of Roads and Construction Sites: Explore various construction environments.
9 Mini Games: Engage in a variety of fun and educational activities.
2 Different Vehicles to Control: Drive, steer, and master different vehicles.
Helicopter Fun: Fly Alfie's helicopter from one landing pad.
UPGRADE TO THE FULL VERSION (one-time purchase):
Unlock the Entire Alfie Atkins World: Gain full access to all areas.
26 Vehicles and Counting: Control a wide range of vehicles, with more being added.
16 Exciting Mini Games: Enjoy additional games.
Helicopter Adventures: Fly from up to 10 helicopter pads.
New map feature, perfect for practicing navigation and boosting spatial understanding.
Please note that family sharing of in-app purchases aren't supported by Apple. So if you want to purchase the full version of the app and share it with family members please purchase the separate premium, full version, of the app available on the Appstore instead.
Alfie Atkins, Willi Wiberg, Alphonse, Alfons Åberg – the popular character created in 1972 by Swedish author Gunilla Bergström, goes by many names. He is one of our most famous Nordic children’s characters, known and loved by generations of children and parents through the best-selling series of books. Children from 3-9 will love the game whether or not they already know Alfie.

listings.name: Beep beep Alfie Atkins - Kids
listings.description:
Beep beep! Welcome to the wonderful world of Alfie Atkins & friends. In this city builder game you help Alfie keep the world clean and use the recycled material to build roads, residential houses, shops, schools, parks and more! As the community grows you and Alfie help the citizens to do fun chores around the city. You get to clean windows, charge cars, go shopping, rake leaves, and even put out fires just like real firefighters. In return the citizens will show you love and you'll get richly rewarded. Loads of fun with 16 different mini-games (in the full version). 

There are no timers or stress elements so that kids can play in their own time. If they can't finish any certain game it still continues so that they never get stuck. It always works and it's always fun! Beep Beep Alfie Atkins is suitable for the whole family!

FEATURES IN THE FREE VERSION:
2 Blocks of Roads and Construction Sites: Explore various construction environments.
9 Mini Games: Engage in a variety of fun and educational activities.
2 Different Vehicles to Control: Drive, steer, and master different vehicles.
Helicopter Fun: Fly Alfie's helicopter from one landing pad.

UPGRADE TO THE FULL VERSION (one-time purchase):
Unlock the Entire Alfie Atkins World: Gain full access to all areas.
26 Vehicles and Counting: Control a wide range of vehicles, with more being added.
16 Exciting Mini Games: Enjoy additional games.
Helicopter Adventures: Fly from up to 10 helicopter pads.
New map feature, perfect for practicing navigation and boosting spatial understanding.

Please note that family sharing of in-app purchases aren't supported by Apple. So if you want to purchase the full version of the app and share it with family members please purchase the separate premium, full version, of the app available on the Appstore instead.

Alfie Atkins, Willi Wiberg, Alphonse, Alfons Åberg – the popular character created in 1972 by Swedish author Gunilla Bergström, goes by many names. He is one of our most famous Nordic children’s characters, known and loved by generations of children and parents through the best-selling series of books. Children from 3-9 will love the game whether or not they already know Alfie.

bluejetty:00159360:ios.description:
BankSocial is a self-custody wallet and investing platform that lets you securely store digital assets, trade crypto, invest in stocks, and manage your financial life—all in one place. Your keys mean your assets. No middlemen. No vendor sprawl.
As the first multi-chain self-custody wallet with native Hedera support, BankSocial gives you seamless access to the Hedera ecosystem along with major blockchains and new investing capabilities.
The BankSocial app supports a diverse range of blockchains, distributed ledgers, and traditional markets, including Hedera, Bitcoin, Ethereum, and U.S. equities.
Do more with your assets
- Invest in stocks: Buy, sell, and track U.S. equities directly from your BankSocial wallet.
- Limit orders for stocks: Set your target price and let the system execute automatically.
- Robo Advisor (Early Access): Personalized, automated portfolio allocation built around your goals.
- Self-custody crypto management: Store, track, and transfer digital assets securely.
- Real-time price tracking: Live market data for crypto and stocks in one unified view.
- Your keys, your crypto: Protected with modern, quantum-safe cryptography and industry-leading security.
- Multi-chain support: Manage Bitcoin, BSL, XRP, Solana, DAG, Ethereum, Hedera, Polygon, and more, all in one wallet.
- Self-custody exchange: Buy and sell select cryptocurrencies while maintaining full control of your keys. Available where licensed and supported.
- Native HBAR staking: Stake HBAR to any eligible Hedera node directly from your wallet.
Tap into what’s next
- Early access to Carbon Card: A powerful spending experience built directly into your wallet.
- Seamless dApp interactions: Connect to decentralized apps across multiple ledgers.
- Programmable finance foundation: Built for speed, security, and ownership in the new financial stack.
Built to grow with you
We’re continuously adding new features, expanding blockchain support, enhancing security, and improving the investing experience across both crypto and traditional assets.

When dangerous cataclysmic events across the world coincide with your brother’s disappearance, you’re sent to a lost island on the Seekers mission of a lifetime! You’ll start a breathtaking adventure of solving challenging puzzles and riddles and playing detective games. Your investigation quickly turns dire when you find a dangerous criminal trying to destroy the worlds and your brother helping the enemy! Can you win in our hidden pictures games to save your brother and the worlds in time? Find out in one of our exhilarating game with point & click adventure!
· VISIT SEVERAL MAGNIFICENT WORLDS AND MEET THEIR MAGICAL INHABITANTS!
Travel from one world to another to find hidden pictures, help the local residents and get their help in return in our hide & seek game! Chase the villain and save your brother from his hypnotic influent before his deeds lead to a catastrophe for the entire world and the Seekers community!
· A NEFARIOUS TRICKSTER HAS BUSTED OUT OF A MAGICAL PRISON! 
Your Seeker’s help is needed again in the Bonus Chapter! Use your wits and intuition to find the object and track a runaway criminal with a powerful artifact!
· REPLAY YOUR FAVORITE HOPS AND MINI-GAMES, AND EARN ACHIEVEMENTS!
The Collector’s Edition provides a lot of bonuses which you won’t find in the standard version. Gather collections, play the Bonus Chapter, replay your favorite puzzles and hidden object games scenes many times!
· TONS OF ARTICLES, COLLECTIBLE CARDS, AND TOKENS TO FIND.
Learn more about the villain’s misdeeds while gathering interesting articles and posters throughout the game. Collect tokens and cards to buy animals for your Seeker’s zoo in our new hidden object games!
Download one of the most amazing free investigation games – Labyrinths of the World – Lost Island! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!

bluejetty:00164000:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00164000:ios.description:
Club Mahindra 
• Club Mahindra has been synonymous with good times and great vacations and now it has its own dedicated app to bring the travel enthusiasts even closer. The app will be a one-stop destination to provide the Club Mahindra patrons with all the information they would ever need regarding their stay.  
• Viewing information about resorts – Whether you’re in the mood for a holiday in the mountains or a coastal cruise, the app gives you detailed information about each of our resorts.  
• Requesting a Service to MR or Resort ops – Using the app, you can enjoy the convenience of requesting certain services at the resort. You can also get in touch with the Member Relationship team by calling them via the app itself. 
• To start with, one simply has to download and install the Club Mahindra app in their phone from AppStore Account and log in with their member id/email id. It is that simple to get started. The app is absolutely free to download.  
• The app facilitates easy navigation so planning a holiday is simple and quick. First, choose the dates of your holiday from the in-app calendar and mark your dates.  
• Next, scroll through your preferred destination and choose from the multitude of Club Mahindra resorts to book your stay for the duration. The app will also notify you about the various exciting deals and offers that the various resorts have from time to time so that you may get the best value for your money.  
• Club Mahindra understands that each family is different and they have their own special requirements. Any special requirement that you may have can be requested and included from the app itself.  
• The Club Mahindra app will enable you to book resorts and rooms instantly and all payments can be made directly via the app. All transactions will be done through a secure server and all your payment information will be strictly confidential.  
• EMIs or ASF payments can be done via the app itself.  
• The app will also allow the Club Mahindra members to share reviews and this would be done through the ratings option provided with the app 
• The Club Mahindra app allows you to Pre- Check in and this way you will be able to avoid the long queues when you are out vacationing with your family. Fill in all the required details through the app up to 48 hours prior to reaching the resort and once there, you can simply collect the keys and head straight to your rooms.  
• Spread the Joy – You’ve joined the Club Mahindra family. And you can invite your friends and relatives too to experience magical moments like you do, through the app itself and earn rewards!  
• Seeing all relevant notifications > Whether it’s an update about your bookings or the latest activities you can be part of at the resort, find out every detail through the app. 
• Update any details or information about your profile – Changed your contact number? Missed out on your preferred dining options? You can add it all to your profile through the app. 
In other words, your stay with Club Mahindra will bring you guaranteed joy. Forget about looking for hotels and accommodations every time you think of a vacation. Instead, we help you save time and effort so that you can dedicate all your energy and concentration solely on spending time with your family. 
To give us feedback about your app experience or to resolve any issue, please get in touch with us at 1860 210 1111 or email at MemberRelations@clubmahindra.com

Live in Washington (outside of Vancouver/Longview)? Download the Kaiser Permanente Washington app inst
bluejetty:00131147:ios.description:
Whether you're at home or on the go, the Kaiser Permanente app gives you a simple, secure way to manage your health — all in one place. 
Live in Washington (outside of Vancouver/Longview)? Download the Kaiser Permanente Washington app instead. 
With the Kaiser Permanente app, you can easily:
• Email your doctor’s office or Member Services with nonurgent questions
• Schedule, view, and cancel routine appointments and see information about past visits
• Fill or refill most prescriptions, check the status of a prescription order, and see a list of all your medications
• View your medical history, including allergies and immunizations, ongoing health conditions, and most lab test results
• Choose a doctor by browsing our online doctor profiles 
• Find facilities and pharmacies near you
• Get care in a way that works for you — online, by phone, or in person
• Access your digital membership card to check in for appointments, pick up prescriptions, and more
• Get personalized reminders and health information as soon as they’re available
Allows users to integrate with the Apple Health app to:
• Enter information about their health (e.g., glucose readings), so that it can be shared with their care team
• View information about their health (e.g., glucose readings)
To get started, download the app and sign in with your kp.org account. If you haven’t registered yet, you can also create your online account in the app.

*** Downloading this app is a 2-step process: the first step is a download of the app template, and the second step is a full download of app content. Please do not navigate away from the app until both steps have been completed. ***
The amount of clinical information currently doubles every 18 months and the pace is only getting faster. Stay up-to-date with the Merck Manual Professional app.
This useful medical reference app provides health care practitioners and students with clear, practical explanations for thousands of conditions in all major medical and surgical specialties. With many new features and enhancements, this app covers etiology, pathophysiology, and options for evaluation and treatment. 
The trusted Merck Manual Professional medical app offers:
• Thousands of topics written and updated regularly by more than 350 academic physicians 
• Photos and Illustrations of thousands of disorders and diseases
• “How to” Videos on numerous outpatient procedures and physical examinations. Concise instructional videos by medical experts on these key topics: 
 - Casting and splinting techniques
 - Orthopedic examinations
 - Neurologic examinations
 - Obstetric procedures
 - Outpatient procedures (including IV lines, tubes, catheters, dislocation reductions and more)
• Drug Reference Information* 
• Quizzes* check knowledge of medical disorders, symptoms, and treatments 
• Interactive Case Simulations* test ability to treat a specific patient over the disease course 
• Medical News and Commentary* covering the most current and important medical topics 
• Editorials* written by top medical experts 
*Internet access needed.
About Merck Manuals
Our mission is simple: 
We believe that health information is a universal right and that every person is entitled to accurate, accessible and usable medical information. We have a responsibility to protect, preserve and share the best current medical information to enable more informed decisions, enhance relationships between patients and professionals, and improve health care outcomes around the world. 
That’s why we are making the Merck Manuals available for free in digital form to professionals and patients around the world. No registration or subscription required, and no ads.

This mobile application is intended for Healthcare Professionals in the United States, its territories, Puerto Rico, and Canada only.
For more information please read the End User License Agreement at 
https://www.merck.com/policy/terms-of-use/merck-apps-home.html. 
For more information about our privacy practices, please see our privacy commitment at https://www.msdprivacy.com 
To report an adverse event with a specific Merck product, please call the Merck National Service Center at 1-800-672-6372.
For questions or help with the app, please contact merckmanualsinfo@merck.com

PEDOMETER + RPG!
Train your team of heroes as you exercise, the more activities the stronger your heroes become! Let’s take on the challenges, and embark on the journey of becoming the new best you! 
It has been 12 years since the Dark Force Took over Fitland. Villagers await the savior to return. Will you be the one to lead a team of heroes, defeat enemies and save them all?
KEY FEATURES:
* Walking RPG - Convert your steps into free energy and use them to level up heroes
* Sync steps - Uses steps from your phone or sync steps from your Fitbit
* Battlegrounds - Explore the Fitland map, fight monsters and save the kingdom
* Team of heroes - Collect and train different heroes, form your ace team
* Precious equipment and skins - Collect, upgrade precious weapons to make your team stronger
* Arena - Compete with other players and fight your way to the top
Please Note: Walking RPG is a free-to-play game, but some extra game items can be purchased for real money. You can disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

Walking RPG is also an Apple Watch game: it uses HealthKit to read your steps from Apple Watch. Make sure to grant all permissions when asked to authorize with the Health App to make it work.

bluejetty:00069809:ios.description:
The Toronto Sun is your trusted source for local news, politics, sports and entertainment. Create your custom feed so you don’t miss the latest from your favourite writers. Stay up to date throughout the day with breaking news in Ottawa, Ontario and around the world. Plus get the latest on the Toronto Blue Jays, Toronto Raptors, Toronto Maple Leafs, Toronto Argonauts and Toronto FC with the best sports coverage in Canada including scores, standings, highlights and commentary.
Features include:
• Stay connected to the best local news, sports, entertainment, commentary and beyond.
• Browse the Toronto Sun, Ottawa Sun, Edmonton Sun, Calgary Sun, The Province and Canoe brands seamlessly.
• You will be prompted to choose your preferred publications when you first open the new app, ensuring a curated news feed that aligns with your interests.
• Use the Discover tab to explore trending stories from Postmedia newsrooms across Canada
• Personalize your news experience by selecting topics, journalists and columnists you care about, so your feed will be filled with the content and perspectives you enjoy.
• As a registered user, you are recognized consistently across web and app platforms for a more cohesive experience.
Register to sample the wide variety of breaking news and special features — plus extensive photo and video coverage. Home delivery print subscribers receive unlimited access, included as part of their print subscription and can gain access by simply signing in with their existing account when prompted. If you’re not an existing print subscriber, you can easily subscribe to the app through the App Store for iOS devices.
Subscription details
• Monthly subscription cost: $5.99 plus applicable taxes
• Complete your subscription at the App Store for iOS devices. Payment will be charged to your account upon confirmation of purchase. 
• No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. 
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. 
• Account will be charged $5.99 each month within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. 
• Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal turned off by going to your Account Settings after purchase. 
Privacy policy: https://www.postmedia.com/privacy-statement/
Terms of use: https://www.postmedia.com/terms-and-conditions/
We appreciate and value your feedback. Please send any comments, suggestions or questions to: appfeedback@postmedia.com

- Uma experiência simples, direta e fácil de usar

bluejetty:00122950:ios.description:
This is Millennium's app, providing secure 24/7 access to your bank account. In addition to checking balances and transactions, it offers a wide range of operations and products. 
Plus, it comes with various user-friendly features to simplify your banking.
Here are some of them.
Open an account with Digital Mobile Key
Go paperless and open your Millennium account within minutes using Mobile Digital Key without the need for in-person visits.
MB WAY
Use MB WAY within the Millennium app to make mobile payments, send money to friends, and more.
Payments and Transfers
In the bottom navigation bar, you'll find these two quick options to make your everyday payments and transfers.
Apple Pay
Leave your wallet at home and make your secure payments with your iPhone or Apple Watch, using contactless technology.
StayON
With StayON, everything is centralized in one place: notification history, documents, pending transactions, Banco Mail, your account manager, and much more.
Apparte
Save money with goals using Apparte. Then set up automatic transfer rules, so you don't have to worry about a thing. You can also build your emergency fund.
Cards
All our cards now come with a digital twin version that you can use as soon as the card is approved in the app. And remember, the decision is instant.
Block cards
If you've lost your card or won't be using it for a while, you can block it in the app. When you're ready to use it again, just unblock it.
Installments
Split your credit card purchases starting from €100 into installments of 3, 6, or 9 months.
Data update with Digital Mobile Key
It's essential that you keep your personal details up to date to continue making transactions. You can update them in minutes using the Digital Mobile Key.
Direct debits
Edit or cancel your direct debits without having to go to an ATM.
Get salary paid at Millennium
We can assist you through the app and even provide a template email with your IBAN for your employer.
Salary advance
Want to get a salary advance on the 1st day of each month? Send us your application. If approved, and if you've already received a salary before, you'll receive that amount in advance on the 1st day of each month.
Privacy mode
Before entering the app, activate the option to hide balances and prevent prying eyes when you're in public.
Notifications
Get real-time notifications when your salary is deposited, when a direct debit is scheduled, when you make card payments, and much more.
Touch ID and Face ID
Use your phone's Touch ID or Face ID to log in to the app and authorize transactions.
Insurance
Get Médis health insurance, Médis Dental (only €9.90/month), Móbis car insurance, YOLO! life insurance, and ON/OFF travel insurance (for just €1.25/day).
Personal and auto loans
Skip the paperwork and apply for a personal or used car loan with an instant response.
“How Much Can I Borrow" calculator
If you're considering buying a home, use our "How Much Can I Borrow" calculator to quickly determine the loan amount you're eligible for.
Mortgage loan
Once you know how much you can apply for, start your mortgage loan application. You can now even submit and sign your application directly within the app.
Investments area
You can subscribe to investment funds, certificates, pension plans, and ETFs. If you prefer, you can also opt for Automated Investment starting from €30, and we'll take care of the rest.
Virtual Assistant
Questions about a feature, product, or banking concept? Our virtual assistant is here to help and can even carry out some operations at your request.
And there's much more waiting for you...
Install and explore all app features.

bluejetty:00165723:ios.description:
AI Video Generator: Bring Your Ideas to Life
Unleash your imagination and explore the future of video creation with our powerful AI tools. Whether it’s creating a stunning animation or reimagining your memories, AI Video Generator is your ultimate creative companion.
Create AI Videos
From photo-to-video to text-to-video, we make starting from scratch effortless and exciting. Be as creative as you want with AI-powered tools.
Transform Text Into Stunning Videos
With advanced AI technology, turn simple text prompts into visually captivating stories. Your imagination is the only limit.
Animate Still Photos
Breathe life into your favorite photos. From cherished memories to creative ideas, watch them transform into enchanting animations.
Add Fun Effects
Explore a range of playful effects to make your videos stand out:
• Levitate, Explode, or Squish Objects
• Money Rain, Business Jet, Vacation Vibes, and more
Weekly updates bring fresh effects, so there’s always something new to discover.
For Everyone
From storytellers to brands to everyday creators, this app is built for anyone with a vision. Design, animate, and mesmerize with ease.
Easy-to-Use Credit System
- You need a subscription to create AI Videos.
- Subscription Price: $7 per month, providing 50 credits (each credit allows you to generate one video).
- Additional Credits: If users exhaust their credits before renewal, they can purchase additional credits separately while the subscription is active.
- Features and Content: Unlimited access to all features and content offered within AI Video.
- Billing: Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly, or annually at the rate selected depending on the subscription plan.
- Payment: Charged to the Apple Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Auto-Renewal: Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Renewal Charges: Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost depends on the chosen package.
- Management: Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase.
Your Privacy Matters
We respect your privacy. User data is processed securely and deleted after use, ensuring your creations remain yours.

bluejetty:00062427:ios.description:
Math Duel - 2 Player Math Game
Challenge a friend or go solo! Math Duel is the ultimate split-screen math game for kids, students, and classrooms. Two players compete head-to-head on the same device, making math practice fast, fun, and competitive. Perfect for Schools and Home Learning. Used by teachers worldwide, Math Duel turns math drills into exciting duels. Customize difficulty for each player independently, ideal for differentiated instruction and personalized learning.
Why Kids and Teachers Love Math Duel:
- 1 or 2 players on one device, no extra hardware needed
- Split-screen mode built for tablets and phones
- Customizable equations for addition, subtraction, multiplication and division
- Adjustable difficulty per player, great for mixed-ability classrooms
- Positive reinforcement keeps students motivated
- Frustration-free design for all skill levels
- Trusted with over 1 million games played
Built for the Classroom, Fun Enough for Home.
Whether it's math fact fluency practice, a classroom warm-up, or friendly competition at home, Math Duel makes arithmetic engaging for all ages. Students sharpen mental math skills without even realizing they're learning.
Great for:
- Elementary and middle school students
- Teachers looking for EdTech tools
- Parents seeking educational games for kids
- Homeschool families
Have a feature idea? Share it directly with Erik, the developer, from inside the app!

bluejetty:00185672:ios.description:
Experience the nostalgic dot-aesthetic of classic RPG right in your hands in this story of adventure 
where children become adults and adults become children!
A century after the Apostles' War, a crisis looms over Hasla due to the sudden appearance of a mysterious woman, 'Sylunis', in the Hyro Forest. 
As the newly appointed Captain of 'Hero Town', you are the only one who can prevent Sylunis' conspiracy to free the Apostles sealed in the Soulstone.
Assist the apprentice goddess, Sera, save the goddesses and prevent the resurrection of the Apostles!
Experience the pixel action RPG unfolding in Hasla, "Crusaders Quest."
■ Puzzle? Action! Skill Block Match Play
Collect skill blocks and use them together!
Use heroes that create skill synergy to become stronger!
Simple yet strategic battle play
■ Dots, all dots! Retro aesthetic graphics
Loved for nearly a decade, the unique pixel art of Crusader Quest
Constantly pushing the boundaries of what can be expressed each year!
Filled with charming pixel art embodying cuteness, splendor, grandeur, and wit
Even with stunning and captivating illustrations...!
■ Choose and enjoy events and battles in your own style
Zero pressure for guild play! Battle Delegation available!
Gameplay featuring single-player-centric battle contents and events,
Choose and proceed according to your play style
■ A relatively easy-to-collect RPG
No need for duplicate heroes for hero growth
Paid currency obtainable in Arena every week
Maximum hero growth achievable within a day
■ Familiar events, innovative events
Familiar events like world raid bosses, consecutive boss battles, deal competitions, random team competition
Mini-game events like rhythm games, bread tycoon, maze finding, bingo, fishing
Experimental events like stock market, prize lottery, auction, roguelike dungeon
■ Delivering the latest information through official channels
⊙ Official website: https://cq-official.online/en
⊙ Official Twitter: https://twitter.com/CrusadersQuest
⊙ Official YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCnhS12kc_rJiiPtz0kXHtcQ
■ Minimum device specifications
iOS 11 and above / RAM 2GB and above
■ Device app access permission guide
We request the minimum optional permissions required for smooth gameplay.
You can refuse to grant optional access rights, but please understand that this may restrict the use of certain features.
[Optional Access Rights]
- Notifications: Used when receiving push notifications
- Photos/Camera: For attaching screenshots when reporting bugs and inconveniences to the Customer Support Center
[How to change access rights]
Settings > Crusader > Set each access right
