bluejetty:00138879:ios.name: Northern Lights Tracker
bluejetty:00138879:ios.summary:
Never miss the northern lights again.
Northern Lights Tracker tells you whether tonight is worth going out, when to look and where to go. It turns live NOAA space weather data into one clear aurora chance for your exact location.
Tonight
bluejetty:00138879:ios.description:
Never miss the northern lights again.
Northern Lights Tracker tells you whether tonight is worth going out, when to look and where to go. It turns live NOAA space weather data into one clear aurora chance for your exact location.
Tonight at a Glance
• Aurora chance for your location, updated live
• A clear verdict, from "Go look now" to "Not tonight", with activity, solar wind, moon and cloud factors
• Best viewing time and the best 2-hour window
• Current Kp index and a 3-day Kp outlook
• Search any place and save your favorite spots
• Share tonight's forecast with friends
Aurora Alerts
Get notified when the aurora is likely where you are. Choose a chance alert, a Kp alert, a storm early warning up to 24 hours ahead, or a solar wind (Bz) alert with your own threshold. Chance and solar wind alerts wait until it is dark, and quiet hours keep your nights undisturbed. Storm and solar wind alerts can arrive as time-sensitive notifications, with your choice of sound or vibration. You decide how often the app checks: every 15, 30, 60 or 180 minutes.
Lock Screen, Widgets and Apple Watch
• Home Screen widgets with chance, Kp, peak time and a 12-hour chart
• Lock Screen widgets
• Live Activity: follow tonight's chance on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Apple Watch app with your chance and Kp at a glance, plus watch face complications
• Ask Siri for tonight's aurora chance without opening the app
Space Weather in Detail
• Hour-by-hour aurora chance for the next 24 hours
• Tonight's Sky: sunset, dark hours, sunrise and moon phase, including polar night and midnight sun
• Cloud cover from Apple Weather
• Solar wind: Bz, total field, speed and density, with charts for the last 3 hours
• 27-day Kp outlook to plan trips weeks ahead
Map and Best Places
• Live map of the NOAA aurora oval. Long-press anywhere to check the chance there
• 15 top aurora destinations ranked by tonight's chance, with distance from you: Tromsø, Svalbard, Rovaniemi, Inari, Sodankylä, Reykjavik, Kiruna, Abisko, Jokkmokk, Fairbanks, Anchorage, Yellowknife, Churchill, Murmansk and Nuuk
• Open any spot in Apple Maps or Google Maps for directions
Aurora AI

Are you tired of being nagged by your relatives about your dating life? Do you want to find someone who shares your South Asian culture and values? If so, you need Vinita - the new name in town for South Asian dating.
HOW WE WORK OUR MAGIC
In the desi community especially, singles are often criticized by relatives and parents. Vinita is on a mission to put your dating life back into your own hands! Our app enables you to take up the driver's seat.
* We’re a ‘smart’ app... meaning the more you swipe, the better we can understand what you’re into.
* Our interface is designed to grant you a flawless swiping experience so you can focus on the choice at hand.
* Our profile features allow you to recognize potential attributes fast with every swipe. We’re free to download & use!
MESSAGE FROM OUR FOUNDER
“Welcome to Vinita, the dating app that celebrates your South Asian heritage and helps you find your perfect match. Vinita is named after my beloved aunty, who was always eager to arrange dates for me with eligible singles. She inspired me to create this app, where you can connect with people who share your culture, values, and preferences. Vinita is more than just a dating app, it’s a community of South Asians who are looking for relationships in all forms.”
Contact: Support@vinita.io
Privacy Policy: https://vinita.io/privacy

bluejetty:00175684:ios.description:
Polar Flow: Your Personal Sports, Fitness, and Health Companion
The exclusive app designed to maximize the potential of your Polar devices.
Key Features:
Activity Tracking: Monitor your daily activity, steps, calories burned, and distance to stay motivated throughout the day.
Training Analysis: Dive deep into your workouts with detailed data on heart rate, speed, pace, distance, power, and more. Understand the impact of each session and optimize your training routines.
Sleep Insights: Discover how well you sleep with advanced sleep tracking. Get feedback on sleep stages and quality to improve your rest and recovery. See how sleep boosts your day and track skin temperature changes.
Training Load & Recovery: Understand how your training sessions strain your body and get recommendations on recovery time to prevent overtraining.
Manage your watch and profile: Customize and manage your Polar device, Sports profiles for different activities, Routes, and Training Targets.
Wireless Syncing: Automatically sync data from your Polar devices for real-time updates, notifications, and other insights.
Stay Connected: Connect your profile and sync your data with Strava, TrainingPeaks, Adidas, komoot, and many other services.
Why Choose Polar Flow?
Personalized Guidance: Receive personalized feedback and guidance and understand your progress.
Comprehensive Ecosystem: Integrates seamlessly with Polar watches, heart rate monitors, and more for a holistic experience.
User-Friendly Interface: Navigate your data effortlessly with our intuitive and clean design.
Notification support: Your Polar watch will receive the same notifications as your phone screen—incoming calls, messages, and app notifications.
Secure and Private: Your data is safely stored and protected, giving you peace of mind as you focus on your journey.
Polar Flow app allows you to share some of your wellness data with Apple Health. This includes details of your training, your heart rate, and steps.
Please note Polar Flow app is not intended for medical or diagnostic use.
Get Started Today!
Download Polar Flow and unlock the full potential of your Polar devices. You can find more info at https://www.polar.com/flow
Connect with us!

Facebook: www.facebook.com/polarglobal
YouTube: www.youtube.com/polarglobal
Find out more about Polar products at https://www.polar.com/en/products

bluejetty:00175827:ios.summary: DivTracker is the best dividend tracker which helps you track and visualise your dividend income. Forget adding up your stock dividends manually or checking your statements every day. With DivTracker, you can see your entire portfolio in on
bluejetty:00175827:ios.description:
DivTracker is the best dividend tracker which helps you track and visualise your dividend income. Forget adding up your stock dividends manually or checking your statements every day. With DivTracker, you can see your entire portfolio in one place, analyze your dividend income, and view upcoming and estimated dividend payouts. DivTracker also has you covered with the latest news on companies you own shares of. Notifications will be sent to your phone on key dividend events like payment dates.
DivTracker will save you countless hours of work when tracking your dividend income portfolio. This app is best for dividend income investors who hold stocks for cash flow.
Features:
● Link your US brokerage accounts eliminating the need for manual updates to your holdings.
● View your daily, monthly and annual dividend income.
● Dates and confirmed amounts for your upcoming dividends.
● See your holdings in one place. We support thousands of US, LSE, TXE and ASX equities.
● Track multiple portfolios.
● Notifications about key events.
● See when a stock pays you next. We also give an estimated date and amount if a stock has no confirmed dividends yet.
● Export your dividend payouts to calendar
● Home Screen widgets
● If a company has suspended or cut its dividend, we'll show it and adjust your income.
● Easy way to see your monthly dividend distribution.
● Stay up to date with the latest news on your companies.
● Find stocks going ex-dividend soon with the Ex-Dividend Calendar.
● Customize how you want to see your dividend data.
● Offline mode supported. You can access your data even when your device is offline.
● All your data is synced across your devices via iCloud or your DivTracker account.
Dividend Tracker is a tool created by dividend investors for dividend investors.
-----------------------------------
If you choose to purchase DivTracker Pro or Ultimate, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at the confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions by going to your account settings on the App Store after purchase. Current DivTracker subscription prices start at $1.25 USD/month, and one-month and 12-month packages are available. Prices are in U.S. dollars, may vary in countries other than the U.S. and are subject to change without notice. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during the active subscription period. If you don’t choose to purchase DivTracker Pro or Ultimate, you can simply continue using DivTracker for free with a limited number of holdings.
Privacy Policy: https://divtracker.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://divtracker.app/terms

The My Delhaize app is your go-to solution for quick and easy shopping, both online and in your favorite Delhaize store! With the My Delhaize app, you always have your SuperPlus card with you.
Download it now and discover all the benefits
bluejetty:00179508:ios.description:
The My Delhaize app is your go-to solution for quick and easy shopping, both online and in your favorite Delhaize store! With the My Delhaize app, you always have your SuperPlus card with you.
Download it now and discover all the benefits of SuperPlus:
* Enjoy all promotions in-store and online, plus exclusive online offers.
* Activate great e-Deals and Flash e-Deals.
* Earn points and redeem them for products or discounts from partners, or donate them to a charity of your choice.
* Always enjoy 10% off fresh fruit and vegetables with Nutri-Score A&B, as well as 10% off Delhaize Plant-Based products, regardless of Nutri-Score.
* Order your groceries 24/7. You can collect them or have them delivered to your home the day after you place your order.
New: SuperPlus Families. Enjoy even more benefits for you and your family, like 10% off all products with Nutri-Score A&B, 10% off when you buy three or more identical Delhaize-brand products, 30% off delivery charges, and big discounts on our Partner deals, including theme parks, cinemas and wellness. All this for just €12 a year.
Are you at Delhaize? Make the most of your SuperPlus card! Scan your SuperPlus card at the checkout directly from your My Delhaize app to enjoy all discounts and promotions. Did you know that you can also use your SuperPlus card at the self-checkout? Thanks to the scanner in the My Delhaize app, you can also scan a product’s barcode. This gives you access to additional information, such as the Nutri-Score. Super handy!

Vencedor do Prêmio iBest
Melhor do Brasil - 2021 | 2022 | 2023 | 2024 | 2025
A Bíblia Sagrada disponibilizada no seu dispositivo móvel permite de um modo simples e prático o acesso a palavra de Deus em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento.
Tudo em um único lugar:
- Devocional em áudio
- Comentário bíblico em áudio Rota 66 do professor Luiz Sayão
- Dicionário Bíblico
- Planos de Leitura
- Hinários
- Estudos em vídeo
- Anotações
- Marcadores de texto
O que Bíblia diz
Uma seção criada especialmente para esclarecer aqueles assuntos que mais te trazem dúvidas.
Compartilhe a palavra de Deus no WhatsApp e Facebook.
Escolha entre as traduções disponíveis, aquela que mais lhe agradar:
- Almeida Revista e Corrigida (ARC)
- Almeida Revista e Atualizada (ARA)
- King James Atualizada (KJA)
- Nova Tradução na Linguagem de Hoje (NTLH)

bluejetty:00114208:ios.description:
This game features a clean, easy-on-the-eyes realistic style with a gentle touch of oil-paint brush texture—richer colors, more depth, and a soothing, feel-good puzzling experience.
[Game Features]
-Restore Complete Pictures by Combining Cards
 At first, the cards may look random—but each one has a single perfect spot. The moment it snaps into place is insanely satisfying!
-Simple, Intuitive Swipe Controls
 Just swipe to move cards around. Once two cards connect, they lock together so you can drag them as one “group”—smooth, effortless, and super satisfying.
-Addictive Chain Snaps
 Line up multiple cards and trigger a “snap-snap-snap” chain reaction as they lock in at once. That rush is hard to resist—you’ll always want one more round.
-Perfect for Any Skill Level & Any Time
 Easy for beginners, rewarding for experts who love optimizing their moves and layout. Great for commutes, quick breaks, or relaxing before bed.
-Tons of Themes, Constantly Updated
 Flowers, landscapes, animals, cozy everyday objects—new themed photos are added regularly, so every session feels fresh.
[How to Play]
-Swipe to Move Cards
 Swipe on the screen to drag cards wherever you want.
-Snap & Move Connected Cards Together
 When a card is placed correctly, it “clicks” into position and connects. Connected cards can then be moved as a single group.
-Watch Out for Overlaps & Size Changes
 If a smaller card is placed on top of a larger one, the larger card may temporarily shrink. Keep an eye on size changes and combine cards carefully to avoid confusion.
Simple to play, yet surprisingly strategic: plan your layout, avoid blocking key pieces, and set up satisfying chain snaps. If you love jigsaw puzzles, card-style organizing, or just want a relaxing and addictive brain game—give it a try today!

bluejetty:00042038:ios.description:
Welcome to Unexpected TV, where every twist and turn is just the beginning of an unforgettable journey! Unexpected TV is not your average reality television network; we specialize in surprising our viewers with captivating stories that defy expectations.
From the heart-pounding excitement of "Unexpected Adventures," where ordinary people embark on extraordinary quests around the globe, to the heartwarming moments of "Unexpected Connections," which explores the bonds formed in unlikely circumstances, our network celebrates the unpredictability of life.
At Unexpected TV, we believe in showcasing the unexpected in all its forms. Whether it's the dramatic transformations on "Unexpected Makeovers," the thrilling challenges of "Unexpected Challenges," or the emotional rollercoaster of "Unexpected Reunions," each show promises to keep you on the edge of your seat.
Our commitment to authenticity and innovation ensures that every episode delivers genuine emotions and jaw-dropping surprises. Join us on Unexpected TV and explore a world where every moment is a revelation, and every story is an adventure waiting to be discovered. Get ready for the unexpected—it's all here, only on Unexpected TV!
To access all features and content you can subscribe to Unexpected TV on a monthly or yearly basis with an auto-renewing subscription right inside the app.* Pricing can vary by region and will be confirmed before purchase in the app. In app subscriptions will automatically renew at the end of their cycle.
All payments will be paid through your iTunes Account and may be managed under Account Settings after the initial payment. Subscription payments will automatically renew unless deactivated at least 24-hours before the end of the current cycle. Your account will be charged for renewal at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current cycle.Cancellations are incurred by disabling auto-renewal.
Terms of Service: https://unexpectedtv.vhx.tv/tos
Privacy Policy: https://unexpectedtv.vhx.tv/privacy

bluejetty:00033183:ios.description:
◇◆◇About Touhou LostWord◇◆◇
Words are going missing, but nobody knows why... The Lost Word Incident has taken over Gensokyo. Explore Gensokyo to resolve the incident with Reimu, Marisa, and the huge cast from Touhou Project!
Taking place in Gensokyo, Touhou LostWord is a derivative work based on Touhou Project, officially licensed by Team Shanghai Alice.
◇◆◇Characters◇◆◇
Reimu Hakurei:
Also known as Hakurei Shrine Maiden, Eternal Shrine Maiden, Wonderful Shrine Maiden of Paradise. 
She is a human who lives at Hakurei Shrine.
Marisa Kirisame:
Also known as Western Magician of the East, Strange Magician, Ordinary Black Magician.
She is a human who lives in the Forest of Magic.
Meet the various characters from the Touhou universe, including Yukari Yakumo, Youmu Konpaku, Alice Margatroid, Reisen Udongein Inaba, Remilia Scarlet, Patchouli Knowledge, Sakuya Izayoi, and many more! 
◇◆◇Game System◇◆◇
Use your characters' Spell Cards to fight in exciting battles of bullets! 
You can power up your favorite characters and create a party of up to 6. 
Choose between 3 voices for every character and dress them up in a variety of different costumes!
◇◆◇Participating Artists◇◆◇
Akitsu Mikami, Arata Toshihira, Capura.L, Eretto, Fruit Punch, Girotin, Hagiwara Rin, Hinayuki Usa, Hiura R, Mikeou, Minamura Haruki, Morinohon, Mottun*, Natsume Eri , Ragho no Erika, Rui Tomono, Sakura Hiyori, Sakuragi Ren, Sakurazawa Idumi, Shinia, Socha, Takehana Note, Tanaka Shoutarou, Tomioka Jiro, Umeckiti, Yamadori Ofuu, Yano Mitsuki, Yumeno Rote, Yuuki Keisuke, and more!
◇◆◇Participating Musicians◇◆◇
AramiTama, Butaotome, Cajiva's Gadget Shop, flap+frog, Foxtail-Grass Studio, Hachimitsu-Lemon, COOL&CREATE, Melodic Taste, O-LIFE.JP Tokyo Active NEETS/Kokyo Active NEETs, and more!
©Team Shanghai Alice
©GOOD SMILE COMPANY, INC. / NextNinja Co., Ltd.

bluejetty:00160839:ios.description:
Fontify – The Ultimate Cool Fonts App for iPhones & iPads
Unleash your creativity with Fontify, the go-to app for stylish fonts, cool symbols, and personalized kaomojis. Whether you’re designing your Instagram bio, enhancing TikTok captions, or adding flair to WhatsApp and Facebook chats, Fontify offers everything you need to express yourself in a fun and unique way. The perfect tool for anyone looking to stand out with cool fonts on their iPhone or iPad!
Top Features of Fontify
• Vast Font Collection
Discover an extensive library of fonts, each designed to match any mood or style. Whether you’re looking for cool fonts to spice up your Instagram bio, elegant typefaces for TikTok captions, or playful options for iMessage chats, Fontify has it all!
• Kaomojis & Symbols
Stand out from the crowd with expressive kaomojis and special symbols that add personality to your posts. Perfect for customizing your social media profiles and making every message a little more fun.
• Create Custom Fonts
Get creative by designing your own custom fonts using Unicode characters. It’s the ultimate way to ensure your text is completely unique, making Fontify more than just a typical fonts app.
• Easy to Use on All Platforms
Whether you’re using fonts for iPhones, fonts for iPads, or switching between multiple apps, Fontify’s easy-to-use interface allows you to copy and paste your customized text effortlessly into Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, Facebook, and more.
• Works Everywhere
Fontify isn’t limited to just one app. You can use our stylish fonts and symbols across any platform—whether it’s WhatsApp, iMessage, Facebook, or other apps. With cool fonts that work everywhere, your text will always stand out!
Why Choose Fontify?
Fontify isn’t just another fonts app; it’s your personal toolkit for digital expression. Whether you’re looking to create a bold Instagram bio, craft unique captions for TikTok, or send personalized messages, Fontify offers the perfect combination of fonts art, symbols, and customization options to make your text unforgettable.
How to Use Fontify:
1. Type the text you want to customize.
2. Choose from a wide selection of cool fonts, symbols, or kaomojis.
3. Copy your customized text.
4. Paste it anywhere—on Instagram, TikTok, Twitter, Facebook, WhatsApp, iMessage, or any other app!
Take your creativity to the next level with Fontify, the best app for fonts art and custom fonts!

bluejetty:00029847:ios.description:
GYMSHARK66 IS BACK: CHANGE YOUR LIFE IN JUST 66 DAYS
Gymshark66 is a 66-day commitment to getting your goals. All you’ve gotta do is choose three daily habits that suit you. Then tick them off, every day, for 66 days.
HOW DO I TRACK MY HABITS?
Download the Gymshark Training App (it’s completely free), sign up to Gymshark66 and choose your three daily habits. Whether it’s 30 mins at the gym or a 30-min walk. 10 mins of mindfulness or 10 pages of a book. And, after 66 days, you’ll have created 3 new habits that are proven to last a lifetime. Not bad, hey?
1000'S OF FREE WORKOUTS
We’ve made our Training App even better to help you along the way. It’s got 1000’s of free workouts, led by your fave Gymshark Athletes, which can be done pretty much anywhere! We’ve even included running plans this year for all your Forrest Gump’ers.
FREE WORKOUTS DESIGNED BY PERSONAL TRAINERS AND ATHLETES
Download the Gymshark Training App for exclusive free workouts led by our team of personal trainers and athletes. There's a better way to train, and it's just an app away.
Your training is unlimited with our entire library of free workouts and plans, so you’ll never feel stuck in a workout rut again. With new workouts added each week, you’ll feel constantly inspired and motivated.
TRAIN YOUR WAY
Customise and personalise your own training plan with moves to suit you and your workout goals. Our free training app has both free gym workouts & home workouts for you to use whenever and wherever you want to workout. Find a fitness coach that works for you or explore the library today.
Searching for the perfect free workout has never been easier. Sort and filter based on the equipment, body part, creator or type of training you feel like. From HIIT to lifting and stretching to functional training, inspiration and motivation comes easy with our training app. Simply search and go.
Create home or gym workout routines that work for you, your goals and your lifestyle. Or check out our top 10 workouts of the day and always know what's trending in the training world. Whatever your goal, at the gym or home, there's a free workout for you.
FOR EVERY LEVEL
Whether you're looking for your 100th workout or just starting out, there's a free workout to suit every level. So, work your way through and see just how much you can achieve. Track every rep, set and workout to monitor your progress and unlock your full potential. After all, your only competition is you.
ONE WORKOUT TODAY, ANOTHER TOMORROW
Spotted the perfect workout for tomorrow with one of our personal trainers? Save your faves and come back to them later. Or if you're halfway through and have something else to do, you can resume a plan at any time. Our training app allows you to make your workout work for you.
WORKOUT AS YOU GO
With free workouts on the go, you can find inspiration using the equipment in the gym, or train from home just using bodyweight exercises. Get inspired by athlete workouts and creator plans or go ahead and customise your own workout by picking your favourite moves from our A-Z library.
FREE WORKOUTS FROM HOME
With a whole host of fitness coach led workouts you can do from anywhere; training is as easy as staying at home. Designed to take up minimal space and with no equipment needed, pick the at-home workout that works for you.
INTEGRATE WITH APPLE HEALTH
Sync your workout data with the Apple Health app to better track your health and wellbeing.
DOWNLOAD THE FREE GYMSHARK TRAINING APP NOW
The Gymshark Training app is a place for the entire conditioning community - all abilities, routines and all training styles. Because even when you train your way, we train together. Download the Gymshark free training app today.

bluejetty:00119038:ios.name: Fleetio Go - Fleet Management
bluejetty:00119038:ios.summary: Put the power of fleet management software in your pocket with Fleetio Go. Fleet managers, drivers, technicians and other fleet personnel can collaborate on critical fleet maintenance tasks and manage everything from DVIRs to work orders in
bluejetty:00119038:ios.description:
Put the power of fleet management software in your pocket with Fleetio Go. Fleet managers, drivers, technicians and other fleet personnel can collaborate on critical fleet maintenance tasks and manage everything from DVIRs to work orders in a single app. Built for speed and optimized for productivity, Fleetio Go helps teams stay ahead of the daily needs of their fleet vehicles and equipment.
*A subscription to Fleetio Manage is required to use this app.
Features:
- Submit inspections (DVIR) and report issues directly from your phone
- Scan barcodes to lookup vehicles and equipment instantly
- See the most relevant information to you on a personalized Home screen
- Access contacts associated with your fleet remotely
- View asset profiles
- Receive service and renewal reminders
- Receive push notifications for important issues and reminders
- Manage mobile Work Orders
- Review maintenance history
- Log fuel-ups and see fuel history
- Add and view photos, documents & comments
- View and change security & permissions
- Manage multiple fleets
Fleetio Go empowers drivers to be more productive by providing an easy way to inspect vehicles, report issues and log fuel from a smartphone or tablet. Users can stay on top of vehicle maintenance with helpful reminders and maintenance history as well as provide details via photos and documents. Technicians can view vehicle issues and manage work orders from anywhere, minimizing downtime.
Using comments and flexible user permissions, teams can customize access, facilitate meaningful conversations and successfully collaborate on fleet management tasks. Users can also manage multiple fleets within Fleetio Go.
About Fleetio:
Fleetio helps fleets run like well-oiled machines and proactively collaborate on and manage daily fleet tasks. Rather than using spreadsheets or outdated software, Fleetio enables fleets of all sizes to manage everything in a modern, intuitive system. Fleetio offers simple and comprehensive management of all day-to-day fleet operations and total cost of ownership data while also providing fuel card and GPS integration, all-inclusive support, unlimited account users and online and mobile accessibility.

bluejetty:00090584:ios.description:
قرآننا ..
يحتوي التطبيق على:
- المصحف الشريف (بجميع المميزات والتي منها : التحكم بألوان المصحف - نسخ الآيات - مشاركة الآيات - العلامات المرجعية - الاستماع - التفسير- الانتقال الى مصحف التهجد)
- ترجمة معاني القرآن الكريم بأكثر من 35 لغة مختلفة
- تلاوات القرآن بأكثر من 250 قاريء في العالم الإسلامي
- تفسير القرآن ب 8 تفسيرات مختلفة
- إعراب القرآن الكريم
- ورد القرآن .. حيث يمكنك إضافة أكثر من خاتمة (خاتمة تلاوه - خاتمة تهجد - خاتمة حفظ)
- قصص القرآن الكريم (24 قصة مرسومة وملونه للأطفال مع تشغيل الصوت وكذلك أسئلة في نهاية كل قصة لتثبيت المعلومه لدى أطفالكم)
- الأذكار .. أكثر من 50 ذكر صحيح من أذكار الكتاب والسنة النبويه مع إمكانية تشغيل الصوت لكل ذكر والتكرار لكل ذكر
- مصحف التهجد .. يمكنك الان وبسهولة استعمال هذا المصحف في التهجد ليلاً حيث أنه يمكن التحكم في الحركة الدائمة للمصحف والتحكم في الايقاف وسرعة الحركة وحجم الخط.
- التفسير الصوتي .. أينما كنت ليلاً أو نهاراً يمكنك استخدام التفسير الصوتي والاستماع إلى تفسير آيات كتاب الله.
- محفظ القرآن الكريم .. يساعدك على قراءة وحفظ القرآن الكريم بطريقه صحيحه.
- أجمل المقاطع .. اخترنا لكم أجمل المقاطع الصوتيه والفيديو لمشاهير قراء العالم الإسلامي
- المصحف المعلم للأطفال .. يمكنك اختيار الشيخ المفضل لطفلك لحفظ آيات كتاب الله.
معاني القرآن .. يمكنك البحث بالآية أو السورة لفهم معاني آيات كتاب الله؟
- أسباب النزول .. يمكنك من معرفة أسباب نزول سور القرآن الكريم.
فضل القرآن الكريم .. يمكنك معرفة فضل قراءة القرآن وفضل سور القرآن وفضل حفظ القرآن
التكرار .. يمكنك تكرار مقطع من القرآن الكريم بالقاريء الذي تفضله من أكثر من 250 قاريء عدة مرات وبالسرعة التي تفضلها.
قرآننا .. جمعنا لكم تطبيقات القرآن الكريم في تطبيق واحد

bluejetty:00170431:ios.description:
Red Fire is a turn-based strategic wargame set in East Asia between the years 1950-1975. Take command of land, air, and naval forces of dozens of nations including the US, USSR, China, Taiwan, North and South Korea, North and South Vietnam, France, Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines.
Experience Korean War, Vietnam War, and many other conflicts - both historical and fictional. Command squadrons of more than 500 types of aircraft, from biplanes to multirole fighter jets. Control the seas with more than 500 types of warships including submarines, battleships and aircraft carriers. Leverage new tools like surface-air missiles, air-air refueling tankers, attack helicopters, and missile cruisers to dominate the battlefield.
Red Fire is powered by a detailed and realistic simulation of Cold War-era air, naval, and ground combat. Fight against an intelligent AI which constantly adapts its strategy to ensure every game is challenging and unique. Challenge a friend in hotseat multiplayer (pass-and-play).
Red Fire contains no in-app purchases or ads of any kind, and an internet connection is not required to play. Buy the game once and get access to all current and future content.

Please cooperate with us in making our service better!

bluejetty:00047698:ios.description:
* Please note, there is a brand new sequel to this game now available - search the App Store for "Football Chairman Pro 2"! *
Build your own football empire!
Create a football club from scratch, starting as a tiny non-league team, and see if you can make it through seven divisions to the very top.
See your players win play-offs, cup competitions and eventually conquer Europe!
Hire and fire managers, develop your stadium, negotiate transfers, contracts and sponsorship deals... while keeping the fans and the bank manager happy.
Over three million users have downloaded the Football Chairman games since launch, and they have won multiple app store awards, including the Apple Editor’s "Best of 2017", "Best of 2016", "Best of 2014" and "Best of 2013".
Football Chairman Pro is the newest and most in-depth version of the game, which is updated every season free of charge with the very latest data!
The Pro app retains the fast-paced, addictive gameplay that made the earlier versions so popular, while adding a whole host of new features, including:
- Take over other clubs: become the chairman of your favourite team
- All domestic and European cup competitions
- Load datapacks featuring teams from all over the world
- Or use the free online data editor to create your own!
- No time limits or adverts, and all in-app purchases are 100% optional
- Manage merchandise sales, pitch condition and backroom staff
- Sign superstar players and boost your club's worldwide reputation
- Pick your club's local 'derby' rivals
- Full youth squad; watch your young players develop
- Players have personalities, playing styles, and happiness and fitness
- Managers use different formations and playing styles
- Offer win bonuses, promotion bonuses, and fine players for indiscipline
- New challenge scenarios to test your skills
- 50 achievements to aim for, including 15 brand new ones
- New club records to beat
- Improved 3D stadium graphics
- Pre-season friendlies
- Redesigned interface
- Plus thousands of tiny improvements to the gameplay.
Good luck... you'll need it!
- Want to try a free version of the game before downloading this one? Search the app store for 'Football Chairman'.

bluejetty:00134496:ios.name: Home Budget Tracker & Planner
bluejetty:00134496:ios.summary:
Organize finances with Shareroo — the go-to budgeting and task-management app used by 1,000,000 couples, families, and roommates across the globe who budget, plan, and share expenses and tasks.
JOIN RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLDS WHO:
• Organiz
bluejetty:00134496:ios.description:
Organize finances with Shareroo — the go-to budgeting and task-management app used by 1,000,000 couples, families, and roommates across the globe who budget, plan, and share expenses and tasks.
JOIN RESPONSIBLE HOUSEHOLDS WHO:
• Organize your budget with monthly spending limits & real-time balance tracking
• Customize income and expense categories & share without linking bank accounts
• Assign and manage to-do tasks with customizable completion conditions
• Collaborate with up to 10 people on financial & household tasks
• Seamlessly delegate household chores & responsibilities
• Save by splitting expenses & managing receipts easily
• Enhance coordination with deadline notifications
• Share shopping lists, to-do lists, & grocery lists
• Get automatic backups & settlement options
• Achieve financial freedom together
[ YOUR BUDGET PLANNER ]
• Share expenses and income easily to get a comprehensive view, with beautiful pie charts per category or family member.
• View statistics instantly to see a complete picture of your financial life.
[ RECEIPT MANAGEMENT ]
• Capture receipts by snapping photos and utilize OCR to extract the total amount.
• Tailor receipt categories for precise tracking.
[ BUDGET PLANNING MADE SIMPLE ]
• Set monthly budgets to know your remaining amount and modify the closing day of the month.
• Calendar view and sorting options enable you to control your shared living expenses effortlessly.
[ CUSTOMIZATION & SHARING ]
• Customize expense and income categories at your convenience.
• Divide expenses flexibly: equal, ratio, or amounts.
• Automatically make settlements with your partner.
[ TO-DO LISTS ]
• Collaboratively craft grocery lists, allowing your partner to seamlessly add items. 
• Create events or reminders for your partner.
• Get notified when a deadline is set, enhancing task coordination and sharing within the household.
• Stay updated with notifications whenever a purchase is completed.
[ FLEXIBLE EXPENSE SHARING ]
• Use Home Spending Tracker: Shareroo for common wallet management, money splitting, and settlement of advances.
• Seamlessly delegate household chores and tasks to make living together more harmonious.
[ FAQ ]
Q1: What can I do with a shared budget in Shareroo?
A1: Share expenses with couples, families, or roommates and handle split bills and settlements in one flow. It goes beyond simple sharing by taking you from tracking to settling in the same app.
Q2: How is this different from simply sharing one budget account?
A2: Some apps only let others view one account. Shareroo records each person’s share and advances, then supports member‑to‑member settlements.
Q3: Do I need to link bank accounts?
A3: No. You can share and manage expenses without linking bank accounts.
Q4: How many people can collaborate?
A4: Up to 10 people can collaborate. It works for couples, co‑living, roommates, and friend groups.
Q5: Can I split expenses flexibly?
A5: Yes. Split by equal, ratio, or exact amounts, then settle with one tap.
Q6: Can I set budgets and see remaining balance?
A6: Yes. Set a monthly budget and see your remaining balance.
Q7: Does it support receipt capture and OCR?
A7: Yes. Take a photo to auto‑input receipts and reduce manual entry.
Q8: Can I share to-do and grocery lists?
A8: Yes. Share shopping lists and to‑do lists to manage household tasks together.
Q9: Is there automatic backup?
A9: Yes. Automatic backups are available for your data.
Q10: Who is it best for?
A10: Couples, families, roommates, or friends who want to share expenses without linking bank accounts. It’s also a good fit if you need multiple budgets or 3+ people in one group.
EULA:
https://shareroo.firebaseapp.com/shareroo_termofuse_v01_en.pdf

bluejetty:00022944:ios.description:
"All in all, this is exactly what I needed for traveling, and if you travel a lot, something like this is essential." - The Common Ryan
Packing List Checklist is an easy to use app that provides you with a checklist of all the important things to consider and pack before traveling.
——— SHARE & COLLABORATE ON YOUR LISTS (Premium feature) ———
Travel just got smarter and more social. Share your travel lists with family, roommates, or friends, and pack together in real time!
——— PICK SUGGESTED ITEMS ———
Get up and running with very little effort by using our Pick Suggested Items feature.
You will be able to pick items from these categories: Essentials, Accessories, Baby, Backpack / Carry On, Beach, Camping, Clothing, Electronics, Food, Healthcare, Makeup, Shoes, Toiletries and many more!
That's it: your list will be ready without any typing involved!
——— SYNC YOUR LISTS (Premium feature) ———
Created your list on your iPad but want to check it on your iPhone? Got a new iOS device and want to see your lists there?
With iCloud sync we've got you covered: your lists will be with you on all your iOS devices as long as you are using the same Apple ID in them.
——— SET REMINDERS (Premium feature) ———
Want to make sure that you are not leaving anything behind? Just set up a reminder, get a notification at the right time and relax!
——— MANAGE ITEM QUANTITIES (Premium feature) ———
Set the quantities for your Packing List items.
——— EDIT THE SUGGESTED ITEMS (Premium feature) ———
Make the suggestions yours: rename, add or remove items in the suggested-items templates, and every new list will start from your own version.
——— APPLE WATCH APP (Premium feature) ———
Check off items right from your wrist. Your lists stay in sync with your iPhone through iCloud.
——— EXPORT YOUR LISTS (Premium feature) ———
Export any list as a .tpl file to back it up or send it to a friend, or as a .csv file to open it in a spreadsheet. Anyone can import a .tpl list, even without Premium.
——— PRO LIST TOOLS (Premium feature) ———
Sort items alphabetically, select all suggested items at once, duplicate or merge categories, and uncheck every item with one tap to reuse a list.
——— TO DO & TO PACK ———
After a lot of research we reached the conclusion that the best way to go through your travel preparation is to distinguish the actions that you need to take before and during travel from the things that you need to pack.
That’s why each list has two sections: To-Do & To Pack.
——— CREATE YOUR OWN CATEGORIES ———
Organize your items by grouping them into different categories.
You will be able to create as many categories as you need, and you can pick an emoji to better differentiate them.
——— REUSE YOUR EXISTING LISTS ———
This is one of the best kept secrets of every seasoned traveller. Keep refining your list, and reach sorcerer-level packing skills. You’ll soon forget why you ever packed for your travels differently in the past!
——— TERMS & PRIVACY ———
Terms of use (https://packingli.st/terms)
Privacy & Policy (https://packingli.st/privacy)
EULA (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/)
——— QUESTIONS OR FEEDBACK? ———
We love hearing from you and we read every single email you send us!
Have suggestions? Please, feel free to reach us at info@packingli.st

bluejetty:00060703:ios.name: Apple Books
bluejetty:00060703:ios.summary: Apple Books is the best place to discover, read and listen to entertaining and informative books and audiobooks. Browse through top charts, personalised recommendations and expertly curated collections in the Book Store and Audiobook Store,
bluejetty:00060703:ios.description:
Apple Books is the best place to discover, read and listen to entertaining and informative books and audiobooks. Browse through top charts, personalised recommendations and expertly curated collections in the Book Store and Audiobook Store, or use search to easily find the perfect read or listen, no subscription needed. Track what you’ve read and want to read, and set your own reading goals—all in one app and across all your Apple devices.
Explore millions of books and audiobooks
• Check out today’s bestsellers, free books and special offers for readers of all ages, plus personalised recommendations.
• Explore collections curated by the Apple Books team to find your next book or audiobook in your favourite genres, from mysteries and thrillers to romance, history, self-development and kids.
• Sample any book or preview an audiobook to start enjoying the first few pages for free.
• Keep track of the books and audiobooks you’re interested in with your Want to Read list.
Customise your reading experience
• Choose from a selection of reading themes, which include a variety of fonts and background colours.
• Make your book easy to read by adjusting line height and letter spacing to your preference.
• Use Auto-Night Theme and adjust your screen brightness to make reading more comfortable for your eyes.
• Enable vertical scrolling to move continuously through books instead of flipping pages.
Make reading a habit with Reading Goals
• Set a reading goal to encourage yourself to read daily.
• Track reading streaks and how many books you’ve read this year.
• Get reminders and coaching to help you achieve your reading goals.
Share with your whole family
 • Family Sharing lets you enjoy your books and audiobooks with your favourite people. Invite up to five family members.
Apple CarPlay
• Designed with safety in mind, the Audiobooks app in Apple CarPlay allows you to listen to audiobooks while driving.
• Large buttons make it easy to start and stop, rewind or fast forward, and the simplified library helps you find your next audiobook while still keeping your eyes on the road.
Apple Watch features
• Use the Audiobooks app on Apple Watch to get back to your recent audiobooks or browse your library right from your wrist.
• Use the Watch app on iPhone to choose which audiobooks to download to your Apple Watch.
Requirements & store availability
• iPhone requires iOS 12 or later.
• iPad requires iPadOS 12 or later.
• Content varies by country or region and may not be available on all devices.

Subscribe in-app today and enjoy access to new issues as they are released, beautifully optimised for iPhone, plus our archive of back issue content.

This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will include access to all regular issues in the app for the duration of your subscription. Access is lost once your subscription expires.

– Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings in the App Store after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period.
– Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
If you are a current Inc. subscriber, access to the Inc. Magazine app is provided to you at no additional cost for as long as you are an existing subscriber. 
Start experiencing Inc. on your mobile device today!
--------------------

bluejetty:00131266:ios.description:
The ultimate destruction game is here!
Introducing "Evolving Bombs", the exciting mobile 3D game where you merge, multiply, and evolve several types of bombs thrown from an airplane to demolish your target! 
Start with a simple dynamite stick and progress through increasingly powerful bombs like the hand grenade, RPG missile, and culminates in the ultimate MOAB.
To win, you need to carefully choose which bombs to use and when to use them. You can even merge and multiply your bombs to make them stronger and more powerful. You must use strategy and think ahead to be successful!
As you progress through the game, you'll encounter various tasks, each with a different objective. In some of them, you'll need to defend yourself against enemy planes by shooting them down and giving air support to your own team. In others, you'll have to free hostages and defend your base against enemy attacks.
The game offers a unique approach to the traditional "evolution" game genre, where players are tasked with evolving their weapons. Merge and multiply your bombs to create a more powerful arsenal and unleash them on unsuspecting targets.
The game's focus is on evolving the bombs, but it also includes other strategic elements, such as artillery, air defence 3D , and attack. You'll need to carefully control your mob and utilize your weapons to successfully complete each task and progress further into more challenging levels.
Play vs your friends, challenge them in this addictive game.
So what are you waiting for? Start playing today and see how high you can evolve your bombs!
To opt out of CrazyLabs sales of personal information as a California resident, please visit the settings page within this app. For more information visit our privacy policy: https://crazylabs.com/app

bluejetty:00145456:ios.summary:
My Diary: Your Personal, Private, and Fun Journal!
Welcome to My Diary, the ultimate app for capturing daily moments, tracking moods, and keeping memories secure and vivid. With My Diary, writing your thoughts, feelings, and experiences ha
bluejetty:00145456:ios.description:
My Diary: Your Personal, Private, and Fun Journal!
Welcome to My Diary, the ultimate app for capturing daily moments, tracking moods, and keeping memories secure and vivid. With My Diary, writing your thoughts, feelings, and experiences has never been more enjoyable or secure.
Privacy First: Your journal entries are entirely private. With PIN lock and fingerprint lock options, you can rest assured that your personal diary remains secure, locked, and only accessible to you. Your private diary is your sanctuary, and My Diary ensures it stays that way.
Attach Photos: Make your diary entries more vibrant and memorable by attaching photos. Capture daily moments and add them to your notes, making each journal entry a visual memory. Photos can bring your stories to life, letting you relive those moments whenever you look back.
Customizable Themes: Express yourself with beautiful journal themes. Choose from various backgrounds, fonts, and colors to personalize your diary. Whether you prefer a light mode for a fresh look or a dark mode for a more subdued vibe, My Diary has you covered. Journal themes are key to making your diary truly yours, and with endless options, you can change your theme as often as you like.
Daily Journal: Writing in your diary daily is a breeze. Keep track of your thoughts, emotions, and experiences. Whether it's a happy or challenging day, My Diary helps you capture every moment. Consistent journaling helps you reflect on your daily life and understand your journey better. Make it a habit, and see how it transforms your outlook.
Mood Tracker with Emojis: Track your mood daily with our fun emoji mood tracker. Visualize your emotional journey over time and better understand your feelings. Emojis are a simple and effective way to express your emotions, making mood journaling fun and engaging. See how your mood fluctuates and gain insights into what influences your feelings.
Year in Pixels: Get a visual representation of your year with our year in pixels stat. Add your mood each day and watch as a colorful mosaic of your year forms. This unique feature allows you to see patterns and trends in your emotional health, making it easier to understand and improve your well-being.
Stats and Insights: Gain insights into your writing habits and mood patterns. Our stats feature provides a detailed look at your journaling journey, helping you understand yourself better. See how often you write, what moods dominate your entries, and how your emotions evolve over time. These insights are valuable for personal growth and self-awareness.
No Data Sent to Servers: Your privacy is our priority. We do not send any of your private journal data to our servers. Unlike other apps, My Diary ensures that your personal information remains strictly confidential and under lock.
** Why Choose My Diary? **
- Secure and Private: Multiple options (PIN lock, fingerprint lock) ensure your diary is private. Your private thoughts deserve the best protection, and My Diary delivers just that.
- Daily Writing: Encourage daily journal habits with a user-friendly interface. Daily writing helps you stay connected with your thoughts and emotions, fostering personal growth.
- Mood Tracking with Emojis: Fun and interactive daily tracking of your emotions. Emojis make it easy to record how you feel, making mood tracking a delightful part of your journal routine.
- Attach Photos: Add pictures to your notes, making memories vivid and detailed.
- Customizable: Beautiful themes, fonts, and colors let you personalize your diary. Customization options make a journal more enjoyable and reflective of your personal style.
- Insightful Stats: Understand your journal routine and mood trends with detailed stats. These insights help you see trends and make informed decisions about your emotional health
---
Read our full Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy:
https://mydiary.habitics.net/privacy
https://mydiary.habitics.net/terms

bluejetty:00188023:ios.description:
Awsat Trader (GTN) Mobile app offers investors the ability to trade in GCC and US financial markets in real-time market data anytime, anywhere. Investors will have fast and convenient access to their online trading portfolios where they can monitor transactions, view holdings, P&L and detailed fundamental and technical data in real-time. Awsat (GTN) Mobile app is available in English and Arabic languages.
Current Awsat (GTN) investors can access the Awsat (GTN) Mobile app using their existing login credentials.
Main features:
• Order placement (buy-sell-amend-cancel-market and limit orders)
• Account and Portfolio summary, Market depth, Time and sales 
• Intraday and historical charts (fast loading)
• Trading alerts 
• Deposit, withdraw, transfer cash
• Symbols Quotes, performance snapshot
• Top stocks (gainers, losers, most-active)
• News and announcements (real-time)
• Status panel (trading status, portfolio valuation)
• Order list (view recent orders, search historical orders)
• Custom and Smart watch lists
Other salient features:
• Watch-list chart to analyze the market compared with average volume and percentage change
• Watch-list grid to place orders rapidly
• Global Market Summary to monitor price movement of key market Indices, Commodities and Currencies
• Ability to select either a Call option or a Put option to get in to an Option contract
• Bi-lingual (English or Arabic)
• High security (OTP based)
To access this application and begin trading online you will need a Awsat account.

bluejetty:00157010:ios.description:
Built to be paired with our MW75 Neuro LT smart headphones, the Neurable App gives you real-time insights into your brain’s performance, helping optimize your cognitive health over time. Learn how to enhance focus, think more clearly, strengthen mental resilience, and lower brain age, one data point at a time. 
Neurable App Features:
**Optimize Your Day**
Start your day with a Cognitive Snapshot. Check your Mental Recovery score to see how well-rested and ready you are to take on the day.
**Level Up Your Focus + Lift Brain Fog**
Improve your concentration habits with Focus Sessions and Neurable’s Rocket Game. Quantify your Cognitive Speed, shedding light on when you’re experiencing cloudy thinking.
**Build Mental Endurance + Banish Burnout**
Push your cognitive limits and strengthen mental stamina. Prevent burnout before it starts by monitoring your Cognitive Strain and taking personalized Brain Breaks.
**Future-Proof Your Cognitive Health**
Monitor your Brain Age with weekly reports. Discover small habits to increase your brain’s flexibility and resilience over time. 
**Personalized Data, Personalized Insights**
Understand your own brain and maximize your potential with Cognitive Coach. Real insights about your cognitive state and how to optimize, every day.
What Neurable users are saying: 
“Apple's AirPods Pro 3 aren't the only headphones that integrate health-tracking features into audio devices. But while Apple focuses on calories, steps, and heart rate, Neurable's second-generation MW75 Neuro LT headphones track your focus, mental recovery, and cognitive strain.” – ZDNet
"The MW75 Neuro LT does not try to control your brain. It gives you a dashboard for it. You get a realistic view of when to push, when to pause, and how to structure your day so work feels less like a grind and more like a plan. bluejetty:00044720:ios.description:
**2022 - Find your Happy Place** - Apple
**MindFi is a perfect app for every aspiring meditator.** - Forbes
We train our bodies to get fit and stay healthy. Why not train our minds to be more resilient, focused, and energized? MindFi is a personalized wellbeing toolkit that fits in your pocket: enjoy access to the resources, tools, and support you need to achieve complete “mind fitness”.
DISCOVER YOUR BEST SELF
Check in on your wellbeing with clinical-grade scientific assessments and discover entirely new sides of you. Based on the WHO-5 framework, we analyze your mental wellbeing, moods, and physical health data from wearables to personalize recommendations for you.
CONNECT TO A WIDER COMMUNITY
Join private group therapy sessions or start a conversation in our forums. Moderated by qualified experts, they’re a great way to immerse yourself in topics like productivity, relationships, and stress.
GET TIPS DIRECTLY FROM EXPERTS
Get tips and tricks from qualified professionals that you can implement into your daily living. Our weekly curated videos and live classes cover all the important details while still fitting neatly into the blank spaces in your day.
EXPLORE SELF-CARE RESOURCES
From short haptic breathing exercises to longer guided meditations that fit into your day, there’s no shortage of self-care tools on MindFi. Listen during meals or a commute, or use our Focus Timer to practice the Pomodoro technique while working.
EXPERIENCE REAL IMPROVEMENTS
We employ a scientifically-grounded approach to instil healthy habits, mindfulness, and wellbeing awareness. Our advisors include a Harvard-trained psychiatrist, an ex-Apple Distinguished Technologist and clinical psychologists from University of California, San Diego's Medical School.
ABOUT MINDFI
Headquartered in Singapore, MindFi is the wellness provider of choice for Fortune 500 companies, fast-growing startups, and corporations across Asia Pacific.
We believe that mental fitness is the next health revolution and are passionate about bringing mind training to a wider audience with a secular and scientific method.
MINDFI PREMIUM
Unlock MindFi Premium and take a step towards your best mind today. Subscriptions auto-renew. Prices below are based on the US App Store, and will change depending on where you are.
$5.99 billed monthly
$59.99 billed annually
$349.99 Lifetime subscription
If your workplace sponsors your use of MindFi, you can get complimentary access to many of our premium features.
MINDFI TERMS
You can subscribe and pay through your iTunes account.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
This app integrates with the Apple Health app. Sync your activities to Apple HealthKit and track your progress all in one place. You’ll see “Mindful Minutes” in the Mindfulness section.

bluejetty:00186010:ios.description:
For everyone around the world who wants to draw and animate, freely and without pressure.
ibisPaint is a full-featured illustration and animation app for smartphones and tablets, with over 500 million cumulative downloads across the series.
"Drawing looks hard" — this app is made especially for people who think that. A creative experience that doesn't compromise, an interface simple enough to use without hesitation, and a comfortable familiarity that grows the more you use it. ibisPaint keeps serving as an easy entry point for anyone to start "drawing," while continually expanding what's possible — from a single illustration to frame-by-frame animation, and on to videos with background music and audio.
This app is the ad-free version of ibisPaint X. Unlocking all features additionally requires purchasing Premium Membership (an in-app purchase); in that case, downloading ibisPaint X and purchasing Premium Membership there works out cheaper.
With over 130,000 brushes, 30,000+ materials, 3,000+ fonts, 86 image filters, 46 screentones, 27 layer blending modes, vector tools, a reference window, radial and symmetry rulers, animated filters, and an AI Disturbance feature, ibisPaint packs in serious functionality that rivals PC illustration software. It's a one-stop app that goes beyond drawing illustrations — into animation production, and even recording and sharing your creative process as a time-lapse video. It's chosen by people of all ages, countries, and experience levels around the world.
*Drawing Tutorial YouTube Channel
We post lots of videos on how to make the most of ibisPaint. Please subscribe!
https://youtube.com/ibisPaint
*Supported Digital Styluses
https://ibispaint.com/stylus/supported_digital_stylus.jsp?platformType=1
*About Purchase Plans
https://ibispaint.com/lecture/index.jsp?no=26
* If you do not cancel auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the free trial ends, you will be automatically charged upon renewal.
*About App Access Permissions
This app may access various device features to provide the service and improve usability. No access permission is required to use this app — all of the following are optional. You may decline any of these optional permissions. Even if declined, the app's core features remain available, but some features that require the relevant permission may be limited.
•Photos/videos in your photo library
 To import artwork files and images, and to save the artwork files, images, and videos you create
•Microphone audio input
 To connect and communicate with supported peripherals such as digital styluses
•Bluetooth communication
 To connect and communicate with supported peripherals such as digital styluses
•Push notifications
 To deliver notifications related to your artwork, app update information, and important announcements
*Questions & Bug Reports
We're unable to respond to questions or bug reports left in reviews. Please contact our support desk below instead.
https://ssl.ibis.ne.jp/en/support/Entry?svid=25
*ibisPaint Terms of Service
https://ibispaint.com/agreement.jsp

bluejetty:00151834:android.summary: Welcome to Arrow Maze - Escape Puzzle! Ready for a relaxing brain challenge? This is the ultimate arrow escape experience. Dive into a world of colorful arrows and intricate grids designed to test your problem-solving skills. Our unique log
bluejetty:00151834:android.description:
Welcome to Arrow Maze - Escape Puzzle! Ready for a relaxing brain challenge? This is the ultimate arrow escape experience. Dive into a world of colorful arrows and intricate grids designed to test your problem-solving skills. Our unique logic puzzle offers hours of calm, focused fun.
💡 How to Play This Arrow Game
Your goal is simple: clear the grid. This is a classic escape puzzle scenario, but with a twist! Each level presents a maze of arrows. You must tap away the arrows in the correct sequence to make them fly off the board. An arrow can only move if its path is completely clear. Think ahead! This is the key to mastering this arrow game.
🌟 Key Features
- Hundreds of Levels: Engage with many variations of the core arrow game challenge.
- Pure Calm Gameplay: No timer and soothing visuals for a true wiggle escape atmosphere.
- Intuitive Controls: Just tap away the arrows to start the sequence!
- Develop Core Skills: Improve logic, planning, and forward thinking with our great problem solving games.
- Helpful Hints: Stuck? Use a hint to safely highlight the next arrow in this escape puzzle.
- Intuitive Design: Clean graphics enhance the relaxing feel of these arrow games.
🧠 Boost Your Brain Power
Our game is more than just fun. It’s daily training for your mind. It significantly sharpens your attention and helps you improve your long-term planning skills. If you enjoy deep solving games and escape puzzles, you will love the strategic depth here. 
✨ Designed for Relaxation
Forget the stress. This is a truly calming escape puzzle. There is no timer! Enjoy the clean, peaceful graphics and take all the time needed to devise the perfect strategy. Our arrow games are built for tranquility. If you enjoy the mindful focus required in a wiggle escape challenge, you’ll find that the process of watching the arrows fly away is incredibly soothing.
🧩 Master the Logic
Every successful sequence requires sharp logic. Plan the entire order of taps, ensuring each exiting arrow frees the way for the next one. This is pure, satisfying problem-solving. Can you find the perfect path? Tapping a blocked arrow costs a life, adding a layer of risk to these captivating problem solving games. To win, you must carefully manage your limited attempts in this complex arrow escape.
🏆 The Ultimate Arrow Escape
If you love highly strategic solving games or a great wiggle escape challenge, download this game now! Master the art of the arrow escape. Ready to tap away the stress and clear the grid? Start your journey with our arrow games today!

bluejetty:00123967:ios.name: Infinite Word Search Puzzles
bluejetty:00123967:ios.summary: Infinite Word Search earns its name in this classic, free word search game that features over 300+ categories of word find puzzles to choose from! Each category has multiple levels of difficulty and multiple game modes, for continuously fre
bluejetty:00123967:ios.description:
Infinite Word Search earns its name in this classic, free word search game that features over 300+ categories of word find puzzles to choose from! Each category has multiple levels of difficulty and multiple game modes, for continuously fresh content. There are almost endless free word puzzles! Simply choose the category you find most interesting and start your search. Find words by tracing your finger over the letters, either by moving up, down, left, right, diagonal, and even backwards! Words are hiding everywhere in our puzzles. To keep things more interesting we created several different word search modes in which to solve puzzles. We put YOU in control of the type of gameplay you would like to experience!
In the Progression game mode, test your word search skills as you hunt your way through thousands of puzzles, with varying levels of increasing difficulty. If you prefer a more casual experience, try out Infinite Mode and solve each word search puzzle at your own pace. Infinite Word Search provides you plenty of ways to enjoy word puzzles, so don't feel like you're locked into playing it only one way!
If you're interested in competitive play, Infinite Word Search Puzzles also includes a MULTIPLAYER game mode! You can now play word search games with friends or you can have us select random opponents for you, in real time! You better be quick in this multiplayer mode, though, because it's a race to see who can find the most words!
How to play a multiplayer Infinite Word Search game:
*Quick Match - With no log in required, quick match will allow you to immediately jump into a game with a random opponent! Sign in to Facebook to save your progress and show your opponents who's boss!
*Play word searches with friends - By logging into Facebook you can directly challenge your friends in head to head word search battles! Live at the top by earning more points than your friends!
*Leaderboards - Multiplayer wins will be counted on the new "Multiplayer Wins" leaderboard. If you're a player who logs in via Facebook, you will be able to also participate in the Premium Multiplayer Leaderboard. Can you beat your friends and rise to the top? How about the world?
Enjoy a virtually unlimited amount of single and multiplayer Word Search Puzzles, with Infinite Word Search!
Unlimited Access Subscription
Infinite Word Search offers a $7.99 weekly subscription that gives the user access to all current and future categories. In addition, the weekly subscription also gives the user +90 seconds on all progression puzzles, +20 highlighters, 2 keys for Infinity Mode, unlimited Daily Challenge resets, and will remove all ads.
Payment of $7.99 will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free 3 day trial. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Your subscription may be managed by you, by going to your iTunes account settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription to Infinite Word Search before your free trial ends.
By subscribing or purchasing, you agree to our Privacy Policy and License Agreement.
Privacy Policy: https://randomlogicgames.com/privacy_policy.php
License Agreement: https://randomlogicgames.com/license-agreement.php

bluejetty:00038498:ios.description:
Play your best set every time. LiveTrackz gives you loops, drone pads, and a rock-solid metronome in one performance-ready app. It’s built for worship teams, bands, and solo musicians on stage.
Now fully rebuilt in V3: a new audio engine with seamless, uninterrupted transitions between loops, a stunning redesign, and Ableton Link support to sync with the rest of your rig.
What's New in V3:
• Seamless Transitions: Our rebuilt audio engine moves between loops and variations with zero gaps and zero dropouts. Flow through your setlist without ever breaking the groove.
• Song Sections & Variations: Find verse, chorus, and bridge variations per track and switch between them live.
• Drone Pads: Lush ambient pads in every key. Fill the space between songs, underscore moments, and glue your set together.
• Built-In Metronome: A precision metronome powered by the same audio engine as your loops - your whole band locked to one reliable tempo.
• Ableton Link: Sync tempo wirelessly with Ableton Live, Logic Pro, additional LiveTrackz instances and other Link-enabled apps on your network.
• Full Offline Mode: No Wi-Fi at the venue? No problem. Access your downloaded library, setlists, and pads completely offline.
• Smarter Library: A personalized "For You" section, plus more filter options to sort through loops.
• EQ & Audio Controls: Shape your sound with output EQ, audio normalization, and expanded routing options for any stage setup.
• A Fresh New Look: A beautiful liquid glass design that's easier to read on a dark stage and faster to navigate mid-set.
Everything You Already Love:
• 3000+ Loop Library: High-quality loops across genres: gospel, worship, R&B, afropop, and more.
• Request Free Loops: Can't find it? Request custom loops free with your subscription*.
• Mix Your Sound: Adjust individual track levels, tweak percussion, and create your mix exactly how you want it.
• Shared Setlists: Build setlists, share them with your band via invite links, and keep everyone on the same page.
Whether you're leading Sunday worship, gigging with your band, or practicing at home, LiveTrackz is the tool to keep you in time and in control.
Download LiveTrackz and hear the difference.
Subscription:
• After the free trial period, a subscription is required to access loops.
• Monthly and yearly options are available. Switch or cancel anytime in Settings → Account → Manage Subscription.

*Free loop requests are available to all app subscribers

Stay ahead of the rain with PredictRain, the world's most precise rain forecast app developed by the team behind PredictWind. Built for those who rely on accurate rain predictions, PredictRain combines advanced AI modeling and intuitive tools to support better decision-making.
Designed for outdoor enthusiasts and professionals, PredictRain delivers rain forecasting that is reliable, efficient, and built for practical use.
Why PredictRain?
Pinpoint Accuracy: AI Rain delivers ultra-precise 4-hour forecasts, updated every 10 minutes and refined with real-time radar data for your exact location.
Real-Time Alerts: Get instant notifications when rain is headed your way in the next hour, so you can adapt quickly and stay one step ahead.
Smarter Planning: View accumulated rainfall over hours or days to better plan your activities and understand how wet the ground will be for your work or adventure.
Proven Reliability: PredictRain combines eight global forecast models with localised radar to improve accuracy where it matters most.

AI Rain: AI-powered 4-hour rain forecasts with location-specific precision.
Multi-Model Forecasts: Compare eight models for greater reliability.
Rain Radar: Visualise real-time rain movement with customisable overlays.
Satellite Imagery: Combine cloud cover and rainfall data for full context.
Climate Data: Access historical rainfall trends for seasonal and location-based planning.
Rain Alerts: Receive tailored, instant notifications based on incoming rainfall.
Lightning Tracker: Monitor global lightning activity with real-time strike classification.
Accumulated Rainfall: Track total expected rainfall over hours or days for better planning.
Plan Smarter with PredictRain
Whether you're preparing for fieldwork, travel, or outdoor events, PredictRain supports more informed decisions with localised rain forecasts, historical data, and real-time alerts.

bluejetty:00074388:ios.summary:

myTracks records your GPS tracks for any occasion — a stroll through the city, a road trip, your daily commute, or a hike in the mountains. No account, no sign-up, no ads. Your data stays priva
bluejetty:00074388:ios.description:
Log every journey — on iPhone or Apple Watch.
myTracks records your GPS tracks for any occasion — a stroll through the city, a road trip, your daily commute, or a hike in the mountains. No account, no sign-up, no ads. Your data stays private on your device and syncs seamlessly via iCloud whenever you need it across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
RECORD & EXPLORE
Capture your tracks and enrich it on the go: drop named waypoints at highlights, snap photos that link directly to the track, then review everything on OpenStreetMap or Apple Maps. OpenStreetMap maps can be downloaded for offline use — no internet connection required.
DIARY MODE
Enable it once — and never think about it again. myTracks automatically creates one track per day in the background, every day. No manual start or stop, ever. It's battery-friendly and always running quietly, keeping a complete record of wherever you go.
APPLE WATCH
All key stats — distance, elapsed time, current altitude, and a live map — are right on your wrist. Start or stop recordings, add waypoints, and record tracks entirely from your Apple Watch, even without your iPhone.
CUSTOMIZE YOUR COCKPIT
Build your own dashboards by choosing from a variety of widgets. Display exactly the stats that matter to you, laid out the way you want them.
FEATURES
• Record GPS tracks with iPhone or Apple Watch
• OpenStreetMap (with offline maps) and Apple Maps
• Waypoints and photos during recording
• Customizable Cockpit views with configurable widgets
• Live Activites
• Export as GPX, KML, KMZ, or ZIP — or open directly in other apps
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac
• Battery-saving Diary Mode for automatic daily tracking
• Ad-free — no tracking, no interruptions
FREE TO USE
myTracks is free to download with optional Premium features.
——
NOTICE: Continuous GPS use — including background and standby tracking — can significantly reduce battery life.
LANGUAGES: German · English · French · Japanese · Spanish · Simplified Chinese
TERMS OF USE:
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00097068:android.description:
Step into a calm and charming world where emojis align, patterns reveal themselves, and every match brings a soft spark of satisfaction.
Pair Pop: Solitaire Match offers a relaxing visual puzzle experience wrapped in cute designs, gentle flow, and simple yet rewarding interactions.
There’s no rush and no pressure—just the quiet joy of discovering hidden connections and watching the board clear in a smooth, satisfying rhythm. Each level invites you to slow down, observe carefully, and enjoy the moment when everything clicks into place.
Relaxing & Easy-to-Play
Play at your own pace with intuitive tap and swap controls.
Group emoji cards that share a hidden visual connection—whether it’s color, expression, shape, or a subtle little detail you might miss at first glance.
Rearrange, think ahead, and clear the board step by step in a calm, cozy flow.
A Gentle Layer of Logic
Every puzzle is a small visual challenge.
Look closely, spot clever patterns, and plan your moves with care.
The difficulty grows naturally, keeping your mind engaged while maintaining a soothing, stress-free experience.
Cute Visuals & Satisfying Interactions
Bright, expressive emojis bring every level to life.
Each correct group creates a clean, pleasing pop as tiles disappear.
Watch the board transform from scattered to perfectly organized in a calming rhythm that feels both rewarding and peaceful.
Features You’ll Love
• Relaxing emoji-based visual puzzle gameplay
• Simple tap-and-swap controls
• Hidden visual connections that train focus and observation
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels
• Helpful hints when you need a little guidance
• Smooth animations and satisfying feedback
• No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle enjoyment
Whether you’re taking a short break or settling in for a cozy play session, Pair Pop: Solitaire Match offers the perfect balance of relaxation and mental stimulation.
Sharpen your focus, enjoy the adorable emojis, and experience the simple joy of finding the perfect match.
Download now and start popping the perfect pairs. ✨🧩💛

bluejetty:00149986:ios.name: Shapa
bluejetty:00149986:ios.summary: Shapa is not a diet and exercise program - it's unique platform that pairs a numberless scale with a user-friendly app to motivate you toward healthy lifestyle changes. You'll get a tailored program based on your personality, habits, and en
bluejetty:00149986:ios.description:
Shapa is not a diet and exercise program - it's unique platform that pairs a numberless scale with a user-friendly app to motivate you toward healthy lifestyle changes. You'll get a tailored program based on your personality, habits, and environment to help you achieve long-term weight management success.
Measure Progress Not Weight:
No more love-hate relationship with your scale. It's normal for weight to fluctuate daily, and the way traditional scales are designed actually hinders your progress.
Get a More Accurate Sense of Your Health:
Instead of seeing your weight, our system uses smart algorithms to tell you your Shapa Color and your Shapa Age, truer metrics of your actual health.
Personalized to You:
Shapa analyzes your unique personality, preferences, environment, habits, and lifestyle. As a result, your Shapa apps recommends personalized activities called Missions that are right for YOU.
Features:
Shapa Color and Shapa Age: These are better feedback mechanisms to replace seeing your weight.  As you progress, you'll see your Shapa Color and Shapa Age improve!
Missions: Small, simple daily actions that are personalized to you.
Progress Review: Track your and celebrate your progress in your Shapa program.
Integration With Fitness Devices: Shapa allows you to sync with the Apple Health app and many other fitness platforms to record your fitness data. With this fitness data, Shapa will provide additional feedback about your activity in the Progress Review screen.
Vacation Mode: You can take a pause so as not to effect your progress over time. Or take Shapa with you, it loves to travel too! 
Shapa Streak: Keep your weigh-in streak alive every time you step on the Shapa.
Community: Invite people to Shapa, share your progress
Amazon Alexa: Get your Alexa to read out your daily Missions.
Design: Shapa is sleek circular design (in cherry, oak, black, orange) so that it looks like it belongs in your home.
Why Shapa? We all know that weight gain is linked to serious health risks, from heart disease to diabetes. But for most of us, losing weight is an uphill battle. Shapa takes a behavioral science approach that understands the psychology behind why it’s difficult to lose weight.

- Use Puzzles: Access a variety of puzzles to challenge your mind and relax

With a 90-year legacy of delivering high-quality journalism, we are committed to keeping you informed, inspired, and connected to the world around you. bluejetty:00039984:ios.description:
Get healthier in a fun and rewarding way with LumiHealth — all from the convenience of your iPhone.
ALL YOU NEED IS AN IPHONE
It’s now easier to get healthy and earn rewards with just your iPhone. Join with an Apple Watch to unlock even more features and personalised insights (watch use is optional).
START YOUR HEALTH JOURNEY
Pick from a range of fun challenges that can help you work on fitness, nutrition, mindfulness, and more. Earn rewards for completing healthy actions! 
FOCUS ON WHAT MATTERS MOST TO YOU
Multi-week Quests can help you work on specific health goals — from strength-building to getting consistent sleep. You can even get help managing chronic conditions like high blood pressure and diabetes. Quests meet you where you are, with personalised goals and daily coaching to help you succeed.
EARN REWARDS WITH EVERY HEALTHY ACTION
You’ll earn coins for completing challenges, responding to surveys, reading articles, and more. Turn the coins you’ve earned into HPB eVouchers, usable at major lifestyle retailers, F&B outlets, and supermarkets.
—
This programme is available for residents in Singapore with a SingPass account, aged 15 years old or older. LumiHealth integrates with the Health app and uses HealthKit to personalise goals and challenges.
Ensure your iPhone is running on one of the two most recent iOS versions. If you choose to use an Apple Watch as part of the programme, you’ll need to ensure that it’s running on one of the two most recent watchOS versions.
For more details, visit www.lumihealth.sg
