bluejetty:00061212:ios.name: Good Night Bo
bluejetty:00061212:ios.summary: Welcome to "Good Night Bo," the perfect bedtime story app for kids! This cute and interactive app helps children aged 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 years old learn how to count and read with delightful, cute zoo animals. It's a goodnight book designed
bluejetty:00061212:ios.description:
Welcome to "Good Night Bo," the perfect bedtime story app for kids! This cute and interactive app helps children aged 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 years old learn how to count and read with delightful, cute zoo animals. It's a goodnight book designed for preschool and kindergarten children, making storytime fun and easy.
INTERACTIVE LEARNING FOR YOUNG CHILDREN
* Read Aloud & Learn Numbers: Enjoy a cheerful narration that helps your child learn to read aloud or read along. This app features an audio story in English that encourages counting up to five as Bo says goodnight to his animal friends. It's a great activity to teach number recognition.
* Engaging Activities: This interactive book lets kids tap, pull, pop, and drag objects, bringing Bo's story to life with charming anime-style illustrations and delightful sound effects. Every page is packed with fun activities for your kid, baby or toddler.
* Offline Bedtime App: "Good Night Bo" works completely offline, allowing your kid to learn and enjoy this book anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection. It's ideal for short stories and low-prep nighttime routines.
* Perfect for Bedtime: This app is specifically designed for bedtime activities, helping children unwind and count to sleep. It's a wonderful addition to any early time routine for nursery and pre-k school students.
* 100% Kid-Safe: Rest assured, this app is completely safe for children, with no ads or in-app purchases, ensuring a calm and focused learning environment. (Even safe for babies and toddlers.)
* Have fun and enjoy the game-like experience!
ENRICHING EDUCATIONAL EXPERIENCE
"Good Night Bo" is more than just an interactive count-to-sleep app; it's an educational storybook that helps preschool and kindergarten children learn numbers, how to read, and develop early literacy skills. With its cute picture animations and engaging activities, it's a good way to make learning fun for every child.
AVAILABILITY
This goodnight app is available on iPad, iPhone, and Mac, making bedtime with Bo and his zoo animals accessible to your family.
WALA BEAR INC.
* https://www.walabear.com
* Please visit our site for more information.

bluejetty:00186339:ios.description:
PBIS Rewards Parent is a parents/ guardians portal to the PBIS Rewards system. Parents/Guardians can use the app to see the accomplishments and goals met through the PBIS Rewards program. They are able to keep track of the points earned, referrals, and purchases from the school's store as well as upcoming events. bluejetty:00045580:ios.description:
Com Kikos Fit uma rotina saudável é mais simples do que você imagina e transformar o seu corpo e a sua vida é possível. VEM!
Faça parte do melhor app de treinos e experimente fazer suas atividades em casa, no condomínio, na praia, no hotel, na praça, na academia ou onde você estiver. 
Fácil de encaixar na sua rotina: assista no celular ou na SmartTV.
ENCONTRE SEU TREINO IDEAL
Exercícios dinâmicos e variados para todos os níveis, com opções para diferentes objetivos e intensidades.
• Força Funcional 
• Kikos Abs 
• Pilates 
• Kikos Dance 
• Kikos Kombat 
• HIIT 
• Ciclismo 
• Corrida 
• Protocolo ZR11 com Zé Roberto 
• #TeamLui com Marcio Lui 
• Vem com a Dani Cicarelli 
• Prancha 
• Funcional 3D 
• Corrida 3D 
• Treinamento Híbrido 
• Yoga 
• Meditação e Mindfulness 
• Prevenção de dor e lesão 
• Mobilidade e Alongamento 
• Nutrição 
• Suplementação 
• Medicina esportiva 
• Motivação 
• Autoconhecimento e bem-estar 
• Saúde dos idosos 
• Atividades para as crianças
• E muito mais!
O aplicativo é constantemente atualizado, fique sempre de olho em NOVAS AULAS.
DESENVOLVIDO PELA KIKOS FITNESS STORE
Há 35 anos juntos pela saúde!
• Kikos Fit é a plataforma de treinos da Kikos Fitness Store, empresa referência no mercado fitness com uma linha completa de equipamentos e acessórios profissionais e residenciais.
TREINE COM QUEM TE INSPIRA
Lado a lado com as pessoas que você admira.
• Conte com um time inspirador de instrutores e tenha acesso aos treinos de celebridades como a apresentadora e triatleta Daniella Cicarelli, o ex-jogador de futebol Zé Roberto e o personal trainer dos famosos, Marcio Lui.
PARCERIAS EXCLUSIVAS
Programas que você só encontra aqui. 
• Acesse programas de treinos completos e gratuitos de grandes parceiros do app como a MPR Assessoria Esportiva, maior e mais respeitada assessoria do Brasil, e My Yoga, a rede de estúdios de Yoga certificada pelo Yoga Alliance (EUA).
ESTAÇÕES FITNESS EM SÃO PAULO
Treine nas estações públicas da cidade seguindo as orientações do app Kikos Fit.
DEFINA METAS E SUPERE-SE
Transforme a sua rotina e veja os resultados.
• Estabeleça metas semanais ou mensais.
• Acompanhe seu progresso e suba no ranking.
• Comemore suas vitórias com medalhas exclusivas.

bluejetty:00178508:ios.description:
A legújabb OTP SZÉP kártya alkalmazással könnyedén követheted az aktuális egyenlegedet és a tranzakcióidat, előleget utalhatsz, ellenőrizheted, hogy mekkora összeget nem használtál még fel a két évvel korábbi juttatásaidból, a térképes keresővel pedig elfogadóhelyeket is kereshetsz.
Az alkalmazás kizárólag az OTP SZÉP kártyabirtokosok számára használható.
Már regisztráltál a honlapunkon?
Ha már van OTP SZÉP Portál (www.otpportalok.hu) regisztrációd, akkor az alkalmazáson belül nem szükséges újra regisztrálnod, az azonosítást követően a Portálon használt e-mail címeddel és jelszavaddal az appba is be tudsz lépni. Az azonosításhoz első alkalommal szükséged lesz a kártyaszámodra és a születési dátumodra. A későbbiekben a belépéshez választhatsz ujjlenyomat- vagy arcfelismerést is, ha a telefonodnak van ilyen funkciója.
Mire van szükséged új regisztrálóként?
 az OTP SZÉP kártyád 16 jegyű kártyaszámára,
a születési dátumodra,
és egy működő e-mail címre.
A kártyaszám és a születési dátum megadása után kövesd a regisztrációhoz szükséges további lépéseket az alkalmazáson belül. A regisztráció során meg kell majd adnod az e-mail címed és egy jelszót, el kell fogadnod az adatkezelési tájékoztatót, meg kell adnod az e-mailben kapott megerősítő kódot. Ha telefonod rendelkezik ujjlenyomat-olvasóval, vagy arcfelismerővel, akkor dönthetsz úgy is, hogy a későbbi belépésekor így azonosítod magad. 
A regisztrációt követően az internetes Portálra is beléphetsz a megadott e-mail címmel és jelszóval.
További információk a regisztrációról: https://magan.szepkartya.otpportalok.hu/gyakori-kerdesek/

minimum iOS 10.0-ás operációs rendszer

bluejetty:00183024:ios.summary:
The original murder mystery invites you to a dinner party to die for…
Step into the shoes of your favourite cast of classy criminal characters – Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Reverend Green, Professor Plum, Mrs Peacock and Dr Orchid – an
bluejetty:00183024:ios.description:
The original murder mystery invites you to a dinner party to die for…
Step into the shoes of your favourite cast of classy criminal characters – Miss Scarlett, Colonel Mustard, Reverend Green, Professor Plum, Mrs Peacock and Dr Orchid – and explore the iconic rooms of the Tudor Mansion, rendered in stunning 3D like never before. 
Play against challenging AI opponents, or go online to challenge Clue/Cluedo fans from around the world. You can even set up a nostalgic games night with your friends and family in Private Multiplayer! 
Whodunit? With what weapon? Where? There’s six suspects, six weapons, nine rooms, and only one answer…
HOW TO PLAY CLUE: CLASSIC EDITION: 
1. Three cards are hidden away at the start of the game – these cards are the solution to the crime.
2. Each player gets three Clue Cards. These can’t be part of the solution, so they are automatically crossed off your clue sheet. 
3. Roll the dice and move your token around the board.
4. If you choose to enter a room, you can make a suggestion. Pick who you think committed the crime, with what weapon and where. 
5. Each player then takes it in turn to compare your suggestion against the cards they hold. If they have a card that features in your suggestion, they’ll tell you. 
6. Cross off any cards other players have shown you and whittle down your list of suspects.
7. When you are ready, you can make an accusation! If your accusation is wrong, you’re out of the game!
FEATURES
- CROSS-PLATFORM MULTIPLAYER – Play with your friends and family on PC, mobile and Nintendo Switch.
- ONLINE LEADERBOARDS – Outsmart fans around the world with weekly online leaderboards.
- MULTIPLE MODES – Face up to six players in Online Multiplayer, or take on customisable AI suspects in Single Player Mode. 
- PRIVATE LOBBIES – Set up a family game night easily with the Play with Friends Mode.
Catch the criminal! Play Clue: Classic Edition today!

bluejetty:00151228:ios.description:
MASTER LUCID DREAMING
Your dreams can be your superpower. Awaken the energy of your sleeping mind by becoming lucid in your dreams. In just 10 minutes a day, you can explore your dreams for:
- Creative insights: dreams are pure creativity
- Profound mental breakthroughs
- Self-awareness, meaning, adventure, and personal growth
- And genuinely fun — exploring the universe in your dreams is right here at your fingertips
MEET MAYA, YOUR DREAM GUIDE
Maya is an AI guide trained on the research of Stephen LaBerge, Matthew Walker, Carl Jung and decades of lucid dreaming science. Tell her a dream and she'll help you see what's in it — without the dream-dictionary nonsense. She remembers every dream you share, so the picture gets clearer the longer you practice.
THE COURSE
23 guided lessons, in the voice of a certified mindfulness instructor and lucid dreaming teacher. Start with attention and dream recall, move through reality testing and dream signs, and finish with the induction techniques that actually work: MILD, WBTB, and wake-initiated lucidity. Each lesson comes with a short practice you can do the same day.
YOUR DREAM JOURNAL
Write as many entries as you like. Maya reads what you write and surfaces the symbols, people, places and emotions that keep coming back — your Patterns page turns a pile of entries into the shape of your inner life. Turn any dream into high-resolution artwork.
SLEEP BETTER, LIVE BETTER
Bad sleep ruins your nights and your days. Learn the clinical fundamentals of sleep hygiene, why REM matters, and how to build the sleep that makes vivid dreaming possible in the first place.
OVERCOME NIGHTMARES
Transform recurring nightmares into something you can move through, using evidence-based methods — without digging through trauma or root causes.
WHAT PEOPLE SAY
"The lucid dreaming course is flat-out, bone-simple, brilliant. Not a word or breath is an extraneous move. The goal is there, elucidated, on Day One. Go. Now. Starting this course again tomorrow." — Micah
"Brilliant, loved every module. Your course is so thorough and touches on many aspects that resonate very deeply within me and my consciousness. I'm so grateful for what you've done." — Paul
"Surprisingly effective. Been following the sessions and using the journal for a few weeks now and am actually surprised by the results. Lucid dreaming is easier than expected when you train and focus on it." — Fred
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Mind Awake Pro is $9.99/month or $79.99/year (auto-renewing), with a 7-day free trial on the monthly plan for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Service: https://mindawake.co/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mindawake.co/privacy

Your dreams can be your superpower. Awaken the energy of your sleeping mind by becoming lucid in your dreams. In just 10 minutes a day, you can explore your dreams for:

- Creative insights: dreams are pure creativity
- Profound mental breakthroughs
- Self-awareness, meaning, adventure, and personal growth
- And genuinely fun — exploring the universe in your dreams is right here at your fingertips

MEET MAYA, YOUR DREAM GUIDE

Maya is an AI guide trained on the research of Stephen LaBerge, Matthew Walker, Carl Jung and decades of lucid dreaming science. Tell her a dream and she'll help you see what's in it — without the dream-dictionary nonsense. She remembers every dream you share, so the picture gets clearer the longer you practice.

THE COURSE

23 guided lessons, in the voice of a certified mindfulness instructor and lucid dreaming teacher. Start with attention and dream recall, move through reality testing and dream signs, and finish with the induction techniques that actually work: MILD, WBTB, and wake-initiated lucidity. Each lesson comes with a short practice you can do the same day.

YOUR DREAM JOURNAL

Write as many entries as you like. Maya reads what you write and surfaces the symbols, people, places and emotions that keep coming back — your Patterns page turns a pile of entries into the shape of your inner life. Turn any dream into high-resolution artwork.

SLEEP BETTER, LIVE BETTER

Bad sleep ruins your nights and your days. Learn the clinical fundamentals of sleep hygiene, why REM matters, and how to build the sleep that makes vivid dreaming possible in the first place.

OVERCOME NIGHTMARES

Transform recurring nightmares into something you can move through, using evidence-based methods — without digging through trauma or root causes.

WHAT PEOPLE SAY

"The lucid dreaming course is flat-out, bone-simple, brilliant. Not a word or breath is an extraneous move. The goal is there, elucidated, on Day One. Go. Now. Starting this course again tomorrow." — Micah

"Brilliant, loved every module. Your course is so thorough and touches on many aspects that resonate very deeply within me and my consciousness. I'm so grateful for what you've done." — Paul

"Surprisingly effective. Been following the sessions and using the journal for a few weeks now and am actually surprised by the results. Lucid dreaming is easier than expected when you train and focus on it." — Fred

SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS

Mind Awake Pro is $9.99/month or $79.99/year (auto-renewing), with a 7-day free trial on the monthly plan for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Service: https://mindawake.co/terms
Privacy Policy: https://mindawake.co/privacy

bluejetty:00153005:ios.name: ECOX Network
bluejetty:00153005:ios.summary: ECOX is a smart and easy-to-use app that rewards people for doing things that help the environment. It uses Eco-To-Earn model, AI technology, and real-life actions to support a greener future. Instead of earning rewards by using energy-heav
bluejetty:00153005:ios.description:
ECOX is a smart and easy-to-use app that rewards people for doing things that help the environment. It uses Eco-To-Earn model, AI technology, and real-life actions to support a greener future. Instead of earning rewards by using energy-heavy methods, ECOX encourages users to make eco-friendly choices in everyday life and get rewarded for it.
We Fix Every Corner Of The Earth
We believe that everyone can play a part in protecting the environment. With ECOX, users are encouraged to find their own creative ways to help the planet. Every person, every idea, and every action matters, from reducing waste to supporting renewable energy.
Through our platform, ECOX raises awareness about critical environmental issues and inspires global participation in sustainability efforts.
How ECOX Works
ECOX turns your real-world green actions into rewards. Here’s how it works:
1. Choose an action: Pick from a list of eco-friendly tasks like recycling, saving electricity, or biking instead of driving.
2. Submit proof: Take a photo or video of what you did and upload it in the app.
3. AI verifies it: Our AI checks your submission to make sure it’s real.
• If it meets the requirements, it’s approved automatically.
• If there’s uncertainty, our team will review it manually.
4. Earn rewards: Every approved action earns you points and recognition in the app.
We Align With ESG Goals
ECOX is designed to support Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) values. We help users take part in the sustainability movement while also connecting with responsible technology and digital communities.
We also work with partners who share the same mission of building a better, greener world.
Why ECOX?
• Get real rewards for helping the planet
• AI-powered review for trust and fairness
• Built for everyone - simple, clear, and purpose-driven
• A tool to take climate action every day
You don’t need to be a climate scientist or an activist. ECOX gives you the tools to do something good for the world every day!

From critically acclaimed storytelling to powerful photography to engaging videos — the GatorSports app delivers the local news that matters most to your community.
APP FEATURES:
• Access all of our in-depth journalism, including things to do around town, sports coverage from high school to the pros, and much more.

See "Subscription Support" in the app's Settings for more details and customer service contact information.

bluejetty:00133472:ios.name: Empire Survivor: Idle Defense
bluejetty:00133472:ios.summary: Welcome, aspiring mage, guardian of Arcane Order, to the realm of Elysia. This mobile RPG places you in the role of a powerful sorceress, tasked with defending the mystical floating city of Elysia from relentless waves of monstrous invaders
bluejetty:00133472:ios.description:
Welcome, aspiring mage, guardian of Arcane Order, to the realm of Elysia. This mobile RPG places you in the role of a powerful sorceress, tasked with defending the mystical floating city of Elysia from relentless waves of monstrous invaders. Armed with a vast arsenal of spells and the strategic manipulation of enchanted runes, you'll stand as the last line of defense against a growing magical threat. 
Runic Empowerment: The core mechanic of Empire Survivor revolves around enchanted runes that materialize around your platform. By tapping, swiping, and holding these runes in specific sequences, you’ll cast a variety of spells. Each rune sequence corresponds to a different spell, offering a strategic depth to combat. 
Elemental Mastery: Spells fall under five distinct elemental categories: Fire, Water, Earth, Air, and Arcane. Fire spells deal high damage in a concentrated area, while Water spells offer crowd control and healing. Earth spells create defensive barriers, while Air spells focus on mobility and manipulation. Arcane spells are versatile, offering powerful effects and utility.
Combo Building: Stringing together rune sequences unlocks increasingly powerful spells within the same element. A basic Fire rune sequence might launch a fireball, while a more complex combination could unleash a meteor shower. Mastering these combos becomes crucial in taking down tougher enemies.
Enemy Variety: The monstrous hordes come in all shapes and sizes. From hulking Orcs resistant to physical attacks to nimble Goblins adept at dodging spells, you’ll need to adapt your strategy based on enemy weaknesses and attack patterns. 
Boss Battles: Interspersed throughout the waves are epic boss battles against monstrous champions of the encroaching darkness. These encounters require a deep understanding of enemy mechanics, strategic use of elemental combos, and quick reflexes to emerge victorious.
Character Progression: As you defeat enemies and earn experience, your Enchantress will level up, unlocking new spells, upgrading existing ones, and enhancing your overall magical prowess. You can further customize your playstyle by specializing in a particular element or focusing on utility spells. 
Equipment and Enchantments: Scattered throughout Elysia are hidden caches containing enchanted equipment. These items can bolster your magical power, enhance specific elemental abilities, or provide passive benefits like increased health or cooldown reduction. Additionally, you can discover powerful enchantments that modify the effects of your spells, allowing for further customization.
Social Features: While Empire Survivor is primarily a single-player experience, there’s a strong social aspect to the game. You can join guilds with other players, share strategies, compete in leaderboards for the highest wave cleared, and even collaborate on special guild challenges.
The Story Unfolds: As you progress through the game, defeating wave after wave of enemies, the narrative unfolds. Fragments of lore are revealed through collectible scrolls and cryptic messages intercepted from enemy forces. You’ll learn about the source of the corruption, the motivations of the enemy leader, and the potential for a hidden prophecy that could turn the tide of the war.
Aesthetics and Soundscape: Empire Survivor boasts a vibrant and colorful art style. Elysia’s floating cityscape is a marvel to behold, bustling with life and pulsating with arcane energy. The enemy designs are grotesque and varied, each creature reflecting its elemental alignment and combat style. The game’s soundtrack is an immersive blend of orchestral music and ambient sounds, swelling with intensity during combat encounters and calming during moments of respite.

• Collection of beautiful background photos.
• Ability to adjust the time of day when quotes are presented.

bluejetty:00177393:ios.description:
Dino Evolution Run 3D is a real race for the right to be at the top of evolution. Evolve your monster in different elements to become stronger and defeat the boss. Upgrade stats to increase your chances of success. Choose your Dino and make it the most dangerous monster on the planet. Also, you can choose a cool hat to make it looks really cool and stylish. Are you ready?
EVOLUTIONARY RACE
Run for upgrade elements to evolve into the ultimate creature that can become the top of the food chain. Move from side to side and collect bonuses of different elements to transform your dinosaur and become stronger. Think over your route, and use all your logic and dexterity to stay in the chosen way.
UNSTOPPABLE GROWTH
Collect elements to become the strongest dinosaur. Along the way, you will meet different elements that will improve your character and evolve it into a completely new monster. Get water, stone, electricity, fire and other elements to defeat everyone in your path. But be careful - different effects interfere with each other. Choose one element per race and collect it to get the maximum power-up.
REQUIRED DEXTERITY
Stay on track during the race. Dodge rockets, mateorites and other obstacles to reach your goal! Collect elements that you need and evolve your dinosaur. Use all your dexterity and complete the ideal route to win the race.
BATTLE FOR SURVIVAL
Fight against the most dangerous creatures to prove that you can survive. Run the perfect race, collect all the necessary elements, improve your attack and defense to increase your chance in a fight against the giant boss. When the time comes up, click on the enemy monster to hit it. Don’t forget to upgrade the stats, the enemies can also bite painfully.
MAKE YOUR MONSTER CUTE AND STYLISH
As you progress, you will open up new dinosaurs and opportunities for customization. Tyrannosaurus or Triceratops? Choose your dino and make him the strongest monster on the planet. And also put a cool hat on it to make it handsome and stylish.
Game Features:
Run the path from an ordinary reptile to the strongest monster
Defeat all enemies on the way
Use all your dexterity to stay in the race
Level up and survive, show who's in charge here
Choose a hat and look to make your dino the most stylish
Cool minimalist 3D graphics
Nice user interfaces
Easy game control
EVOLVE YOUR DINOSAUR
Dino Evolution Run 3D is an incredible race to the bottom in order to evolve and rise to the top of the food chain. Improve performance and run the perfect route. Choose the right elements and become a completely new creature. Defeat the boss and prove that you are the strongest! Ready to race? Download and play completely free!

bluejetty:00071715:ios.summary: Choose Apple Music songs, playlists, albums, an artist’s top songs, or stations for your sound buttons. Apple Music access is free in LEMO; catalog playback requires Apple Music eligibility. Mixing with built-in ambient sounds uses LEMO Plu
bluejetty:00071715:ios.description:
Choose Apple Music songs, playlists, albums, an artist’s top songs, or stations for your sound buttons. Apple Music access is free in LEMO; catalog playback requires Apple Music eligibility. Mixing with built-in ambient sounds uses LEMO Plus.
Plus Mixing Mode: Enable it in Settings to play multiple ambient sounds together and control each sound independently.
LEMO FM is an ultra-simple, elegant white noise App designed to help users achieve better sleep quality, resolve insomnia and anxiety issues and ultimately lead healthier lives. By playing high-definition natural sounds, it allows you to focus, relax, or fall asleep quickly, and achieve a healthier lifestyle and sleep. Under the philosophy of "Less is more," we designed LEMO FM. Its interface is a simple and elegant radio design. When your finger touches the radio button, natural sounds start playing, and the breathing light also starts to flash in and out. These carefully designed interactions allow you to start a journey of sound in a very ritualistic way.
##What can you do with LEMO FM:
 – Sleep – LEMO FM is your sleep assistant, making sleep easier. Natural sounds (like rain, forest sounds, etc.) can help you enter a deep sleep state quickly; if you are a parent needing to soothe your baby, you can also play LEMO FM sounds.
 – Relax – Calm your mood and enter a comfortable, relaxed, and secure state. During mindfulness and meditation, you can open LEMO FM to play white noise to quickly calm down.
 – Focus – It can help you focus for longer periods and work efficiently. The exquisite timer function can even be used as a pomodoro clock, allowing white noise to stop playing on a schedule.
 – Learn - Block out external distractions and immerse and focus more during learning.
Design Philosophy
"LEMO FM" is a white noise App inspired by radios. Its design is just like a real radio, playing a variety of classic, high-quality white noise, such as rain, bonfires, forests, etc. Under the skeuomorphic interface, clicking the button will provide mechanical sound and vibration feedback, just like pressing a real radio button. Skeuomorphism is the most distinctive visual feature of LEMO FM, but behind skeuomorphism, we pursue simplicity and elegance in operation.
##Simulate the texture and operating experience of a real radio
When the sound button is pressed, it emits a crisp sound like a mechanical shutter, and the white noise slowly begins to play. We hope friends who use this "player" can immerse themselves in a ritualistic experience.
##Breathing light effect on the sound button
The faint light on the sound button, simulating the soothing rhythm of human breathing, though not particularly conspicuous, you will notice it with continued use, and even use it as a meditation breathing light.
##"Lifetime Member" Exclusive Unique Number
To make friends who like LEMO FM feel like they own a physical white noise radio, we have designed a unique member number function for lifetime members!
##Beautiful lock screen cover
Devices above iOS 16 support displaying album covers on the phone's lock screen. We have selected particularly beautiful lock screen covers for each sound, leading you into the realm created by the sound.
##Future Function Planning:
 – More rich, high-quality natural sounds, such as the sound of sea tides, the sound of small rivers, etc.;
 – Support Apple system widgets;
 – Support integration with Apple Watch;
 – Adapt to the display effects on iPad's large screen;
Welcome to contact us:
Everyone is welcome to write to us in various ways, your support and suggestions will bring unlimited possibilities to LEMO FM!
Email thelemoapp@gmail.com
Red book @LEMO APP
Instagram @thelemoapp
Looking forward to your letter!

bluejetty:00121397:ios.name: Gravity Rider
bluejetty:00121397:ios.summary:
Start the engine and get on your ride! Travel through space and tackle racing challenges on a variety of planets on the way to becoming the master rider.
KEEP YOUR BALANCE
Race to the finish at turbo speed, but watch out – jumps, mega ramp
bluejetty:00121397:ios.description:
Start the engine and get on your ride! Travel through space and tackle racing challenges on a variety of planets on the way to becoming the master rider.
KEEP YOUR BALANCE
Race to the finish at turbo speed, but watch out – jumps, mega ramps, elevators & twisted tracks will challenge you! Try to keep your space bike steady and land safely in this exciting bike balance game.
SWIRLING 3D STAGES
Hold tight as you speed through colossal loops, narrow turns and take risky high jumps. Feel even more thrill thanks to the dynamic pursuit camera, showing the action from the best angles!
PLAY WITH REALISTIC PHYSICS
Leverage the power of the realistic physics-based engine: push blocks to build bridges, balance on ramps and time properly.
AVOID DEADLY TRAPS
Can you make it to the finish line in one piece? Gigantic lasers, sharp shurikens and dangerous spikes got scattered around the stages and it takes some master skills to avoid them.
CHALLENGE OTHER RIDERS
The universe is full of talented contenders and everyone wants to be the top rider. Challenge the Gravity Rider community and prove who’s the fastest! Race against other riders’ best runs to know how you stack up against them.
DOMINATE ON EVERY PLANET
As you go from planet to planet, every environment is different and poses different types of challenge. Beat times, opponents, clear special tests and more while you admire beautiful vistas.
Gravity Rider is free to download and play, however some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you do not wish to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device settings. A network connection is also required.
Auto-renewable subscription: VIP membership offers a weekly subscription, you will have a 3-days free trial period, after this period you will be charged. After buying this subscription, you will unlock certain features and cause the ads to be removed for the subscription period. Payment is charged to iTunes account at confirmation. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off in the settings of the iTunes account after the purchase, no later however than 24 hour before the next renewal. Any unused part of the free trial period if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription. For more details please check Terms of Use.
By downloading the game you accept our End User License Agreement, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: http://support.vividgames.com/policies
Contact us anytime at support@vividgames.com

bluejetty:00088564:ios.name: Tizi Pink Home Design Games
bluejetty:00088564:ios.summary: Design your perfect Pink Dream Home, pink mansion, and bring your creative visions to life! Immerse yourself in a vibrant pink world where your imagination takes center stage. Whether you adore pink rooms, dream of a pink princess and pink
bluejetty:00088564:ios.description:
Design your perfect Pink Dream Home, pink mansion, and bring your creative visions to life! Immerse yourself in a vibrant pink world where your imagination takes center stage. Whether you adore pink rooms, dream of a pink princess and pink dollhouse, or envision a pink mansion filled with exquisite luxury pink furniture, Tizi Town is the ultimate playground for interior design enthusiasts. Let your creativity run free as you design, decorate, and customize every inch of your dream house in a realm inspired by all things purple pink, and fabulous.
Step into the enchanting universe of Tizi Town Pink Dream Home and discover endless opportunities for self-expression. Here, you’re in charge of building a pink house and designing your pink world dream home—whether it’s a cozy pink dollhouse or a lavish pink mansion. The game offers a user-friendly experience where players can explore pink games and create stunning spaces featuring elegant pink furniture and trendy decor elements. From crafting themed rooms to adding fine details like wall art, decorative accessories, and unique layouts, Tizi Town Pink Dream Home is a haven for those who love luxury interior design.
Create Your Perfect Pink Room
Begin by designing the perfect pink room that reflects your personality. Imagine walls painted in dreamy hues of blush, rose, or hot pink, paired with matching pink furniture that elevates the ambiance of your space. Whether you’re aiming for a cozy retreat or a vibrant and lively setting, the design possibilities are limitless. Add layers of creativity with accent pieces, rugs, cushions, and lamps to complete the look. Tizi Town Pink Dream Home lets you personalize every corner of your Pink Dream Home, ensuring your space is as unique as you are.
Experiment with layouts, play with Pink Dream Home design textures and discover the joy of mixing and matching luxury furniture styles. Your pink world's dream home decoration can range from a chic minimalist haven to an extravagant pink mansion filled with luxury and charm. Each item you choose adds character to your pink world, making every room an extension of your imagination.
A Pink Dollhouse Come to Life
Transform your ideas into reality by designing a pink dollhouse that looks straight out of a fairy tale. Whether you’re decorating a room fit for a pink princess or creating a chic and modern living area, Tizi Town Pink Dream Home provides all the tools you need. Design Pink themed spaces that range from vintage glamour to contemporary elegance. Use pink furniture to craft unique setups that bring your vision to life.
Add special touches to your pink dollhouse with miniature accessories like photo frames, plants, and adorable knick-knacks. Build a world where every room tells a story, and each detail captures your personal style. The pink dollhouse concept is perfect for fans of pink avatars and pink-themed games who want to step into a playful yet sophisticated world of design.
Explore the Pink World of Tizi Town
In Tizi Town, the fun extends beyond just decorating. Step outside your dream home and explore a bustling pink world filled with inspiration and creativity. Walk through vibrant streets, visit virtual stores packed with decor items, and find ideas to transform your pink room or pink mansion. The dynamic environment allows players to interact with friends, share design ideas, and enjoy fun activities like parties, gatherings, and even design challenges.
Whether you’re attending a pink theme event in the Pink World Center or relaxing at a charming purple pink park, Tizi Town’s social atmosphere keeps the excitement alive. Meet fellow players, exchange tips, and find new inspiration to enhance your designs. The more you engage, the more vibrant your pink world becomes.

bluejetty:00015550:ios.description:
From award-winning creators! Otsimo | Speech Therapy SLP is proud to be the only Speech Therapy app that uses voice and speech recognition technology and machine learning; it understands exactly what you are trying to say! 
For those who experience speech related issues such as:
- Delayed speech (late talkers),
- Non-verbal autism and down syndrome affecting speech,
- Difficulty to articulate themselves and enunciate,
- Apraxia,
- Aphasia,
- Stuttering
- Articulation issues,
Can use Otsimo | Speech Therapy SLP for speech practice efforts and improving their speech. 
The speech games designed specifically for individuals, are created under the guidance of parents, speech language pathologists (slps), and therapeutic activity experts. The assistive games in Otsimo | Speech Therapy SLP aim to improve speech and communication skills.
All the reasons to try out Otsimo | Speech Therapy:
- We use voice and speech recognition technology to evaluate what is being said for accurate results, enhancing the speech therapy experience. 
- With receptive, machine learning technology, the app detects whether or not the articulation and pronunciation is being improved.
- Each speech exercise is followed by funny filters, with hats and masks as rewards, to make learning more fun.
- Each speech exercise also has 200+ stickers to be collected, encouraging the individual to be more engaged with the speech therapy.
- The exercises involve repetition, a popular method of aba speech therapy, which helps with the development of the person with speech impediments.
- As part of certified professional therapy, we use video modelling that enables learning from peers through mimicking.
- Our apps are updated on a weekly basis with exciting content and speech activities, so you never get bored of learning new words.
- Otsimo | Speech Therapy also offers settings for parental control.
 For purposes of learning and development, Otsimo | Speech Therapy SLP will teach how to articulate the correct sound of vowels and consonants and more, so they can learn to communicate orally in an improved way.
Otsimo | Speech Therapy SLP is a pocket SLP that you can use as speech therapy at home. Awarded as the best therapy activities app, it aims to reduce any kind of language and speech problems, in a fun way!
The Otsimo | Speech Therapy app consists of 15+ categories, including First Words, Basic Shapes, Body Parts, Safari Club, Tongue Acrobatics, Rainbow Splash! Each category is designed to stimulate sound production.
Otsimo | Speech Therapy SLP journey starts with 7-days free trial or monthly subscription. We offer monthly, annual and lifetime subscriptions. Actual charges might be converted to local currency depending on your country of residence. At the confirmation of purchase, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. 
Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Our account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. Subscriptions may be managed by the user. Auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user’s Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to the app. 
Disclaimer: Otsimo | Speech Therapy SLP is developed in a way that can be used with a guardian. Any individual can benefit from the service without any age restriction. 
For more information: 
Privacy Policy & Terms of Use - https://otsimo.com/en/legal/privacy-speech/
Payment Policy - https://otsimo.com/legal/payment.html

Television Time is the best way to track the shows you watch, with a beautiful interface and a ton of features.
"We tested a bunch of apps and found that Television Time is the best TV tracker for iOS." - The Sweet Setup
"Television Time gives you a fighting chance of tracking all the great shows you'd like to see - regardless of where or when they happen to be airing." - Craig Grannell, British GQ
"Television Time is my favorite TV show tracker that integrates with trakt.tv" - MacStories
Features
• Beautiful design: Easily navigate between series and episodes to find everything you need to know.
• Sync your progress with Trakt.tv (Plus) or over iCloud
• Widgets: View upcoming shows, or episodes you missed, on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• Stats: View your overall series progress, time spent watching TV, and more.
• Information about the cast and crew
• Support for rich notifications, universal links, keyboard shortcuts and pointer, alternate app icons, and more.
Contact
Follow us on Twitter @TelevisionApp or send an email to support@televisiontime.app for questions, comments, and support.
Television Time Plus
Television Time is free for up to 5 shows. Subscribe or purchase Television Time Plus to:
• Track unlimited shows
• Sync your progress with Trakt.tv
• Unlock additional app icons
• Sync upcoming episodes with your Calendar
• Receive notifications for upcoming shows
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/MaxHasADHD/PrivacyPolicies/blob/master/TelevisionTime.md

bluejetty:00193544:android.description:
Sonic Trail: Race Pino invites you on a vibrant 2D musical journey where rhythm is everything. Step into the shoes of Pino as you dash through dynamic tracks filled with falling notes that align perfectly with the highs and lows of the background song. Each beat, each melody, and every drop is carefully synchronized—your reflexes must match the tempo.
In this casual rhythm-based adventure, your mission is simple yet engaging: catch the musical notes as they fall in harmony with the song’s pace. Fast beats, slow harmonies, and dramatic shifts will keep you on your toes. Missing notes breaks your flow, while perfect timing fills your performance meter and leads to satisfying combos.
As you progress, you'll unlock new songs, each offering unique themes and visual atmospheres to match the music’s tone. From dreamy lullabies to upbeat techno, the game grows with your rhythm mastery. New environments, colorful trails, and catchy tracks await every skillful player.

bluejetty:00140035:ios.summary:

Grab your trusty chainsaw and get to slicing and dicing fruits so they can be turned into de
bluejetty:00140035:ios.description:
► A FRUIT-FUL BUSINESS
Imagine a game that is part fruit ninja, part idle farming, and part business empire: congrats, it’s Chainsaw Juice King! 
Grab your trusty chainsaw and get to slicing and dicing fruits so they can be turned into delicious smoothies and juices, which will earn you a pretty profit and help your business grow. In addition to chopping up all those bananas and strawberries, you’ll also need to manage your workers, keep products stocked, and so much more – this business simulator will keep you on your toes in the cutest way. 
That’s right, we’ve made sure to include adorable graphics and the perfect sound effects so you can really get in the mood. So grab your trusty chainsaw and hurry on down to your fruit farm, your customers are waiting!
► TOTALLY BANANAS
● Your goal is simple: harvest fruit to make juice that you can then sell from your shop. But as you begin your journey to becoming a fruit tycoon you’ll soon realize how much more is involved in this arcade style farming and business simulator! Carefully balance where you spend your profits, expand your base, hire workers, cut up fruit – and hey, watch out for the big ones, they might get you! Thrilling and fast paced, this game is sure to delight.
● Juicy graphics: that’s right, get ready for the best chainsaw and fruit splattering sound and visual effects as you slice your way through your crops! Despite your character’s preferred method of harvesting, these graphics are cute and perfect for all ages. You’ll be too focused on the fun, bright colors and cute characters to worry about the shop simulator side of the game.
● Build your empire: don’t let anything stand in the way of you becoming the ultimate juice tycoon! Master the art of running a farm business as you juggle all the different aspects, but don’t sweat it too much – this game still manages to be all fun.
● Idle farming: part of what keeps it so fun is the idle aspect of the game. Even when you’re not actively playing your character will still be collecting resources and earning you money. All you need to do is sit back, relax, and watch the dough come rolling in… just watch out for that watermelon!
● Fantastic fruit: apples, oranges, kiwis, and so much more await you! Despite their cute faces, you’ll need to keep an eye out for the bigger versions as those guys may not take kindly to you harvesting and juicing the little fellows. Time your attack to cut them up into smaller pieces and you’ll reap the rewards!
► LET’S GET JUICY
Put your fruit ninja skills to the test as you seek to become the ultimate juice tycoon in the land! Harvest fruit from your farm in this arcade style game, then master the business side by hiring workers and selling your finished products for big bucks. 
With all sorts of tasks to complete and fun new places to explore, you’ll never get bored in Chainsaw Juice King – try it today to see how fruitful your business can be!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

We guarantee you
bluejetty:00071086:ios.description:
Glitty is a wonderful coloring book in which you paint by spreading shimmering glitter. Relax by spreading glitter on layers and listening to the soothing sounds of the sand. This is a real ASMR coloring book for adults.
We guarantee you haven't seen this method of painting before. Sprinkle shimmering sand on layers with glue and enjoy the beautifull colors!
Chill by painting and listening to the relaxing sound and music.
- Enter the world of rainbow colors, wonderful coloring pages, and true creativity. No matter where you are, you can turn on the coloring book app at any free moment, relax and express your artistic soul.
- In Glitty, you paint coloring books by spreading shimmering glitter on appropriate layers of the chosen picture. 
- 2 painting modes. Choose whether you want to spread glitter from above or under your finger
- Coloring books for children and adults.
- Coloring book painting time 5-10 minutes
- Shiny glitter effects
- You can paint without the internet connection
- A unique painting system that has never been seen anywhere before
- Confirmed by players relaxing effect. Coloring books help with overstimulation, help you relax and de-stress
- Use coloring boosters to help you finish detailed pictures
- Themed coloring books for every season and mood
- Use the app the way you want with its many settings and modes
Choose from hundreds of works we have prepared for children and adults. You can browse through all of them or use the prepared categories to find realistic coloring books, cartoon pictures, crochet-like pictures (with 3D effects), and more.
Are you bored with pixel art games and looking for an alternative? This game is perfect for you! During a break at work or at school, on the train or subway, you can paint a new creative picture and feel like a real artist. Thanks to glitter, each coloring book takes on a wonderful and unusual effect, sparkling with multicolored gleaming glitters and crystals.
How to color the pictures? 
Just pour glitter on a layer, when you paint the whole color you will automatically move on to the next one.
What kind of coloring pages can you find in our application? We offer a wide range of pictures including:
- Animals (colorful parrots, butterflies, dogs, cats, flamingos)
- flowers and floral designs (roses, orchids, tulips)
- Beautiful views and landscapes (Hawaiian islands, great cities of the world)
- Jewelry (gold, silver, and diamond ornaments)
- Delicious cookies, fruits, dishes
The coloring books are divided into categories, among others:
- Realistic pictures
- With 3D effect
- In a crazy cartoon style
- Crocheted and embroidered
Enjoy many setting options to paint the way YOU like. It’s possible to paint offline.
Unleash your artistic soul and have fun.
Glitty is a great alternative to click-and-fill and pixel art coloring books. Sprinkling sand gives you an even more relaxed, fashionable ASMR style coloring and fun.
Our coloring book is fully adapted for tablets. Enjoy the brilliant glitter in high resolution. 
Hundreds of adult coloring books will make sure there is something for everyone. Draw and relax on your day off.
Greetings, Glitty team
To access all coloring pages and additional options, you can subscribe to an automatic renewal subscription. You can choose between two options:
Monthly subscription - we will charge a fee of $5.99 for each week
Lifetime acess for $19,99
The subscription is managed by the user and can be cancelled by going to the user account settings.
Terms of service: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00087702:ios.description:
Rentbrella is here to make your life easier and keep the city always within your reach. Unexpected rains and UV rays can't be an obstacle in your days, not anymore. Next time the weather gets in your way, go to the nearest Rentbrella station and start sharing.
Our umbrellas are designed to endure the most intense of rains with their reinforced fibreglass structure and hydrophobic fabric technology.
How to start using Rentbrella:
1. Create an account and register a credit card
2. Use the map to find the closest Rentbrella station
3. Tap "I want an umbrella" and scan the station's QR Code
4. Use the station keyboard to type in the code generated on the app
5. Withdraw the umbrella and enjoy the city
6. Return it in any other Rentbrella station using the app
What's the use of owning an umbrella if we're always without it when it rains? For this reason and many others, we believe that through sharing we can achieve a more efficient, conscious and innovative world.
—
Can we help?
If you want to know more about Rentbrella, visit us at rentbrella.com and if you have any questions, check our 'Help' tab inside the app, we'll get you sorted.

bluejetty:00155735:ios.description:
There's now a better way to manage your chronic pain. The HFX App pairs with the Nevro HFX iQ spinal cord stimulator to learn from your unique pain and deliver personalized pain relief from your smartphone. Join over 100,000 people who have been treated with HFX therapy.
The HFX App is easy to use:  
 1. You complete simple check-ins 
 2. HFX iQ learns from your unique pain experience 
 3. Get your personalized recommendation 
With the HFX App you can:  
Get continuous pain relief.  
HFX iQ will learn from your inputs, preferences, and unique pain experience to deliver personalized pain relief.  
Receive proactive patient support within 24 hours.
The HFX App will send alerts to your Nevro Care Team so they can proactively reach out to provide support when you need it.   
Save your favorite programs. 
Bookmark your favorite programs that you like to use or want to easily return to. You can personalize your favorites by giving it a name like “walking” and selecting a color. 
Track your progress. 
Better understand your pain level trends, review your relief over time, and how your pain responded to past programs.  
Earn badges. 
Collect badges as you complete goals, achieve more pain relief, or reach a milestone.  
Check your battery level. 
Your battery level is conveniently displayed on your Home screen. When your battery is low or empty, you will get a notification to recharge.  
Safely get an MRI scan.* 
Easily turn on MRI Mode so you can safely get a full-body MRI scan.    
*Within conditional parameters. Refer to https://www.nevro.com/English/us/patients/patient-manuals/default.aspx  for detailed information on MRI safety and conditions. 
________________________________________ 
The HFX App will work on select Apple devices: iPhone 8 and above running iOS 15 or later. To view the list of compatible devices, go to https://www.NevroHFX.com/resources/hfx-app/
The HFX App is approved for use with the Nevro HFX iQ Spinal Cord Stimulator within the U.S., English Only. 
The HFX App controls an implanted medical device only available if prescribed by a physician. You should consult your physician before using the Nevro HFX iQ Spinal Cord Stimulator (including the HFX App) or making medical decisions.  The HFX App can change your HFX iQ therapy settings; use only as directed by your Nevro Care Team or physician.

bluejetty:00100518:ios.description:
Build your dream soccer club with over 5,000 players. Scout talent, master your strategy, and lead your club to glory in SEGA’s soccer management game.
SEGA FC Champions is back!
Build your soccer club from the ground up in SEGA’s soccer management simulation. Experience a soccer game where every decision matters, from scouting and player development to transfers, finances, tactics, and football strategy.
BUILD YOUR SOCCER CLUB
A successful soccer club needs more than talented football players. Strengthen your team, improve facilities, attract sponsors, and grow your football club season after season. Build a soccer organization that reflects your strategy and style of football by managing your budget, investing in proper facilities, and making decisions that shape the future of your football club.
SCOUT AND SIGN PLAYERS
Scout and recruit soccer players from around the world. Discover promising football talent, experienced stars, and players who fit your soccer team and strategy.
A great soccer manager knows what a club needs. Scout players who match your football strategy, strengthen weak positions, and create a balanced team. From soccer prospects to football stars, every signing can shape your club.
DEVELOP YOUR PLAYERS
Finding talented soccer players is only the beginning. Develop your soccer team through football training and help young players reach their potential.
Turn promising football players into soccer stars and build a football team that grows stronger every season. Smart soccer development can make the difference at the highest level of football.
MASTER TACTICS AND STRATEGY
As a football manager, you decide how your club plays. Choose formations, set soccer tactics, and adjust your football strategy for every opponent.
Soccer is about more than individual talent. Create a soccer strategy that makes the most of your team. A smart soccer manager can change a soccer game with the right football tactics and strategy.
MANAGE YOUR FOOTBALL CLUB
Being a football manager means thinking beyond the pitch. Manage finances, control your budget, negotiate sponsorships, and improve your stadium and facilities.
Build a strong foundation for your football club. Smart soccer management and football strategy are essential for a club aiming for the top.
REAL SOCCER CLUBS AND PLAYERS
Experience a soccer game featuring licensed clubs and real football players. Build your team, develop soccer players, and compete to become one of the strongest clubs in football.
COMPETE AND PROVE YOUR SKILLS
Put your soccer management and football strategy skills to the test. Compete against other clubs and managers, improve your team, and refine your soccer tactics.
From scouting football players to choosing soccer tactics, every decision shapes your performance. Learn from every football match, adjust your strategy, and build a stronger club.
PLAY ACROSS DEVICES
Continue your soccer club journey across supported devices with cross-play. Manage your football club wherever you are and keep building your ultimate soccer club.

bluejetty:00045464:ios.name: iPrescribe
bluejetty:00045464:ios.summary: iPrescribe is a mobile e-prescribing app that helps healthcare providers simplify workflows and improve patient care. Whether you’re in the office, on the go, or working after hours, iPrescribe provides secure and efficient tools for managi
bluejetty:00045464:ios.description:
iPrescribe is a mobile e-prescribing app that helps healthcare providers simplify workflows and improve patient care. Whether you’re in the office, on the go, or working after hours, iPrescribe provides secure and efficient tools for managing electronic prescriptions. 
Access Requirements
The iPrescribe app is exclusively for users who have created an account through the iPrescribe platform, including completion of IAL-2 identity-proofing with ID.me.  
Downloading the app does not grant access. For more information on creating an account, visit www.iPrescribe.com. 
Who It’s For 
Individual Providers: Flexible solutions for healthcare professionals. 
Independent Practices: Scalable tools for clinics of any size. 
Specialty Care Providers: Tailored features for specialties such as mental health, dentistry, dermatology, psychiatry and others. 
Key Features 
Comprehensive E-Prescribing: Make informed prescribing decisions with access to critical patient information, including demographics, medication history, preferred pharmacies, and clinical alerts. 
Live Chat and Email Support: Get technical support for troubleshooting issues and comprehensive onboarding assistance.  
EPCS-Ready: Prescribe controlled substances with full compliance, using an EPCS certified platform enabled with two-factor authentication. All iPrescribe identity proofing uses ID.me, iPrescribe’s independent partner. 
PDMP Integration: Access prescription drug monitoring program (PDMP) databases directly within the app to ensure safe prescribing and adherence to state regulations. State regulations vary, so please consult your state’s guidelines.  
Connect With Patients: Call patients securely using the app without revealing your personal number. 
Team Access Options: Add administrative staff and, where allowed by applicable laws and regulations, provider agents to assist with prescription workflows, ensuring smooth and efficient operations. 
Desktop Flexibility: Prescribe seamlessly from your desktop in the office, with full access to iPrescribe features for efficient in-office workflows. 
No EHR Required: iPrescribe works as a standalone solution on mobile and desktop, with no need for EHR integration. 
EHR Integration: The desktop version of iPrescribe integrates seamlessly with your EHR. 
iPrescribe is your all-in-one solution for secure, compliant, and efficient prescribing across mobile and desktop platforms. Save time, reduce administrative burdens, and focus on what matters most: patient care. 
Download iPrescribe today and experience modern prescribing on your terms.

bluejetty:00033446:ios.description:
Spinner Battle is a thrilling and addictive mobile game that combines strategy and skill. In this game, players use their collections of spinning tops, each with unique abilities, to engage in battles against opponents. The objective of the game is to knock out the opponent's spinning tops by launching your own tops into them, using strategic timing and skillful aim.
As a player, you start with a small collection of spinning tops and gradually build your arsenal by collecting and unlocking different types of spinning tops, each with their own strengths and weaknesses. You can use these tops to build powerful combinations for battle and strategically defeat opponents.
Spinner Battle is designed to be easy to learn but challenging to master. The game features intuitive controls that allow players to quickly launch their tops and unleash powerful attacks. There are also multiple game modes to keep things interesting, including a single-player campaign and online multiplayer battles.
The graphics and sound effects in Spinner Battle are top-notch, with colorful and detailed spinning tops that come to life on your mobile screen. The game also features a catchy soundtrack that adds to the excitement and energy of the gameplay.
As players progress through the game, they can earn rewards and unlock new tops to add to their collection. Multiplayer modes allow players to compete against each other online in intense battles of skill and strategy.
Overall, Spinner Battle is a must-play game for fans of spinning tops and competitive games. With its addictive gameplay, unique merging mechanic, and challenging battles, it is sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. So what are you waiting for? Download Spinner Battle today and start battling!

bluejetty:00013730:ios.description:
VMonkey is a Vietnamese language learning application for Kindergarten & Primary School children under the new General Education Program, closely following the primary school output standards.
VMonkey application helps children promote their imagination, develop cognition, develop language, social skills, nurture their soul and arouse love in Vietnamese in children. VMonkey gives children an interesting, interactive and unique reading experience thanks to:
Part 1: Reading
-750+ interesting stories and 350+ audiobooks divided into many levels suitable for the ability to acquire language and daily activities of children in Kindergarten and Primary School. New stories are updated weekly.
-Interactive-Comic Method - let children experience a vivid reading experiences and a Vietnamese environment. Children gradually inprove their ability to use words, and at the same time gain more knowledge and skills in life through lessons integrated in each story.
Part 2: Learning including Reading Comprehension & Spelling Exercises
-The system of 112 rhyme lessons is divided into 3 levels. The volume, length of lessons and interactive activities are built according to the age and receptivity of each child.
-An interactive comic book store with 10 common topics, presented using real photos, beautiful drawings, and vivid animations to help children understand correctly and enjoy reading stories.
Part 3: Listening (audiobook):
 -The archive of audiobooks selected from the Vietnamese and world's literary treasures is divided into four categories: Classics, Poetry, Life Lessons and Fairy Tales, folklore with humanistic and meaningful content to nourish a child's heart.
 -Standard and emotional voice, suittable for reading stories, no lisp, no dialect, combined with music and sound effects to help children be exposed to the standard Vietnamese learning environment.
Outstanding features of VMonkey:
-Adhere to the Primary Vietnamese curriculum of the Ministry of Education & Training
-Vivid comics with animation
-Standard pronunciation with Northern and Southern Vietnamese accents.
-New content updated weekly
-The text changes color as the voice read
-Interactive function: touch or press to display an object's name
-Record children's reading to stories and save as videos
-Listen to audiobooks even when the app screen is off - No ads
ABOUT US
VMonkey is developed by Early Start company, along with other products: Monkey Junior application, currently being the leading app for teaching children to learn languages; Monkey Stories, an app for developing comprehensively 4 English skills: Listening, Speaking, Reading and Writing; Monkey Math, a Math learning app for Kindergarten & Primary School children
Achievements:
-First prize of Global Initiative 2016 initiated by President Obama in Silicon Valley, USA.
-First Prize of Vietnamese Talent 2016
-Southeast Asian Information Technology Gold Award 2016
-Top 1 app Teach your baby to read the number 1 in the US
-Top 20 Early Education Apps in America.
We have a mission in early education and our motto is: Education begins from the day a child is born. The education of young children should be filled with joy and excitement. We have helped millions of children learn to read at an early age, and let us help your child on this journey.

bluejetty:00052157:android.description:
The successful Bridge Constructor series – number 1 in the Google Play Store with over 30 million players worldwide – treads new paths with Bridge Constructor Stunts! 
Stuntman and engineer in one? No problem with Bridge Constructor Stunts!
Build imposing ramps and loops to reach your goal in the diverse stages. But building structures alone isn't enough this time: you sit behind the wheel of the vehicles yourself and have to maneuver them skillfully to the goal. Collect stars, complete daredevil jumps, flips and spectacular stunts, leaving behind a trail of destruction across the entire level to beat the high score. But you can only do all that with perfectly constructed bridges and ramps.
Join the huge Let's Play community
To ensure none of your jumps are forgotten, you can save your runs as videos, upload them via the sharing feature and share them with your friends. Let the world be part of your most outrageous jumps!
Improved Construction Mode
Once again you have access to a variety of building materials with different properties. Numerous improvements make building even easier: simply tap to convert a beam you have built into road, and vice-versa. Tap and hold on a part of the construction and you now have the option to reposition your structures without having to build them from scratch. 
Loose Screw!
We have hidden some hard-to-reach screws in some of the levels. Find and collect them, and you might be able to put these screws to good use in the future...

- The latest instalment in the internationally successful Bridge Constructor series!
- Improved and simplified Construction Mode

 - Achievements and rankings
 - Replay feature and video sharing: save your best bridge crossings and stunts and share them with your friends 
 - Google Play Game Services for Achievements and Leaderboards
 - Tablet support

bluejetty:00064766:ios.summary: Technology is meant to make life easier. Bank securely and conveniently with CSB Simple Banking. Our FREE app is available to Community State Bank customers and offers quick access for managing your CSB accounts and debit card. Use your cur
bluejetty:00064766:ios.description:
Technology is meant to make life easier. Bank securely and conveniently with CSB Simple Banking. Our FREE app is available to Community State Bank customers and offers quick access for managing your CSB accounts and debit card. Use your current online banking credentials to get started or enroll through the app!
Mobile Banking Features
• Manage Accounts — Monitor accounts, review current balances and past transactions.
• Transfer Funds — Move money from CSB account to another.
• Locate ATMs — Find an ATM near you when you’re on the go.
• Manage your Debit Card — Secure, monitor and manage access to your CSB Debit Card. 
• Enable Touch ID and Facial Recognition — Take advantage of Apple’s Touch ID to log into your account from your iOS device.
• Review Check Images — Tap the icon next to a check number to quickly view a check image.
• Make Mobile Deposits — Take photos of checks to deposit them directly into your CSB accounts. 
• Pay Bills and People — Pay vendors and people through the app after setting up Bill Pay and Pop Money through Online Banking. 
• Push Notifications & Account Alerts – Setup & receive push notifications and Account Alerts through the app! Stay updated on your recent account activity and banking information.
*Must be a Community State Bank Customer and enrolled in CSB Online Banking, or bank customers may enroll in CSB Online Banking via the CSB Simple Banking App
. 
**Community State Bank is Member FDIC. This application is offered by Fiserv, Inc. as the service provider. Community State Bank does not charge a fee to use CSB Simple Banking, but data rates may apply. Check with your communications service provider for details. To sign up for CSB Online Banking or view the Community State Bank Privacy Notice please visit CSB.bank.
https://csb.bank/support

bluejetty:00076621:ios.description:
Triple Match City - The Ultimate Hidden Objects Adventure!
Are you ready to sharpen your observation skills and test your focus in an exciting and fast-paced hidden objects game? In Triple Match City, your mission is simple yet thrilling: find hidden objects across expansive maps and match them in sets of 3 before the time runs out! Immerse yourself in this captivating scavenger hunt challenge that will keep your brain engaged and your eyes sharp.
Embark on a journey through beautifully designed maps filled with hundreds of hidden items waiting to be discovered. Every level brings a new challenge, with more intricate scenes, harder-to-find objects, and limited time to complete your goal. It’s a race against time—can you find all the objects before the clock runs out?
Key Features:
- Exciting Hidden Object Gameplay: Find and collect small objects scattered across massive, colorful maps. Match them in sets of 3 to clear them from the screen!
- Time-Based Challenges: Feel the thrill as you race against the clock to complete your tasks.
- Diverse Maps and Themes: Explore vibrant locations like crowded bustling cities, mysterious deserts, icelands, and more!
- Helpful Hints: Can’t spot an object? Use hints to reveal its location and keep moving forward.
- Zoom Functionality: Zoom in and out of the map to spot even the tiniest hidden objects.
- Relax or Challenge Yourself: Play casually to unwind, or take on harder levels to test your speed and accuracy.
- Frequent Updates: Enjoy new maps and challenges added to keep the adventure alive.
- Free to Play: Triple Match City is completely free to download and play, with optional in-game purchases available for boosters.
How to Play Triple Match City:
- Search and Collect: Observe the map closely, find hidden objects, and match them in groups of 3 to clear them.
- Beat the Timer: Keep an eye on the clock—complete the level before time runs out!
- Zoom and Swipe: Zoom in, out, and swipe across the map to uncover hidden items in every corner.
- Use Hints: Stuck on a tricky item? Use helpful hints to locate it and keep progressing.
Why Play Triple Match City?
If you love hidden object games, scavenger hunts, or brain-teasing puzzles, Triple Match City is the perfect challenge for you! It’s a unique twist on the classic hidden object genre, combining fast-paced gameplay with relaxing exploration. Whether you’re playing to relax or to push your skills to the limit, Triple Match City is your next favorite game.
Explore Modern Cities, Viking Villages, Western Towns, Ancient Egyptian Pyramids, and More: Each map features unique hidden objects and challenges to uncover.
- Improve Observation Skills: Train your brain and attention while solving scavenger hunt puzzles.
- Fun for All Ages: Whether you’re playing solo or with family and friends, Triple Match City offers entertainment for everyone.
- Search and Find Bright Hidden Objects: Use your focus to spot items on colorful and vibrant maps.
- Relax Your Mind with Scavenger Hunt Puzzles: Play at your own pace and enjoy the calming gameplay.
Download Triple Match City Now!
Dive into the ultimate hidden object adventure today and challenge yourself with this addictive scavenger hunt game. Explore stunning maps, match objects in sets of 3, and race against the clock to become the ultimate master of Triple Match City!

bluejetty:00186451:ios.name: Mazes & More: Classic Maze
bluejetty:00186451:ios.summary: Mazes & More is a classic puzzle game, perfect for taking a quick break to train your brain. It’s designed to be a surprisingly simple solo game played by swiping or tapping through fun 2D retro labyrinths. Play a quick game, challenge your
bluejetty:00186451:ios.description:
Mazes & More is a classic puzzle game, perfect for taking a quick break to train your brain. It’s designed to be a surprisingly simple solo game played by swiping or tapping through fun 2D retro labyrinths. Play a quick game, challenge yourself with 450 labyrinths and become the king of the maze.
NEW Features
User-selected avatars: customize your player by choosing from 11 new characters that can replace the default Dot icon.
In-game navigation: allows you to customize with tap or swipe on-screen controls.
Custom Path Colors: optimized color options for a custom navigational path.
Level Skip: option to skip any level if you get stuck
Mirror Mode: Try to beat the mazes with all the controls reversed (Hint: Move up to go down)
Shuffle Mode: Play random mazes from different categories & test your skills in future levels
Lightning Mode: Do you have what it takes to complete this fast-paced gauntlet?
Key Features
Easy to play, forget about awkward tilt controls. Better than using a marker!
All mazes are handcrafted for maximum fun, all games are winnable.
6 categories: Classic, Enemies, Ice Floor, Darkness, Traps, and Time Trial. 
Puzzles range from easy mazes to much harder and advanced labyrinths.
Minimal and retro 2D graphics, forget about complicated 3D mazes.
OFFLINE MODE: no wifi required to play.
How to Play
Customize your player avatar and guide your new friend along the walls of our square mazes. Ditch your paper and marker & those confusing 3D games for this simple logic adventure game played anywhere you wish to relax. Test your memory skills, escape each maze & share your score with friends.
Tips & Tricks
Guide the dot or player avatar through different routes in this free maze adventure. Run, explore and find a way out of the intricate walls. Is there a Minotaur? 
No cat and mouse games here, just fun creative maze designs & exciting adventures for anyone. 
Have Fun! Kickback & Relax
Enjoy playing this casual puzzle, maze, labyrinth game when you feel mentally fatigued or need to sharpen your mind. Discover addictive challenges and hours of entertainment with over 450 different levels and progressive game modes to choose from. The puzzles range from easy mazes to much harder and advanced labyrinths to keep the challenges interesting
Mazes & More is available in over 57 languages, including English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Vietnamese, Hindi, Turkish & many others. 
Thank you for playing Mazes & More! Have any problems, questions or general feedback? Our support team is here to help!
Email: contact@maplemedia.io
Visit us: http://www.maplemedia.io/

bluejetty:00140125:ios.summary: Zip Archiver is a powerful and easy-to-use file management tool for phone, designed to compress, decompress, and organize your files quickly. Whether you're handling large archives, sharing multiple files, or simply managing storage, Zip Ar
bluejetty:00140125:ios.description:
Zip Archiver is a powerful and easy-to-use file management tool for phone, designed to compress, decompress, and organize your files quickly. Whether you're handling large archives, sharing multiple files, or simply managing storage, Zip Archiver gives you complete control over your data in just a few taps. It's the ideal solution for anyone who needs to zip or unzip files while on the go, supporting all major archive formats like ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, and more.
◆ Key Features ◆
• Compress Files: 
 - Easily compress large files or multiple files into a single archive.
 - Create ZIP files to save storage space or for fast sharing via email, cloud storage, or messaging apps.
 - Supports advanced compression options for customisation.
 - Password-protect your ZIP files for enhanced security.
• Decompress Archives:
 - Open and extract contents from a variety of compressed file formats, including ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZIP, and more.
 - Supports multi-part RAR files and encrypted archives.
 - Browse, preview, and extract individual files from an archive without decompressing the entire package.
• File Management:
 - Manage files within the app with a built-in file browser.
 - Organize your documents, images, videos, and archives into folders.
 - Perform basic file operations like rename, delete, move, and copy.
• File Preview and Sharing:
 - Preview the contents of your archives before extraction, including documents, images, videos, and more.
 - Share individual files or entire archives via email, AirDrop, or supported apps like Dropbox, Google Drive, or OneDrive.
 - Export files to other apps for further editing or sharing.
• Batch Compression/Decompression:
 - Handle multiple files at once with batch compression and decompression.
 - Create multi-file archives with ease, perfect for organizing large sets of documents, photos, or videos.
• Advanced Security:
 - Add a password to your ZIP files to keep sensitive data secure.
 - Decrypt password-protected archives quickly and easily.
 - Store sensitive information safely, with the ability to encrypt and share protected files.
• User-Friendly Interface:
 - Clean, intuitive design that makes compressing and decompressing files simple for users of all skill levels.
 - Easy-to-navigate file structure with support for multiple views and sorting options.
 - Quick access to recently opened or created files for easy file management.
• File Formats Supported:
 - Compression: ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZIP
 - Decompression: ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, GZIP, ISO, BZ2, XZ, LZH, and more.
• Offline Mode:
 - Work with files and archives even when you’re offline. No internet connection required for zipping/unzipping local files.
◆ Use Cases:
- Organize your work files by compressing multiple documents into a single ZIP file for easy sharing.
- Unzip compressed files received through email or messaging apps to preview and extract contents directly on your device.
- Secure sensitive files by creating password-protected ZIP files.
- Manage and extract compressed files from cloud services without downloading them entirely.
Whether you’re compressing files for storage, sending large attachments via email, or unzipping archives you’ve downloaded, Zip Archiver simplifies file management. With its powerful features, easy-to-use interface, and full support for cloud services and encryption, Zip Archiver is your all-in-one solution for handling compressed files on phone.

– Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/liam-sammy-pp
– Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/liam-sammy-tos
Download it today and take control of your files!
