Built for businesses u
bluejetty:00119618:ios.description:
Square Team app is the one place for your team to communicate, manage schedules, access timecards, and stay in sync — all on the go. It also allows them to see their hours worked, breaks, overtime, and estimated pay.
Built for businesses using Square, the app enables employees to clock in and out on their phones instead of at the POS, which saves time and eliminates the need for team members to crowd around the POS to clock in. Employers can manage teams more easily, adjust schedules, and empower their employees by putting critical shift information at their fingertips. Employers using Square Payroll can easily pay their team, automatically importing timecards, tips, and commissions.
Your whole team can chat using real-time messaging and employers can send out important updates and announcements so the whole team stays in the know.
Team members can see when and where they’re scheduled to work, pick up open hours, and make sure their work schedule fits with their personal one. It also allows them to see their hours worked, breaks, overtime, and estimated pay. And if team members are paid through Square Payroll, they have access to their pay stubs and tax forms right on their mobile phones.
Home Screen
• Clock-in: Team members can clock in for an upcoming shift directly through Team app
• Weekly Snapshot: Team members can get a quick snapshot of when and where they’re scheduled to work
• Estimated pay: Team members can also see hours worked, breaks, overtime, tips and estimated pay
Messages and Announcements
• Messaging: Real-time messaging for the whole team, eliminating the need to share phone numbers.
• Announcements: Easily broadcast important announcements, news, and updates to everyone on the team.
Shifts
• Team-initiated scheduling: Empower your team to request time off, swap shifts, and claim open shifts directly from the Square Team app.
• Timecards, schedules and estimated pay: Team members can view timecards, scheduled hours, and view estimated pay.
• Clock in and out: Enable team members to clock in and out, take breaks, and get notifications.
Payroll
• Owners using Square Payroll can easily pay W2 employees and 1099 contractors, automatically importing timecards, tips, and commissions
• Our team of specialists will take care of the rest—we pay your team, file your payroll taxes, and send your tax payments to federal and state tax agencies.
My Pay
• If team members get paid through Square Payroll, they can: 
• See estimated earnings, even before they get paid
• Get paid faster via Cash App
• Download tax forms
• Update their bank account or personal details
• And all staff information is stored securely
Team Management
• Quickly see all of the team members at your location, edit team member information directly in the app, or resend invites to the team.
More
• Team members can update personal and account settings on the go.
Download the Square Team app and invite your team members now.

bluejetty:00139808:ios.description:
A new RPG 'Bistro Heroes', from Team Tapas, the developer of 'A Girl Adrift'!
◆ Gather various ingredients through hunting.
◆ Create tasty dishes with special ingredients to run a bistro.
◆ Collect hero clothes to create unique styles.
◆ Develop your town with numerous buildings and furniture.
◆ And…help the heroes save the world!
[Game Features]
- Small-sized, light RPG that can be enjoyed without additional downloads
- Various dishes made with ingredients from a fantasy world
- Cute clothes and furniture that can be used freely to decorate heroes and town
- Engaging storyline with the feel of a light novel
- Simple controls easy to learn, even for novices
- Fairytale-like atmosphere and graphics
[Community Page]
Website: https://teamtapas.com/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TeamTapas/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/teamtapas
[Storing Data Safely]
- The server storage feature of the game data is activated when synced with a social account.
- The game data is stored in the server only at certain moments of gameplay and is not stored constantly in real-time.
- To safely store the data, please manually save it in the server regularly by using the server save icon on the upper right side of the game screen.
[Notes for Switching Devices]
1. To transfer data to a new device when switching your device, you must first sync with your social account.
2. After syncing with your social account, use the server save icon on the upper right to manually save your data on a manual save slot.
3. Log in with the same social account from your new device, load the data you stored from your previous device and play the game.
[Notes for Updating]
- Bistro Heroes' updates are done manually through the store page.
- If your Bistro Heroes does not update normally, please try the following method.
1. Restart the device and try again
2. Device settings - select iTunes & App Store - Check App Updates - restart and try to update again
※ The update time may differ depending on your device, so please wait a while longer if the above method does not work.
※ Deleting the app may reset some of the progressed data.
[Customer Support]
- If you experience gameplay problems, contact us via the in-game [Settings] → [Customer Support] button.
- Contact is at support@teamtapas.com for other bugs and problems.

bluejetty:00130986:ios.name: VO2 Max: Widget Notifications
bluejetty:00130986:ios.summary:
VO₂ Max shows how much oxygen your body can absorb at peak effort. The redesigned dashboard puts the latest measurement, rolling averages, and your personal best in one view so you immediately see how training affects cardio fitness.
ESTIM
bluejetty:00130986:ios.description:
VO₂ Max shows how much oxygen your body can absorb at peak effort. The redesigned dashboard puts the latest measurement, rolling averages, and your personal best in one view so you immediately see how training affects cardio fitness.
ESTIMATES FOR RUN & BIKE
- New tab turns VO₂ max + weight + power into W/kg and FTP estimates for running and cycling.
- Compare modeled race times and power against your actual HealthKit FTP/power.
NEW DASHBOARD
- Trend cards highlight the 7-day average, any selected range, and your best value with percentage deltas.
- The interactive chart responds to 1W, 2W, 1M, 3M, 1Y, or All filters and animates every new HealthKit reading.
- Entry tiles list the test type, source, and timestamp so you can compare prediction and max-exercise tests.
INSIGHTS & GUIDANCE
- The info sheet matches your value with the correct age and sex bracket to explain whether it is poor, good, or superior.
- Manual refresh, HealthKit warnings, and empty states keep permissions and sync issues obvious.
- Trial countdown and subscription access stay a tap away.
APPLE WATCH + WIDGETS
- All complication families are supported, so your latest VO₂ max is available on every watch face.
- iPhone Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets follow the dashboard range you selected.
- The Widget Showcase walks you through pinning widgets or complications and previewing layouts.
HOW VO₂ MAX IS CAPTURED
1. Wear Apple Watch for at least 24 hours, then record several Outdoor Walk, Outdoor Run, or Hiking workouts with heart rate and GPS.
2. Apple may need several qualifying workouts and passive measurements before the first VO₂ max estimate appears.
3. Give this app read access to Cardio Fitness (VO₂ Max) in Apple Health so the dashboard, widgets, and complications can display the data.
Requires Apple Watch Series 3 or later. VO₂ Max makes it easy to see if your cardio fitness plan is working today, over the last weeks, and all time.

bluejetty:00036046:ios.name: White Noise & Box Fan
bluejetty:00036046:ios.summary:
Fall asleep faster with white noise, a box fan or soft rain that plays all night, or fades out gently once you've drifted off, then wake up to birdsong.
Sound Asleep has 61 sleep sounds, from soft rain and ocean waves to fans, white noise
bluejetty:00036046:ios.description:
Fall asleep faster with white noise, a box fan or soft rain that plays all night, or fades out gently once you've drifted off, then wake up to birdsong.
Sound Asleep has 61 sleep sounds, from soft rain and ocean waves to fans, white noise and a mother's heartbeat. 35 of them are generated live on your iPhone, so they never loop or repeat. The recorded sounds loop seamlessly, with no gaps, clicks or sudden volume jumps to wake you.
WHITE, PINK, BROWN, GREEN AND GREY NOISE
White noise masks snoring and street noise, pink noise is softer like steady rain, brown noise is a deep, low rumble, green noise sounds like a distant waterfall, and grey noise is balanced so every pitch sounds equally loud.
A FAN FOR EVERY ROOM
Box fan, ceiling fan, desk fan, air conditioner, air purifier, plus a hair dryer, vacuum and clothes dryer for little ones.
MIX AND SHAPE YOUR SOUNDSCAPE
Layer up to six sounds and set each one's volume. Turn up Warmth to soften a sound's bright edge, or Movement to make it rise and fall like slow breathing. Save your favorite mixes, or start with ready-made ones like Rainy Cabin, Deep Sleep and Night Train.
A SLEEP TIMER THAT WORKS
Choose from 15 minutes to 8 hours, or set your own length. The sound fades out gently at the end, so the silence doesn't wake you, and the timer counts down on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
WAKE UP GENTLY
Set a wake-up alarm with birdsong, a morning stream, a music box or wind chimes. It starts softly and rises, rings even on silent, and turning it off stops your sleep sounds too.
SOUNDS FOR EVERYONE
• Rain & Storms: rain, heavy rain, light rain, rain on a tent, rain on a window, thunderstorm, distant thunder
• Water: ocean waves, distant surf, seashore, stream, babbling brook, mountain river, waterfall, pond, underwater, cave drips, aquarium, shower
• Nature: birdsong, crickets, wind, snowstorm, wind chimes, campfire, fireplace, purring cat
• Noise: white, pink, brown, green, grey and deep noise
• Fans & Machines: fan, box fan, ceiling fan, desk fan, air conditioner, air purifier, extractor fan, hair dryer, vacuum cleaner, washing machine, clothes dryer, fridge hum
• Travel & City: car ride, train, airplane cabin, starship engine, city, market
• Baby & Comfort: womb, heartbeat, shushing, music box, ticking clock
• Calm Tones: singing bowl, deep space, and delta, theta and alpha binaural beats
GREAT FOR BABIES TOO
Shushing, womb sounds, heartbeat and white noise are favorites for settling newborns. Try the Little One mix in the nursery.
MORE THAN SLEEP
Use brown noise or rain to focus while you study or work, or to unwind after a long day.
BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and a Control Center button to start your sounds with one tap
• Plays in the background, with Lock Screen controls
• Ask Siri: "Play rain in Sound Asleep"
• Play alongside a podcast or audiobook if you like
• Pauses when you unplug your headphones, so it never blasts from the speaker
• Works offline, with no account and no ads
SOUND ASLEEP PRO
15 sounds are free forever, including rain, heavy rain, ocean waves, white, pink and brown noise, box fan, air conditioner, shushing and womb. Sound Asleep Pro unlocks all 61 sounds and mixes of up to six. Choose yearly or monthly with a 3-day free trial (we'll remind you before it ends), or pay once with Lifetime.
If you bought sounds or sound packs in an earlier version, they're still yours: tap Restore Purchases in Settings.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings at any time after purchase.
Privacy Policy: https://boluga.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://boluga.com/terms

bluejetty:00151297:ios.description: Barouche is a trick-taking card game popular in communities around the world. The game uses a standard deck, but with 2s, 3s and 4s removed. Four players form 2 teams, with partners sitting across from each other. Each player is dealt 9 cards, plus 4 cards for the widow in the middle of the table. An auction bid begins at 30, for the right to name the trump suit. The high bidder swaps out cards with the widow, then leads a trump. During the tricks phase, Aces are high, 5s are worth 5 points, 10s and Aces are worth 10 points. The other cards are worth nothing. The high bidder's team needs to meet or exceed its high bid.

Ducky Notes is a "Ducky"-themed healing-style & girlish journal diary book.Here,you can write diaries with Ducky.A lot of materials at Ducky's material store are free! Every day in the future, Ducky will accompany you to self-discipline clock, record mood and growth , complain troubles …

1.Ducky Notes software is a healing and cute software. A super cute and lovely "Ducky" accompanies you to write journal. You can freely collage and record in a cozy atmosphere.
2.Easy to operate, complete a journal in three steps.
3.A full range of materials and styles. Original and innovative journal stickers, backgrounds and brushes are constantly updated.

1.In the home page, click "+" to start writing journal.
2.When you finish the journal, you can enter the journal title and introduction and save it in the journal books you created.
3.In the left display bar of the home page, you can check the monthly journal clocking status in the calendar view.

bluejetty:00163618:ios.description:
In control. Healthier. Happier.
- Order repeat prescriptions to your door
- Book GP appointments
- Bring all your health information and GP records together
- Discover your Wellness Score
- Get practical insights on how to be as happy and healthy as possible
Welcome to Happychondria.
Welcome to Evergreen Life.
Happychondria is the word we use to describe the blissful state of being in complete control of one's health and wellbeing. By using the Evergreen Life app to interact with GP services like booking appointments and ordering prescriptions, as well as managing your wellbeing through our Wellness Score, you can take control of your health and wellbeing and experience Happychondria for yourself.
NHS-ASSURED GP ONLINE SERVICES
Available at GP practices in England:
- Save yourself time by booking and cancelling GP appointments.
- Order your repeat prescriptions directly to your door.
- Stay informed with 24/7 access to your GP medical record, including test results, immunisations, allergies and medications.
WHAT’S YOUR WELLNESS SCORE?
Taking control of your health starts with understanding it. Based on your answers to clinically-reviewed questions, your Wellness Score out of 100 helps you see if you’re doing all you can to be healthy and provides insights on how to optimise your wellbeing. 
ONE HEALTH RECORD. WHEN YOU NEED IT
Your GP, hospital and other records aren’t joined up, so it can get pretty tricky having to repeat the same information over and over. With Evergreen Life, you can build an accurate, up-to-date health record in the palm of your hand.
MEDICATION REMINDERS
Give yourself one less thing to worry about. Never forget to take your medications again with the Evergreen Life medicine app, helping you safely manage your own or your family’s health.
HEALTH AND FITNESS TRACKER
Track your health and fitness measurements, including blood pressure, body fat percentage and blood sugar levels, so you can monitor your health goals.
SECURELY STORE YOUR DOCUMENTS
If you struggle to find appointment letters or your health information is difficult to manage, storing all your documents in one app can make it much easier to organise your care.
SHARE WITH THOSE WHO MATTER MOST
Get the best care possible and give peace-of-mind to your family or health providers with secure access to your shared health information.
Need a helping hand? If you want any help and support with using the app or getting set up with GP online services, head to https://help.evergreen-life.co.uk or call our Support Team at 0161 768 6063
*Your local doctor’s surgery may not offer all GP online services. Ask your practice directly to find out which are available to you.

bluejetty:00173550:ios.description:
The missing girl in Lake Arbos sparks an investigation and the small community town is lit with gossip and confusion! A dark mystery is going to uncover in this tense yet fun drama!
You’ll help Rachel find out what’s happened and learn all about her as you serve customers in the town’s most popular cafe Local Crust. You’ll uncover mysteries, meet people from neighborhood community and unlock new areas to show your interior design skills better than any other home and mansion renovation games. You’ll get the chance to renovate and makeover untouched areas in the neighborhood.
Merge, Upgrade, Serve

Merge and match delicious meals on the board to create new recipes to serve hungry customers and complete tasks. Unlock new merge categories from delicious treats like cakes, pies and coffees to fantastic design objects to make you experience a relaxing and dream journey. bluejetty:00121528:ios.name: Klaverjas HD
bluejetty:00121528:ios.summary:
Your favourite Dutch card game, with a fresh look for 2026. Play Klaverjas your way on iPhone and iPad: challenge the computer, meet friends online, or take on the daily challenge.
YOUR RULES, YOUR TABLE
Choose Amsterdam or Rotterdam rules
bluejetty:00121528:ios.description:
Your favourite Dutch card game, with a fresh look for 2026. Play Klaverjas your way on iPhone and iPad: challenge the computer, meet friends online, or take on the daily challenge.
YOUR RULES, YOUR TABLE
Choose Amsterdam or Rotterdam rules and your preferred way of choosing trump. Play with mandatory trump selection, the traditional play/pass procedure, or explore Contrée and Kraken. Klaberjass and Belote are available too. Quick settings put your favourite combinations within easy reach.
A PARTNER IN EVERY HAND
Klaverjas is a trick-taking game for four players in two teams. Read your partner's signals, make the most of your trump cards and collect points together. Play against computer opponents or join friends and other players online. Computer players can fill empty seats.
LEARN FROM YOUR CARDS
Use the Trainer/Helper for card suggestions and explanations. Review tricks, compare your play with the computer's and explore how a different choice could change the result. Follow your progress through statistics, achievements and rankings.
A DAILY REASON TO PLAY
Try the daily challenge and see how your result compares with other players on the same deal.
MAKE YOURSELF AT HOME
Choose from different card decks and table backgrounds, including the original favourites. Prefer larger cards and controls? Adjust the playing screen to suit you. The redesigned table keeps scores, trump and player information easy to find.
FREE PLAY AND CLUB
Play for free with ads. Club membership removes ads and lets you use your own photo as a table background. Existing Legacy access continues to provide its applicable benefits.
QUESTIONS OR IDEAS?
We'd love to hear from you: support@knippie.com
More information: https://knippie.com
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Octopus on iPhone or Apple Watch simplifies the way you ride transport and shop in Hong Kong. Check your balance and skip queues by topping up using your favourite credit / debit card.

If you have an iPhone X or later, or Apple Watch Series 3 or later, simply download the Octopus App for Tourists to add a new Octopus. It is a breeze to check your balance and top up using your favourite credit card / debit card. If you already have a physical Octopus card, you can transfer it to your iPhone or Apple Watch easily.
With Octopus App for Tourists, you can:
- Add an Octopus Card to your iPhone or Apple Watch with just a few steps
- Top up anytime, anywhere, with your favourite non-Hong Kong issued Mastercard, UnionPay or Visa credit or debit cards 
- Check the balance and spending records of your Octopus
- Apply for a refund of the deposit and remaining value on your Octopus before departing Hong Kong
For more details, please visit www.octopus.com.hk

bluejetty:00080928:ios.description:
Transform your spoken words into written text effortlessly with Voice to Text & AI. Our powerful app leverages cutting-edge artificial intelligence to provide accurate and reliable speech-to-text conversion, making it easier than ever to capture your thoughts, notes, and messages.
With Speech & Dictation to Text functionality, you can simply speak into your device and watch as your words are transformed into written form in real-time. Whether you're a student, professional, or anyone looking to streamline their communication, our app offers a convenient and efficient solution.
Key Features:
- Advanced Speech Recognition: Powered by state-of-the-art artificial intelligence, our app ensures highly accurate and fast speech recognition. It captures your voice with exceptional precision, even in noisy environments.
- Real-time Transcription: Witness the magic of our real-time transcription feature, which converts your spoken words into text instantaneously. Say goodbye to manual typing and save valuable time.
- AI Technology: Experience the extraordinary ability to dictate softly with our AI technology. Even in hushed or low-volume conversations, the app adapts and accurately transcribes your speech.
- Multilingual Support: Communicate in your preferred language with ease. Our app supports a wide range of languages, allowing you to effortlessly transcribe speeches in various contexts.
- Editing and Formatting Tools: Customize your transcriptions with a robust set of editing and formatting tools. Easily correct any inaccuracies, format the text, and enhance readability for a polished final document.
- Cloud Sync and Storage: Seamlessly sync your transcriptions across multiple devices and access them from anywhere. The app securely stores your data in the cloud, ensuring you never lose an important note.
- Share and Export: Share your transcriptions directly from the app via email, messaging apps, or save them to popular cloud storage services. Collaborate with colleagues, send meeting notes, or archive important information effortlessly.
Voice to Text & AI empowers you to harness the power of your voice, converting spoken words into written text with exceptional accuracy and speed. Simplify your daily tasks, boost productivity, and unlock a new level of convenience with our reliable and feature-rich app.
ABOUT SUBSCRIPTION
Subscription payments will be charged to your App Store account at confirmation of your purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew and you will be charged unless auto-renew is turned off or unless you cancel at least 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription or trial period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period. The cost of renewal depends on the Subscription Plan you choose.
Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase or by contacting Customer Support.
Our standard Subscription Plans are:
* 1-Year Subscription
* 1-Month Subscription

apple-macos:1534708672.name: WHAT THE CAR?
apple-macos:1534708672.description:
Absurdly silly adventure full of racing, laughs, and surprises. Roll, jump, fly and sneeze your way to victory! 
NOT YOUR TYPICAL RACING GAME
You’re a car, but instead of wheels you have legs! Race through hundreds of unique levels by jumping, flying with jetpacks, climbing buildings, delivering packages, and pretty much everything you would NOT expect a car to do.
Hint: Look for hidden shortcuts and avoid explosives 
A WORLD TO EXPLORE
It’s not all racing. Explore the many islands to meet new friends, find hidden treasures or try your best at the quirky puzzles. 
Hint: Look behind the waterfalls!
CREATE YOUR OWN LEVELS
Make your own wacky levels, share them with friends and family, or climb the leaderboards of quirky levels made by other players.
Hint: Adding cute bears and speed pads that go vroom works every time!
OKAY, IT GETS REALLY SILLY
You’ll be flipping burgers, fishing, swimming, and singing CAR-aoke!
Hint: Don’t try to talk to the laser cow
DISCLAIMER: 
This game is for entertainment purposes only and will absolutely not improve your driving skills in any way. Actually, no one on the development team even owns a car.
SPOILER: 
A spoiler is apparently a thing you can attach to the back of a car to make it look cool… Who knew?!
Anyways, we hope you enjoy the game! We really enjoyed making it!

apple-macos:1529389288.name: Neural Network
apple-macos:1529389288.description:
Learning and using neural networks in an intuitive and natural way!
The tutorials now include a full Chapter 9 on Transformer: self-attention, causal masking, positional encoding, multi-head attention, a complete layer (FFN, residual connections and layer normalization), encoder/decoder variants, and language models with pretraining — each lesson with interactive diagrams.
Intuitive and interactive tutorials. A large number of charts and interactive components are used to make learning more intuitive.
Visualized Neural Network Lab. Open the black box of neural networks with simplified datasets and full visualization, gain more intuition.
Learning with mission like gaming. In the missions, you will run into many key concepts in neural networks, complete the challenges and acquire a deep understanding.
Put neural network lab in your pocket. 
Variety of datasets: 2D and 3D datasets both with regression and classification. Get the dataset just with a tapping.
Do experiments at anytime anywhere.
Good visualized neural network knowledges. Key concepts and dynamics are showed with charts and animations. Activations, regularizations, loss functions, classifications, Embedding, CNN1d, CNN2d, RNN and more to come.
Visualized Deep Learning Models. Learn the most classic models in an intuitive way that has never been seen before, and quickly master cutting-edge technology. Through modular diagrams, understand how data changes from input to output and how it changes at each step. There are detailed documents for each module, and even reference papers, source codes and animations.
Visual neural network model editor. Quickly build a model by dragging your fingers. What you see is what you get: Through real-time calculation and display of the output of each step, the construction of the model has never been so intuitive and efficient; real-time display of various errors, including parameters/input types and value compatibility, etc., abandoning inefficient debugging.
MORE FEATURES COMING!!!

apple-macos:6746052507.description:
aTravel Favorites – Your Trips. Your Places. Your Way.
aTravel Favorites is your personal travel companion – designed to help you save, organize, and revisit your favorite places, custom routes, and unforgettable travel moments.

Save Places: Store your favorite spots with name, icon, address, notes, and photos.
Organize with Groups: Categorize your sights by trip, theme, or region – fully customizable.
Interactive Map View: Visualize your saved places and routes on a map, with dynamic filters by region or category.

Photos & Comments: Enrich your entries with personal impressions and images.

Perfect For:
Travelers who want to remember every special spot
Hikers and cyclists who document their routes
Globetrotters who plan and archive their adventures
Anyone who loves maps and personalized travel logs
Privacy First
Your data stays yours. aTravel Favorites stores everything locally on your device – no tracking, no cloud dependency, no ads.
Relive your travels – beautifully organized with aTravel Favorites.

apple-macos:6739888423.name: RIFT Notes: Voice Memo to Text
apple-macos:6739888423.description:
RIFT Notes is the fastest way to get a thought down.
Type it like a text. Say it and RIFT writes it out. Snap a photo. Your notes sync free across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
No ads. No accounts. No subscription. No tracking.
Type it
Write like you're texting yourself. Hit send and it's saved. Add a #tag and it's sorted.
Say it
Talk, and RIFT turns it into text. It all happens on your device, so it works offline and your voice never goes anywhere to be transcribed.
Snap it
Take four photos in a row and they land in one note. Give them a Look: Pop Print, Thermal, Newsprint, CGA, and more amazing filters.
Map it
Notes can remember where you wrote them. Retrace your day, find that door code, or play a voice note back right where you recorded it.
Theme it
Over 50 themes, from quiet paper to loud retro.
Prompt it
Add a note without opening the app. Use Siri, Spotlight, Shortcuts, the Action Button, Camera Control, Control Center, or the Share sheet.
Keep it
Notes sync through your own iCloud, free on every device. Each note is also saved as a plain Markdown file in iCloud Drive, so any app can open it. If you ever leave, your notes come with you.
Also
• Bold, lists, and checklists show up as you type
• Search every word, or filter by tag or color
• Focus mode when you just want to write
• Quick Bar to jump anywhere from the keyboard
RIFT Pro (was PowerPack)
Pay once, keep it forever. RIFT Pro adds voice, the camera, the map, and themes. Writing, tags, search, and sync stay free for everyone. The Mac has its own RIFT Pro purchase. This was previously named PowerPack, if you've purchased the 'pack you have Pro.
Your notes live on your devices and in your iCloud. We can't see them at all.
Free to download.
